words.enDefinition: One separate section of a whole bulb of garlic

examples.en: The recipe listed a clove of garlic next to the lemon juice.
examples.zh: 菜谱在柠檬汁旁边列了「一瓣大蒜」。

examples.en: My roommate asked whether a clove of garlic was enough for the whole bowl.
examples.zh: 室友问这一整碗放「一瓣大蒜」够不够。

words.enDefinition: a quantity of twelve eggs, often sold in one carton

examples.en: I bought a dozen eggs because we were cooking breakfast for several people.
examples.zh: 我们要给好几个人做早餐，所以我买了「一打鸡蛋」。

examples.en: The corner shop sold a dozen eggs for less than the campus store.
examples.zh: 街角小店卖「一打鸡蛋」比校内商店便宜。

collocations: a carton of a dozen eggs

words.enDefinition: A small amount of oil poured in a thin stream

examples.en: The salad called for a drizzle of oil rather than a full spoonful.
examples.zh: 这份沙拉要用「少量淋上的油」，用不着满满一勺。

examples.en: We added a drizzle of oil before tasting the salad with our neighbors.
examples.zh: 和邻居一起尝沙拉之前，我们加了「少量淋上的油」。

collocations: finish with a drizzle of oil

words.enDefinition: A small piece of butter measured by eye rather than weight

examples.en: The British recipe listed a knob of butter instead of giving a weight.
examples.zh: 这份英国菜谱写的是「一小块黄油」，没有注明重量。

examples.en: My roommate asked how much the recipe meant by a knob of butter.
examples.zh: 室友问，菜谱说的「一小块黄油」大概有多少。

collocations: a knob of butter for mixing

words.enDefinition: Choosing separate dishes from a menu, with each priced individually

examples.en: The server asked whether we wanted to order à la carte for lunch.
examples.zh: 服务员问我们午饭想不想「按单道菜点」。

examples.en: We asked which dishes could be ordered à la carte that evening.
examples.zh: 我们问那天晚上有哪些菜可以「按单道菜点」。

words.enDefinition: one portion of food ordered to go with a main dish

examples.en: I ordered a side of fries to share with my flatmate after our lecture.
examples.zh: 下课后我点了「一份薯条」作配菜，和室友分着吃。

examples.en: Could I get a side of rice with the curry in the same bag?
examples.zh: 咖喱能配「一份米饭」吗？放同一个袋子里就好。

words.enDefinition: A small, informal amount of milk poured into something

examples.en: I added a splash of milk after testing the consistency of the batter.
examples.zh: 我试了下面糊的稠度，然后加了「少许牛奶」。

examples.en: The recipe calls for a splash of milk to make the mixture easier to stir.
examples.zh: 菜谱要求加「少许牛奶」，这样混合物更容易搅拌。

words.enDefinition: One small stem of thyme with leaves still attached

examples.en: The ingredients included a sprig of thyme as well as a little parsley.
examples.zh: 食材里除了少量欧芹，还有「一小枝百里香」。

examples.en: I asked what a recipe meant by a sprig of thyme when measuring herbs.
examples.zh: 量香草时，我问菜谱说的「一小枝百里香」是多大一枝。

words.enDefinition: dried yeast granules used to make bread dough rise, often activated in liquid first

examples.en: I bought active dry yeast after reading the ingredients for the bread recipe.
examples.zh: 看完面包食谱的配料后，我买了「活性干酵母」。

examples.en: The bakery aisle had small packets of active dry yeast beside the flour.
examples.zh: 烘焙区在面粉旁边摆着小袋的「活性干酵母」。

collocations: a packet of active dry yeast
dissolve active dry yeast in water

words.enDefinition: order an additional dish to go with a main item

examples.en: I decided to add a side because we were sharing one sandwich after rehearsal.
examples.zh: 排练结束后我们要分吃一份三明治，我就决定「加点一份配菜」。

examples.en: Can I still add a side if the kitchen hasn't started our order yet?
examples.zh: 如果后厨还没开始做我们的餐，我还能「加点一份配菜」吗？

collocations: add a side to the order
add a side for a small charge

words.enDefinition: To request an extra item with an order already made

examples.en: We asked to add to our order after our friends arrived at the table.
examples.zh: 朋友们入座后，我们请服务员「给我们加单」。

examples.en: My flatmate wanted to add to our order before the kitchen took its final orders.
examples.zh: 厨房停止接单前，室友想请店员「给我们加单」。

collocations: ask to add to our order
want to add to our order
call the server over to add to our order

words.enDefinition: Salt put into food during preparation or processing

examples.en: The package used bold letters to state that there was no added salt.
examples.zh: 包装用粗体标出没有「添加的盐」。

examples.en: I asked whether the beans had any added salt before buying a tin.
examples.zh: 买罐头前，我问这些豆子有没有「加盐」。

words.enDefinition: to change the amount of salt, spices or other flavourings after tasting

examples.en: I stopped to adjust the seasoning before taking the soup to the table.
examples.zh: 把汤端上桌前，我停下来「调整调味」。

examples.en: We tasted the dressing together before deciding how to adjust the seasoning.
examples.zh: 我们一起尝了调味汁，才决定怎样「调整调味」。

words.enDefinition: to cook food in an appliance that circulates very hot air around it

examples.en: I decided to air-fry the potato wedges for our lunch in the flat.
examples.zh: 我决定「用空气炸锅烹调」薯角，在住处当午饭。

examples.en: The recipe says you can air-fry the vegetables instead of roasting them in a large oven.
examples.zh: 食谱说，可以「用空气炸锅烹调」蔬菜，不必用大烤箱烤。

words.enDefinition: the removable container that holds the food in an air fryer

examples.en: I let the air-fryer basket cool before removing it from the shared appliance.
examples.zh: 我等「空气炸锅炸篮」凉下来，再把它从共用的机器里取出。

examples.en: The instructions said to place the wedges in the air-fryer basket without piling them up.
examples.zh: 说明说，把薯角放进「空气炸锅炸篮」，不要堆在一起。

collocations: put food in the air-fryer basket

words.enDefinition: A container that prevents air passing through its seal

examples.en: I labelled the airtight container so my flatmates knew which rice was mine.
examples.zh: 我给「密封容器」贴了标签，这样室友就知道哪份米饭是我的。

examples.en: The airtight container was on the top shelf beside the unopened packet.
examples.zh: 「密封容器」在最上层，旁边是没开封的食品包。

collocations: an airtight container with a lid
store food in an airtight container

words.enDefinition: cooked so that it is still slightly firm to the bite, especially pasta

examples.en: I checked whether the pasta was al dente before pouring off the water.
examples.zh: 把水倒掉前，我尝了尝意面是不是「熟而有嚼劲」。

examples.en: The café served the penne al dente with a vegetable sauce on top.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆的斜管面「熟而有嚼劲」，上面浇了蔬菜酱。

words.enDefinition: A North Pacific fish with mild white flesh widely sold frozen

examples.en: I found Alaska pollock in the freezer section beside the cod.
examples.zh: 我在冷冻区找到了「狭鳕」，就在鳕鱼旁边。

examples.en: The package listed Alaska pollock as the fish inside the breaded portions.
examples.zh: 包装写明，这些裹了面包糠的鱼块用的是「狭鳕」。

words.enDefinition: a wheat flour intended for a wide range of ordinary baking and cooking uses

examples.en: I used all-purpose flour for the pancakes because the recipe called for it.
examples.zh: 食谱要求用「通用面粉」，所以我用它做了薄煎饼。

examples.en: The supermarket put all-purpose flour next to the packets of bread flour.
examples.zh: 超市把「通用面粉」摆在一袋袋面包粉旁边。

words.enDefinition: A buffet allowing diners to take repeated servings during the meal

examples.en: My flatmates picked an all-you-can-eat buffet for a meal after exams.
examples.zh: 室友们选了「不限次自助餐」，准备考完试一起吃。

examples.en: We asked whether the all-you-can-eat buffet included the nearby dessert counter.
examples.zh: 我们问「不限次自助餐」包不包括旁边的甜点柜台。

words.enDefinition: A substance that can trigger an allergic reaction

examples.en: The label highlighted the allergen in bold beside the name of the ingredient.
examples.zh: 标签在配料名称旁用粗体标出了「过敏原」。

examples.en: The dining team asked which allergen we wanted them to look up.
examples.zh: 餐厅工作人员问我们想让他们帮忙查哪一种「过敏原」。

words.enDefinition: Unintended transfer of an allergen to another food

examples.en: The menu mentioned possible allergen cross-contact in the kitchen beside the ingredient details.
examples.zh: 菜单在配料说明旁提到了厨房里可能发生的「过敏原交叉接触」。

examples.en: I asked the dining manager about allergen cross-contact before choosing a meal that day.
examples.zh: 当天选餐前，我问了餐厅经理有关「过敏原交叉接触」的事。

words.enDefinition: Identification of allergens on a food label

examples.en: I found the allergen declaration below the list of ingredients on the packet.
examples.zh: 我在包装袋的配料表下方找到了「过敏原标示」。

examples.en: The allergen declaration on the new label listed milk and soy in bold.
examples.zh: 新标签的「过敏原标示」用粗体列出了乳类和大豆。

collocations: an allergen declaration on a label

words.enDefinition: Details about allergens in a product or dish

examples.en: I looked up the allergen information before choosing a sandwich at the café.
examples.zh: 选咖啡馆的三明治前，我查了「过敏原信息」。

examples.en: The server brought a separate folder with allergen information for the dessert menu.
examples.zh: 服务员拿来一个单独的文件夹，里面是甜点菜单的「过敏原信息」。

words.enDefinition: A table matching menu items to their allergens

examples.en: I checked the allergen matrix for the soup served at the student café.
examples.zh: 我查了「菜品过敏原对照表」，看学生咖啡馆卖的汤列了哪些过敏原。

examples.en: The allergen matrix had one row for each dish and a column for milk.
examples.zh: 「菜品过敏原对照表」每行是一道菜，其中一列是乳类。

words.enDefinition: A written note flagging an allergy for staff

examples.en: The café put an allergy note on the order before sending it through.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆在把订单发过去之前，加了一条「过敏备注」。

examples.en: I checked that the allergy note included sesame before the form was submitted.
examples.zh: 表单提交前，我确认「过敏备注」里写了芝麻。

collocations: an allergy note on an order

words.enDefinition: An ingredient that comes from an animal

examples.en: I asked the server to check whether the glaze used an animal-derived ingredient.
examples.zh: 我请服务员查看外层糖衣是否用了「动物来源配料」。

examples.en: The guide listed gelatin as an example of an animal-derived ingredient on food labels.
examples.zh: 指南把明胶列为食品标签上「动物来源配料」的一个例子。

collocations: an animal-derived ingredient in a recipe

words.enDefinition: Enzymes from animals used to make milk set

examples.en: I asked whether the cheese in the sandwich was made with animal rennet.
examples.zh: 我问三明治里的奶酪是不是用「动物凝乳酶」做的。

examples.en: The menu note identified the cheeses that the supplier made using animal rennet.
examples.zh: 菜单注释标出了供应商用「动物凝乳酶」制作的几种奶酪。

words.enDefinition: A question offering to add something to a customer's order

examples.en: The server asked, "Anything else for you?" after taking our lunch orders.
examples.zh: 服务员记下午餐的点单后问「您还需要点什么吗？」

examples.en: After hearing "Anything else for you?" I ordered some bread for the table.
examples.zh: 听到「您还需要点什么吗？」我给全桌人又点了些面包。

collocations: finish taking an order with "Anything else for you?"

words.enDefinition: A small dish eaten before the main part of a meal

examples.en: We split one appetizer before our rice dishes came out.
examples.zh: 米饭套餐端上来之前，我们分吃了一道「餐前小菜」。

examples.en: The server asked whether we wanted an appetizer to share.
examples.zh: 服务员问我们要不要点一道「餐前小菜」一起吃。

words.enDefinition: A round fruit with firm flesh and thin skin

examples.en: I put an apple in my bag to eat after the afternoon lecture.
examples.zh: 我把一个「苹果」放进包里，准备下午的讲座结束后吃。

examples.en: The shop had three kinds of apple on the shelf near the door.
examples.zh: 店门旁的货架上摆了三种「苹果」。

words.enDefinition: vinegar made by fermenting liquid from apples

examples.en: I used apple cider vinegar in the dressing for the shredded cabbage.
examples.zh: 我用「苹果醋」给切丝的卷心菜调酱汁。

examples.en: The bottle of apple cider vinegar was stored with the oils and sauces.
examples.zh: 那瓶「苹果醋」和油、酱汁放在一起。

collocations: a bottle of apple cider vinegar

words.enDefinition: A tool that removes the central part of an apple

examples.en: The shared kitchen had an apple corer beside the fruit bowl.
examples.zh: 共用厨房的水果碗旁边有一个「苹果去核器」。

examples.en: My roommate asked whether the apple corer would fit the smaller apples.
examples.zh: 室友问「苹果去核器」适不适合这些较小的苹果。

words.enDefinition: A small stone fruit with yellow-orange skin

examples.en: I found a fresh apricot in the box marked with the farm's name.
examples.zh: 我在标有农场名称的箱子里找到一个新鲜的「杏」。

examples.en: The stallholder said each apricot in the small tray was from the same orchard.
examples.zh: 摊主说，小托盘里的每个「杏」都来自同一个果园。

words.enDefinition: A leafy green with a noticeably peppery taste

examples.en: I found arugula in small bags beside the spinach at the campus supermarket.
examples.zh: 我在学校附近超市的菠菜旁找到了小袋装的「芝麻菜」。

examples.en: My flatmate asked for arugula because she wanted a more peppery salad.
examples.zh: 室友想让沙拉多一点辛辣味，就让我买「芝麻菜」。

words.enDefinition: A crisp, juicy pear often shaped like an apple

examples.en: The shop displayed an Asian pear beside an apple to show how similar they look.
examples.zh: 店里把一个「亚洲梨」摆在苹果旁边，展示它们有多相像。

examples.en: The sign described the Asian pear as crisp and showed its round shape.
examples.zh: 标签说「亚洲梨」口感脆，还展示了它圆圆的形状。

words.enDefinition: Long tender shoots sold as a vegetable

examples.en: I found asparagus in small bundles beside the green beans at the market.
examples.zh: 我在市场的四季豆旁找到了一小把一小把的「芦笋」。

examples.en: The asparagus at that stall came from a farm a few miles away.
examples.zh: 那个摊位的「芦笋」来自几英里外的一家农场。

words.enDefinition: A species of salmon commonly sold from farmed sources

examples.en: The label said Atlantic salmon in small letters beneath the main price.
examples.zh: 标签在大号价格下方用小字写着「大西洋鲑」。

examples.en: We asked which tray held the Atlantic salmon advertised by the store.
examples.zh: 我们问哪只托盘里装着商店宣传的「大西洋鲑」。

words.enDefinition: A table that is open for customers to sit at

examples.en: We asked about an available table because our lecture had ended early.
examples.zh: 我们的课提前结束了，就问餐厅有没有「空桌」。

examples.en: The host saw an available table behind the group waiting for dessert.
examples.zh: 迎宾员发现，等甜点的那群客人身后有一张「空桌」。

collocations: an available table near the door

words.enDefinition: A fruit with creamy flesh and one large seed

examples.en: I bought an avocado to take with my lunch after the morning seminar.
examples.zh: 我买了一个「牛油果」，准备上午的研讨课结束后配午饭吃。

examples.en: My roommate wanted an avocado for that evening, so I chose a softer one.
examples.zh: 室友想当晚吃「牛油果」，所以我挑了一个软一点的。

words.enDefinition: Out of a place where sunlight shines directly

examples.en: The carton said to keep it away from direct sunlight once it was opened.
examples.zh: 纸盒写明，开封后要「避免阳光直射」。

examples.en: I found away from direct sunlight in the small print beneath the barcode.
examples.zh: 我在条形码下面的小字里找到了「避免阳光直射」。

words.enDefinition: Short, curved pork ribs cut from close to the backbone

examples.en: The shop sold baby back ribs by the rack rather than in single pieces.
examples.zh: 店里的「猪背肋排」整扇卖，不能单根买。

examples.en: We checked whether the baby back ribs would fit in our small oven.
examples.zh: 我们看了一下「猪背肋排」能不能放进我们的小烤箱。

collocations: a rack of baby back ribs
a half rack of baby back ribs

words.enDefinition: Bacon cut mainly from the loin of a pig

examples.en: The British supermarket had back bacon next to the streaky kind.
examples.zh: 这家英国超市把「猪背培根」摆在五花培根旁边。

examples.en: I bought back bacon for the breakfast my housemate wanted to make.
examples.zh: 室友想做早餐，我就买了「猪背培根」。

words.enDefinition: Thin slices of bacon, especially in British and Irish retail usage

examples.en: The local shop sold six bacon rashers in a small pack.
examples.zh: 附近的店把六片「薄片培根」装成一个小包装出售。

examples.en: I compared two packs of bacon rashers with different prices and weights.
examples.zh: 我比较了两盒价格和重量都不同的「薄片培根」。

words.enDefinition: Salad leaves sold together in a bag

examples.en: I picked up a bagged salad to share with my flatmates after our lecture.
examples.zh: 我买了一份「袋装沙拉菜」，准备下课后和室友一起吃。

examples.en: The bagged salad is on the top shelf of the refrigerated display near the entrance.
examples.zh: 「袋装沙拉菜」在入口附近冷藏展示柜的最上层。

words.enDefinition: a dry mixture that releases gas to help dough or batter rise

examples.en: I checked that the baking powder was in the cupboard before making muffins.
examples.zh: 做松饼前，我先确认柜子里有「泡打粉」。

examples.en: The recipe lists baking powder separately from flour and the other dry ingredients.
examples.zh: 食谱把「泡打粉」和面粉等其他干料分开列出。

words.enDefinition: sodium bicarbonate used in cooking, including to help baked mixtures rise

examples.en: I used baking soda in the biscuits because the recipe contained buttermilk.
examples.zh: 食谱里的饼干含酪乳，我按要求用了「小苏打」。

examples.en: The supermarket kept baking soda on the shelf just below baking powder.
examples.zh: 超市把「小苏打」放在泡打粉下方那层货架。

collocations: add baking soda to the mixture

words.enDefinition: A whisk with wide loops that can incorporate air into mixtures

examples.en: The balloon whisk was too big for our smallest mixing bowl.
examples.zh: 「球形打蛋器」太大，放不进我们最小的搅拌碗。

examples.en: I chose a balloon whisk from the tools beside the recipe.
examples.zh: 我从菜谱旁边的用具里挑了一个「球形打蛋器」。

words.enDefinition: A long curved fruit with soft flesh

examples.en: I bought a banana to eat on the bus after my morning class.
examples.zh: 我买了一根「香蕉」，打算上完早课在公交车上吃。

examples.en: The bananas by the window were greener than the ones near the checkout.
examples.zh: 窗边的「香蕉」比收银台旁的还要青一些。

words.enDefinition: Barley allowed to sprout and then dried

examples.en: The cereal box listed barley malt after the first three ingredients on its label.
examples.zh: 谷物食品盒上的标签在前三项配料后列出了「大麦麦芽」。

examples.en: My flatmate spotted barley malt on one cracker packet but not the other.
examples.zh: 室友在一包饼干上看到了「大麦麦芽」，另一包上没有。

words.enDefinition: An aromatic herb with soft, fragrant leaves

examples.en: I found basil in little pots on the shelf just above the chilled herbs.
examples.zh: 我在冷藏香草上方的货架找到了小盆栽的「罗勒」。

examples.en: The bag of basil on the lowest shelf had smaller leaves than expected.
examples.zh: 最下面一层的那袋「罗勒」，叶子比我想的小。

words.enDefinition: a variety of long-grain rice with a distinctive aroma

examples.en: I served basmati rice with the lentil dish we made on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 周二我们做了扁豆菜，配的是「巴斯马蒂香米」。

examples.en: The supermarket sells small bags of basmati rice beside the larger sacks.
examples.zh: 超市把小袋装的「巴斯马蒂香米」摆在大袋装的旁边。

words.enDefinition: to spoon or brush fat or liquid over food during cooking

examples.en: The chef stopped to baste the roast before returning it to the oven.
examples.zh: 厨师先「将油汁浇在烤肉上」，再把肉送回烤箱。

examples.en: I saw my flatmate baste the vegetables with oil from the tray.
examples.zh: 我看到室友把「烤盘里的油浇在蔬菜上」。

words.enDefinition: A label code identifying one production batch

examples.en: I wrote down the batch code from the bottom of the tin.
examples.zh: 我记下了罐底的「批次编码」。

examples.en: The store asked for the batch code when I reported a problem with the lid.
examples.zh: 我反映盖子有问题时，商店要我提供「批次编码」。

words.enDefinition: making a large amount of food at once for several later meals

examples.en: We tried batch cooking on Sunday so weekdays would be less rushed.
examples.zh: 周日我们试了「批量烹调」，这样工作日就不用那么赶。

examples.en: The shared kitchen had enough space for batch cooking with two large pots.
examples.zh: 共用厨房空间足够，能用两个大锅「批量烹调」。

words.enDefinition: To mix ingredients briefly with small, quick movements

examples.en: The recipe says to beat lightly until you can no longer see streaks.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，要「轻轻搅打」，直到看不出颜色深浅不同的条纹。

examples.en: We checked whether the recipe said to beat lightly or whisk vigorously.
examples.zh: 我们核对了菜谱说的是「轻轻搅打」还是用力搅打。

words.enDefinition: Beef from the shoulder area near the front of the animal

examples.en: The butcher labeled the cut as beef chuck on the display card.
examples.zh: 肉柜店员在柜台标签上把这块肉标作「牛肩肉」。

examples.en: I asked for beef chuck because our recipe mentioned the shoulder cut.
examples.zh: 菜谱提到要用肩部的肉，所以我问有没有「牛肩肉」。

words.enDefinition: Thin pieces of seasoned beef dried to make a chewy snack

examples.en: My friend bought beef jerky for the train ride back to campus.
examples.zh: 朋友买了「牛肉干」，准备坐火车回学校时吃。

examples.en: The shop displayed beef jerky beside the other savory snack packs.
examples.zh: 店里把「牛肉干」摆在其他咸味小吃旁边。

words.enDefinition: The liver of cattle sold as food

examples.en: The market sold beef liver in smaller packs than our local supermarket.
examples.zh: 市场的「牛肝」比我们附近超市卖的规格更小。

examples.en: I asked whether the label on the beef liver listed the net weight.
examples.zh: 我问「牛肝」的标签上有没有写净重。

words.enDefinition: A cut of beef from the lower leg of the animal

examples.en: I saw pieces of beef shank with bone and others without it.
examples.zh: 我看到有的「牛腱肉」带骨，有的不带骨。

examples.en: The shop labeled its beef shank with both the weight and total price.
examples.zh: 店里在「牛腱肉」的标签上注明了重量与总价。

words.enDefinition: Beef rib cuts containing strips of meat and sections of rib bone

examples.en: My flatmates shared the cost of the beef short ribs for our weekend dinner.
examples.zh: 我们周末一起吃饭，室友们平摊了「牛小排」的钱。

examples.en: The butcher wrapped the beef short ribs before handing them across the counter.
examples.zh: 肉柜店员把「牛小排」包好后，从柜台递给了我。

collocations: a pack of beef short ribs

words.enDefinition: The tender, narrow muscle running along the inside of the beef loin

examples.en: I asked where the beef tenderloin was displayed at the butcher's counter.
examples.zh: 我问肉柜把「牛里脊」摆在什么位置。

examples.en: The beef tenderloin was too expensive for our usual weekly grocery budget.
examples.zh: 「牛里脊」价格太高，超出了我们平常每周的买菜预算。

words.enDefinition: A flexible wax-coated cloth used to wrap food

examples.en: I saw beeswax wrap beside the sandwich bags at the student market.
examples.zh: 我在学生市集的三明治袋旁看到了「蜂蜡保鲜布」。

examples.en: My roommate used a piece of beeswax wrap to cover the bread for lunch.
examples.zh: 室友用一块「蜂蜡保鲜布」把午餐的面包包起来了。

words.enDefinition: An edible beet root usually deep red in colour

examples.en: I asked whether the beetroot on display was sold loose or by the bunch.
examples.zh: 我问摆出来的「甜菜根」是散卖还是成把卖。

examples.en: I chose three small beetroots from the box near the market stall's wooden scale.
examples.zh: 我从摊位木秤边的箱子里挑了三个小「甜菜根」。

words.enDefinition: A large mild pepper with crisp hollow flesh

examples.en: I bought one red bell pepper from the crate under the shelf.
examples.zh: 我从货架下面的箱子里买了一个红色「甜椒」。

examples.en: The shop sold each bell pepper separately, so I didn't need a whole pack.
examples.zh: 店里「甜椒」按个卖，我不用买整包。

words.enDefinition: A flat tool used to divide dough or clear a worktop

examples.en: The tutor left a bench scraper beside the dough for each group.
examples.zh: 老师在每组的面团旁边放了一个「面团刮板」。

examples.en: I borrowed a bench scraper to move the pieces onto the tray.
examples.zh: 我借了个「面团刮板」，把这些小块移到托盘上。

collocations: divide dough with a bench scraper

words.enDefinition: A label date indicating expected best food quality

examples.en: The best-before date was printed on the lid of the oats I bought.
examples.zh: 我买的燕麦在盖子上印了「最佳食用品质日期」。

examples.en: I checked the best-before date because two similar bags had different labels.
examples.zh: 两袋食品看起来相似但标签不同，所以我看了「最佳食用品质日期」。

collocations: a best-before date on the lid

words.enDefinition: beans with a black outer skin, especially common in Latin American cooking

examples.en: I added black beans to the rice bowls we packed for lunch.
examples.zh: 我往午饭的饭盒里加了「黑芸豆」配米饭。

examples.en: The shop has black beans in both cans and bags of dried beans.
examples.zh: 店里的「黑芸豆」有罐装，也有袋装干豆。

words.enDefinition: A dark soft berry made of many tiny parts

examples.en: The blackberries looked dark and glossy in the market stall's smallest boxes that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上，摊位小盒里的「黑莓」乌黑发亮。

examples.en: I chose blackberries instead of a bag of apples for the group picnic.
examples.zh: 我给小组野餐买了「黑莓」，没买那袋苹果。

words.enDefinition: to cook something briefly in boiling water, often followed by cooling

examples.en: The recipe says to blanch the beans before adding them to the salad.
examples.zh: 食谱说，先把豆角「短时焯水」，再加进沙拉。

examples.en: In the class, we watched the cook blanch vegetables for a cold dish.
examples.zh: 课上，我们看厨师为做凉菜而把蔬菜「短时焯水」。

words.enDefinition: to bake a pastry case before putting its filling into it

examples.en: I needed to blind bake the pastry case before adding the lemon filling.
examples.zh: 加柠檬馅前，我需要先「空烤派皮」。

examples.en: The instructor showed us how to blind bake a tart shell in class.
examples.zh: 讲师在课堂上示范了怎样「空烤派皮」。

words.enDefinition: cheese sold as a solid block rather than sliced or shredded

examples.en: I bought block cheese so I could cut thick slices for the sandwiches.
examples.zh: 我买了「整块奶酪」，这样能切厚片夹三明治。

examples.en: The chilled shelf had block cheese alongside packets of ready-cut slices.
examples.zh: 冷藏货架上有「整块奶酪」，旁边还有切好片的袋装奶酪。

collocations: cut a piece of block cheese

words.enDefinition: An orange with red or reddish flesh

examples.en: The sign showed what a blood orange looked like after it was cut open.
examples.zh: 标签上展示了「血橙」切开后的样子。

examples.en: I bought a blood orange because my flatmate wanted to try the red variety.
examples.zh: 室友想尝尝红色果肉的品种，我就买了一个「血橙」。

words.enDefinition: cheese with blue or green veins of mould and a distinctive strong flavour

examples.en: The cheese plate included blue cheese and two kinds I recognized immediately.
examples.zh: 奶酪拼盘里有「蓝纹奶酪」，还有两种我一下就认出来的奶酪。

examples.en: I added a little blue cheese to the dressing for our salad.
examples.zh: 我往沙拉酱里加了一点「蓝纹奶酪」。

words.enDefinition: A small round fruit with blue-purple skin

examples.en: The shop had two sizes of blueberries in the chilled display beside the grapes.
examples.zh: 葡萄旁的冷藏柜里有两种规格的「蓝莓」。

examples.en: One blueberry had rolled out of the box and into my shopping bag.
examples.zh: 有一颗「蓝莓」从盒子里滚到了我的购物袋里。

words.enDefinition: to boil so vigorously that liquid or foam spills out of the container

examples.en: I took the lid off when the pasta water began to boil over.
examples.zh: 煮意面的水开始「沸腾溢出」时，我掀开了锅盖。

examples.en: My flatmate saw the milk boil over while I was setting the table.
examples.zh: 我摆餐具时，室友看到牛奶「沸腾溢出」。

collocations: watch for liquid that may boil over

words.enDefinition: A leafy cabbage with green leaves and pale stalks

examples.en: I bought bok choy on my way home from our evening group meeting.
examples.zh: 晚上小组会议结束后，我在回家路上买了「小白菜」。

examples.en: The box of bok choy was just below the shelf with the loose carrots.
examples.zh: 装「小白菜」的箱子就在散装胡萝卜货架下面。

words.enDefinition: A piece of meat sold with one or more bones attached

examples.en: The bone-in cut cost less per pound than the one beside it.
examples.zh: 「带骨肉块」每磅的价格比旁边那块肉低。

examples.en: I asked which of the trays held the bone-in cut on sale.
examples.zh: 我问打折的「带骨肉块」放在哪只托盘里。

words.enDefinition: A piece of meat sold with the bones removed

examples.en: I chose a boneless cut because I needed a small portion.
examples.zh: 我只需要一小份，所以挑了块「去骨肉块」。

examples.en: The boneless cut was wrapped separately from the other piece of meat.
examples.zh: 「去骨肉块」与另外那块肉分开包装。

words.enDefinition: To arrange for a restaurant to hold a table for you

examples.en: We agreed to book a table for the evening after our final exam.
examples.zh: 我们商量好「预订餐桌」，在最后一门课考完的那天晚上去吃饭。

examples.en: My roommate offered to book a table near the theater before the show.
examples.zh: 室友提出演出前在剧院附近「预订餐桌」。

words.enDefinition: Restaurant seating with fixed benches around or alongside a table

examples.en: We chose booth seating because it gave us more space for our bags.
examples.zh: 我们选了「卡座座位」，因为能腾出更多地方放包。

examples.en: The café had booth seating along one wall and stools near the window.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆沿一侧墙摆了「卡座座位」，靠窗放的是凳子。

words.enDefinition: A flexible tool shaped to remove mixture from inside a bowl

examples.en: I used a bowl scraper to move the dough onto the board.
examples.zh: 我用「碗用软刮板」把面团移到了板子上。

examples.en: The bowl scraper bent enough to follow the curve of our bowl.
examples.zh: 「碗用软刮板」能弯到贴合我们碗的弧度。

words.enDefinition: A box-shaped tool with different surfaces for shredding or grating

examples.en: The box grater has a different surface on each of its sides.
examples.zh: 「四方擦丝器」每一面都有不同的擦丝面。

examples.en: I borrowed a box grater from the flat next door for the cheese.
examples.zh: 我要擦奶酪，就从隔壁公寓借了一个「四方擦丝器」。

collocations: the coarse side of a box grater

words.enDefinition: an individual lunch prepared and packed in a box

examples.en: I picked up a boxed lunch before getting on the bus for our field trip.
examples.zh: 坐上实地考察的车之前，我取了份「盒装午餐」。

examples.en: The café made each boxed lunch separately and stuck the student's name on top.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆分开做每份「盒装午餐」，并把学生的名字贴在盒盖上。

words.enDefinition: to cook food slowly with a little liquid, often after browning its surface

examples.en: We planned to braise the cabbage before serving it with mashed potatoes.
examples.zh: 我们打算把卷心菜「用少量汤汁慢焖」，配土豆泥吃。

examples.en: The cook chose to braise the beans with tomatoes and vegetable stock.
examples.zh: 厨师把豆类和番茄用少量高汤「慢焖」。

words.enDefinition: A basket used to serve bread at a dining table

examples.en: The server placed the bread basket in the middle of the table.
examples.zh: 服务员把「盛面包的篮子」放在桌子中央。

examples.en: My roommate passed me the bread basket after we ordered soup.
examples.zh: 我们点过汤后，室友把「盛面包的篮子」递给了我。

words.enDefinition: wheat flour with relatively high protein content, used for making bread

examples.en: I bought bread flour to try making dough in the shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 我买了「面包粉」，想在共用厨房试着和面团。

examples.en: The bakery sells a small bag of bread flour for home baking.
examples.zh: 面包店卖小袋装「面包粉」，供大家在家烘焙。

words.enDefinition: A knife with a toothed edge designed for slicing bread

examples.en: I looked for a bread knife before our breakfast in the student kitchen.
examples.zh: 在学生厨房做早餐前，我找了找「面包刀」。

examples.en: My roommate put the bread knife next to the loaf on the board.
examples.zh: 室友把「面包刀」放在板上的面包旁边。

words.enDefinition: An outer layer made from small pieces of dried bread

examples.en: The recipe showed the breadcrumb coating in a separate shallow dish.
examples.zh: 菜谱展示了另一个浅盘里的「面包糠外层」。

examples.en: I checked whether the breadcrumb coating had already been added to the tofu.
examples.zh: 我核对了豆腐是否已经裹上「面包糠外层」。

words.enDefinition: Fish portions covered with a breadcrumb coating before cooking

examples.en: The shop offered breaded fish in a box of four portions.
examples.zh: 商店有四份一盒的「裹面包糠的鱼」。

examples.en: I checked the label to see what species the breaded fish contained.
examples.zh: 我查看标签，看看「裹面包糠的鱼」用的是哪种鱼。

words.enDefinition: To serve several dishes at roughly the same time

examples.en: We asked the server to bring the dishes out together because we were sharing everything.
examples.zh: 我们所有菜都分着吃，就请服务员「把菜一起端上来」。

examples.en: The café said it could bring the dishes out together once our friend arrived.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆说，等朋友到了就可以「把菜一起端上来」。

collocations: ask to bring the dishes out together
offer to bring the dishes out together
try to bring the dishes out together

words.enDefinition: to heat a liquid until it begins to boil

examples.en: The instructions said to bring to a boil before adding the rice.
examples.zh: 盒子上的说明是，先把水「加热至沸腾」，再放米。

examples.en: The soup recipe uses the phrase bring to a boil before the simmering step.
examples.zh: 汤的食谱在小火慢煮之前写了「加热至沸腾」。

collocations: bring to a boil over medium heat
bring to a boil while stirring

words.enDefinition: A cut of beef from the lower chest of the animal

examples.en: We saw brisket in the case next to the beef ribs.
examples.zh: 我们在冷柜里看到「牛胸肉」，就摆在牛肋排旁边。

examples.en: My neighbor asked for a smaller piece of brisket for dinner.
examples.zh: 邻居问能不能买小一点的「牛胸肉」，留着做晚饭。

words.enDefinition: A vegetable with clusters of green flower buds

examples.en: The broccoli was on a low shelf beside the crates of cauliflower.
examples.zh: 「西兰花」在一个矮货架上，旁边是装菜花的箱子。

examples.en: I chose the broccoli with a smaller head because I had limited space.
examples.zh: 因为地方有限，我挑了棵花球小一点的「西兰花」。

words.enDefinition: A seal that is no longer closed or intact

examples.en: I noticed a broken seal after lifting the lid on the carton.
examples.zh: 打开纸盒盖后，我看到了一个「破损的封口」。

examples.en: I mentioned the broken seal when I returned the container to the campus shop.
examples.zh: 我把盒子退回学校商店时，提到了「破损的封口」。

collocations: a product with a broken seal

words.enDefinition: rice from which the outer husk is removed while the bran remains

examples.en: I packed brown rice with roasted vegetables for my long day at university.
examples.zh: 那天在学校要待很久，我带了「糙米」和烤蔬菜。

examples.en: The shop had brown rice in the same aisle as oats and lentils.
examples.zh: 商店把「糙米」和燕麦、扁豆放在同一条通道。

words.enDefinition: sugar crystals containing molasses, giving them a brown colour and distinctive taste

examples.en: I bought brown sugar for the cookies we were baking for the fundraiser.
examples.zh: 我们要给募捐活动烤曲奇，我买了「含糖蜜的棕糖」。

examples.en: The recipe uses brown sugar to give the cake a deeper flavour.
examples.zh: 食谱用「含糖蜜的棕糖」让蛋糕的味道更浓。

words.enDefinition: to cook meat until its outside turns brown, often before another cooking step

examples.en: The recipe asks us to brown the meat before adding the other ingredients.
examples.zh: 食谱要求先「把肉表面煎上色」，再加其他配料。

examples.en: My flatmate offered to brown the meat while I chopped the carrots.
examples.zh: 室友主动帮我「把肉表面煎上色」，我来切胡萝卜。

collocations: brown the meat on all sides

words.enDefinition: Marked or damaged by being bumped or pressed

examples.en: I put back the bruised apple and chose one from the other side.
examples.zh: 我放回那个「碰伤的」苹果，从另一边选了一个。

examples.en: Several peaches were bruised on the side where they touched the wooden box.
examples.zh: 有几个桃子在碰着木箱的一侧「有碰伤」。

words.enDefinition: Small green buds that look like tiny cabbages

examples.en: The shop sold Brussels sprouts loose and left a small basket beside the scale.
examples.zh: 店里散卖「抱子甘蓝」，秤旁还放了个小筐。

examples.en: I picked up Brussels sprouts for my flatmate while we shopped for weekend dinner.
examples.zh: 给周末晚饭买菜时，我帮室友拿了些「抱子甘蓝」。

words.enDefinition: A lid that curves outward abnormally

examples.en: I showed the volunteer the bulging lid on a jar in the delivery box.
examples.zh: 我把送货箱里一只罐子上「鼓起的盖子」指给志愿者看。

examples.en: The shop assistant took away the tub with a bulging lid from the shelf.
examples.zh: 店员把有「鼓起的盖子」的那个盒子从货架上拿走了。

collocations: a jar with a bulging lid

words.enDefinition: wheat grains that have been partly cooked, dried and cracked into small pieces

examples.en: I used bulgur in the salad we took to the student society picnic.
examples.zh: 我用「碎蒸小麦」做了沙拉，带去参加学生社团野餐。

examples.en: The grocery shop stocks bulgur next to the bags of rice and lentils.
examples.zh: 杂货店把「碎蒸小麦」放在袋装米和扁豆旁边。

words.enDefinition: Several bananas still joined at the stem

examples.en: I bought a small bunch of bananas on my way back from class.
examples.zh: 我下课回家路上买了「一小串香蕉」。

examples.en: My roommate asked me to choose a bunch of bananas with some green left.
examples.zh: 室友让我选「一串还带点绿色的香蕉」。

words.enDefinition: A shop area where customers select and buy cuts of meat

examples.en: I went to the butcher's counter to ask about smaller portions.
examples.zh: 我去了「肉柜」，询问有没有小份的肉。

examples.en: The butcher's counter was still open when I arrived after my lecture.
examples.zh: 我下课后到店时，「肉柜」还在营业。

words.enDefinition: a tangy milk product used in baking and cooking, often made by culturing milk

examples.en: I added buttermilk to the batter for the pancakes we made on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六做薄煎饼时，我往面糊里加了「酪乳」。

examples.en: The small shop stocked buttermilk beside the cream and other baking ingredients.
examples.zh: 小店把「酪乳」和奶油等烘焙食材放在一起卖。

words.enDefinition: A tan squash with a bulbous base and orange flesh

examples.en: I chose a small butternut squash that would fit in our shared fridge.
examples.zh: 我挑了一个较小的「奶油南瓜」，能放进我们的共用冰箱。

examples.en: The seller showed me a cut butternut squash with bright orange flesh inside.
examples.zh: 摊主给我看了一个切开的「奶油南瓜」，里面的果肉是鲜橙色的。

words.enDefinition: A leafy vegetable usually forming a dense round head

examples.en: I bought half a cabbage because a whole head was too much for me.
examples.zh: 一整棵太多，我就买了半棵「卷心菜」。

examples.en: The cabbage in the lower crate had tighter leaves than the one on display.
examples.zh: 下面箱子里的「卷心菜」比展台上的那棵叶片更紧实。

words.enDefinition: A flat container for carrying dishes through a self-service dining area

examples.en: I picked up a cafeteria tray before joining the lunch line.
examples.zh: 进午餐队伍前，我拿了一个「食堂托盘」。

examples.en: My cafeteria tray held a bowl, a plate, and two cups.
examples.zh: 我的「食堂托盘」放着一只碗、一个盘子和两个杯子。

words.enDefinition: eggs from hens housed without cages, which may be indoors

examples.en: The label marks these as cage-free eggs and shows a barn on the front.
examples.zh: 标签注明这些是「非笼养鸡蛋」，正面还画了一座鸡舍。

examples.en: I compared the price of cage-free eggs with the smaller box beside them.
examples.zh: 我把「非笼养鸡蛋」的价格和旁边小盒装鸡蛋的价格作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a fine wheat flour with relatively low protein, used for tender cakes

examples.en: The cake flour was kept beside the larger bags of standard flour.
examples.zh: 「蛋糕粉」就放在大袋的普通面粉旁边。

examples.en: The recipe uses cake flour to give the sponge a softer texture.
examples.zh: 食谱用「蛋糕粉」让海绵蛋糕的口感更松软。

collocations: use cake flour for a sponge

words.enDefinition: asks someone to make the call using the app's phone feature

examples.en: Please call me through the app when you arrive at the sports centre entrance.
examples.zh: 你到了体育中心入口后，「请通过应用给我打电话」。

examples.en: You can call me through the app if the residence gate is closed tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚宿舍大门如果关了，你可以「通过应用给我打电话」。

collocations: please call me through the app
you can call me through the app
call me through the app if you get lost

words.enDefinition: A university facility where students can eat meals on campus

examples.en: We met at the campus dining hall between our afternoon classes.
examples.zh: 我们在两节下午课之间到「校园食堂」碰面。

examples.en: The campus dining hall offered a separate line for soup and sandwiches.
examples.zh: 「校园食堂」给汤和三明治设了单独的排队通道。

collocations: eat at the campus dining hall
meet at the campus dining hall

words.expression: can I cancel before they start cooking
words.lemma: can i cancel before they start cooking
words.zhGloss: 还没开始做餐能取消吗
words.enDefinition: asks whether cancellation is possible before food preparation starts
acceptedZhAnswers: 还没开始做餐能取消吗
acceptedEnVariants: can I cancel before they start cooking

examples.en: Can I cancel before they start cooking because I accidentally ordered from another branch?
examples.zh: 我误选了另一家分店，「还没开始做餐能取消吗」？

examples.en: Can I cancel before they start cooking if my flatmate has already bought dinner?
examples.zh: 如果我室友已经买了晚饭，「还没开始做餐能取消吗」？

collocations: can I cancel before they start cooking my food?
can I cancel before they start cooking the new order?
since I ordered twice, can I cancel before they start cooking?

words.enDefinition: A polite question asking to exchange the included side dish

examples.en: I asked, "Can I swap the side?" because I wanted rice with the fish.
examples.zh: 我想用米饭配鱼，就问「我可以换一道配菜吗？」

examples.en: My friend asked, "Can I swap the side?" when the server mentioned the fries.
examples.zh: 服务员说配薯条时，朋友问「我可以换一道配菜吗？」

collocations: say "Can I swap the side for rice?"
ask "Can I swap the side, please?"

words.expression: can I switch from delivery to pickup
words.lemma: can i switch from delivery to pickup
words.zhGloss: 我能把外送改成自提吗
words.enDefinition: asks to collect a food order originally booked for delivery
acceptedZhAnswers: 我能把外送改成自提吗
acceptedEnVariants: can I switch from delivery to pickup

examples.en: Can I switch from delivery to pickup now that I'm near the café anyway?
examples.zh: 既然我已经在咖啡馆附近，「我能把外送改成自提吗」？

examples.en: Can I switch from delivery to pickup if the driver hasn't collected the food?
examples.zh: 如果配送员还没取餐，「我能把外送改成自提吗」？

collocations: can I switch from delivery to pickup today?
can I switch from delivery to pickup before it's ready?
since I'm nearby, can I switch from delivery to pickup?

words.expression: can the restaurant still change my order
words.lemma: can the restaurant still change my order
words.zhGloss: 餐厅还能改我的订单吗
words.enDefinition: asks whether the food order can still be altered
acceptedZhAnswers: 餐厅还能改我的订单吗
acceptedEnVariants: can the restaurant still change my order

examples.en: Can the restaurant still change my order if the sandwiches haven't been made yet?
examples.zh: 如果三明治还没做，「餐厅还能改我的订单吗」？

examples.en: Can the restaurant still change my order to two bowls of soup instead of one?
examples.zh: 「餐厅还能改我的订单吗」？我想把一碗汤改成两碗。

collocations: can the restaurant still change my order now?
can the restaurant still change my order before the driver gets it?
if it's early enough, can the restaurant still change my order?

words.zhGloss: 能帮我们核对一下点单吗
words.enDefinition: A polite request for staff to verify the restaurant order
acceptedZhAnswers: 能帮我们核对一下点单吗

examples.en: I asked, "Can you check our order?" when we received two bowls instead of three.
examples.zh: 我们点了三碗，只端来两碗时，我问「能帮我们核对一下点单吗？」

examples.en: My roommate said, "Can you check our order?" before the server left our table.
examples.zh: 服务员离开桌边前，室友问「能帮我们核对一下点单吗？」

collocations: say "Can you check our order, please?"
ask "Can you check our order for the soup?"

words.enDefinition: asks the restaurant to keep prepared food warm until collection

examples.en: Can you keep it warm until I get there after my last lecture ends?
examples.zh: 「能先帮我把餐保温吗」？我最后一节课上完就过去。

examples.en: Can you keep it warm while my flatmate walks over from the student centre?
examples.zh: 我室友正从学生中心走过去，「能先帮我把餐保温吗」？

collocations: can you keep it warm until I get there?
can you keep it warm for pickup?
while I walk over, can you keep it warm?

words.enDefinition: Asking if a dish can omit an ingredient

examples.en: Can you make it without butter, or is the sauce already prepared?
examples.zh: 「可以不放黄油做吗」，还是酱汁已经调好了？

examples.en: Can you make it without sesame oil for the group meal this evening?
examples.zh: 今晚聚餐的这道菜，「可以不放芝麻油做吗」？

collocations: can you make it without butter
can you make it without eggs
can you make it without sesame

words.expression: can you refund the missing item
words.lemma: can you refund the missing item
words.zhGloss: 能退还漏送餐品的钱吗
words.enDefinition: asks for a refund covering the food that was not delivered
acceptedZhAnswers: 能退还漏送餐品的钱吗
acceptedEnVariants: can you refund the missing item

examples.en: Can you refund the missing item since I need to leave for class shortly?
examples.zh: 我一会儿要去上课，「能退还漏送餐品的钱吗」？

examples.en: Can you refund the missing item from tonight's order for our study group dinner?
examples.zh: 我们学习小组今晚下的那单，「能退还漏送餐品的钱吗」？

collocations: can you refund the missing item from my order?
can you refund the missing item instead?
if that's easier, can you refund the missing item?

words.expression: can you send me a pin
words.lemma: can you send me a pin
words.zhGloss: 你能发个地图定位给我吗
words.enDefinition: asks somebody to share a marked location on a map
acceptedZhAnswers: 你能发个地图定位给我吗
acceptedEnVariants: can you send me a pin

examples.en: Can you send me a pin for the entrance so I can find your building?
examples.zh: 「你能发个入口的地图定位给我吗」？我好找到你那栋楼。

examples.en: Can you send me a pin in the chat while I wait by the road?
examples.zh: 我在路边等着，「你能在聊天里发个地图定位给我吗」？

collocations: can you send me a pin for the entrance?
can you send me a pin in the chat?
if possible, can you send me a pin?

words.enDefinition: beans cooked or preserved in a sealed can

examples.en: I used canned beans for the salad because I had very little time.
examples.zh: 我时间不多，就用「罐装豆类」做沙拉。

examples.en: My flatmate put canned beans on the list alongside rice and tomato paste.
examples.zh: 室友把「罐装豆类」、米和浓缩番茄膏一起写进了购物清单。

words.enDefinition: food packed and preserved in sealed cans

examples.en: I bought a few canned goods before the campus shop closed for break.
examples.zh: 校内商店放假关门前，我买了几样「罐装食品」。

examples.en: The donation box accepted canned goods such as beans, vegetables and soup.
examples.zh: 捐赠箱接收豆类、蔬菜和汤等「罐装食品」。

words.enDefinition: tomatoes preserved in cans, available whole, chopped or crushed

examples.en: I used canned tomatoes in the sauce we made for our pasta.
examples.zh: 我们给意面做酱汁时，我用了「罐装番茄」。

examples.en: The shop sells canned tomatoes in both whole and chopped varieties.
examples.zh: 商店的「罐装番茄」有整颗和切碎两种。

collocations: add canned tomatoes to a sauce

words.enDefinition: A melon usually with orange flesh and a netted rind

examples.en: The cantaloupe had a rough skin, unlike the smooth melon beside it.
examples.zh: 这个「橙肉甜瓜」的皮是粗糙的，旁边那个瓜的皮却很光滑。

examples.en: I bought half a cantaloupe because a whole one wouldn't fit in our fridge.
examples.zh: 我买了半个「橙肉甜瓜」，因为整个放不进我们的冰箱。

words.enDefinition: to cook onions until they become sweet and deep golden brown

examples.en: I began to caramelize the onions for our sandwiches while the bread warmed.
examples.zh: 面包加热时，我开始「把洋葱炒到焦糖色」，准备夹三明治。

examples.en: The recipe says to caramelize the onions before stirring them into the lentils.
examples.zh: 食谱说，先「把洋葱炒到焦糖色」，再拌进扁豆里。

collocations: caramelize the onions for a topping

words.enDefinition: A root vegetable that is commonly orange

examples.en: I added one carrot to the bag after checking how much I needed.
examples.zh: 确认需要多少之后，我往袋子里加了一根「胡萝卜」。

examples.en: The carrots with green tops were on the top shelf beside the onions.
examples.zh: 带着绿叶的「胡萝卜」放在最上层，就在洋葱旁边。

words.enDefinition: continued cooking caused by heat already present in food after the heat source is removed

examples.en: The instructor used a roasted vegetable to demonstrate how carryover cooking changes the texture.
examples.zh: 老师用烤蔬菜示范了「离火后继续熟化」会怎样改变口感。

examples.en: I read about carryover cooking while comparing two recipes for the same roast.
examples.zh: 我比较同一道烤菜的两份食谱时，读到了「离火后继续熟化」。

collocations: carryover cooking after removing food from heat

words.enDefinition: A protein found naturally in milk

examples.en: I found casein on the label while checking the ingredients for our group lunch.
examples.zh: 我为小组午餐查配料时，在标签上看到了「酪蛋白」。

examples.en: The class handout identified casein as one of the proteins found in milk.
examples.zh: 课堂讲义介绍，「酪蛋白」是乳类中所含的蛋白质之一。

words.enDefinition: fine-grained white sugar that dissolves more readily than regular granulated sugar

examples.en: I used caster sugar in the cake because it mixes in easily.
examples.zh: 我往蛋糕里用了「细粒白砂糖」，因为它容易拌匀。

examples.en: The recipe called for caster sugar and a little lemon zest.
examples.zh: 食谱里要用「细粒白砂糖」和一点柠檬皮屑。

words.enDefinition: A fish with whisker-like barbels, often sold in fillets

examples.en: The market card said catfish beside the tray of large fillets.
examples.zh: 那盘大块鱼柳旁边的市场标签上写着「鲶鱼」。

examples.en: I had catfish on my list for a recipe from home.
examples.zh: 我想做一道家里的菜，购物清单上有「鲶鱼」。

words.enDefinition: A vegetable with a dense head of flower buds

examples.en: I bought a small cauliflower because our fridge already had plenty of vegetables.
examples.zh: 我们冰箱里已经有不少蔬菜了，我就买了棵小「菜花」。

examples.en: The cauliflower was wrapped in its outer leaves when the seller handed it over.
examples.zh: 摊主递过来时，「菜花」还裹着它外层的叶子。

words.enDefinition: A vegetable with long, crisp, edible stalks

examples.en: I bought celery from a stall just outside the station on my way home.
examples.zh: 我回家路上在车站外的摊位买了「芹菜」。

examples.en: The celery was tied in large bunches, so I shared one with my roommate.
examples.zh: 「芹菜」扎成了大把，我就和室友分了一把。

words.enDefinition: To alter details of a booking already made with a restaurant

examples.en: I called to change a reservation after another classmate decided to join us.
examples.zh: 又有一位同学决定加入之后，我打电话「修改订位」。

examples.en: The host told me whom to contact to change a reservation for tonight.
examples.zh: 迎宾员告诉我，今晚的餐要找谁「修改订位」。

words.enDefinition: To move from one restaurant table to another during a visit

examples.en: We asked to change tables because the speaker above us was loud.
examples.zh: 我们头顶的音响太响，就问能不能「换桌」。

examples.en: The host said we could change tables once the group beside us left.
examples.zh: 迎宾员说，等旁边一桌客人离开后我们可以「换桌」。

collocations: offer to let guests change tables

words.enDefinition: to expose something to strong heat so part of its surface turns black

examples.en: The cook used the grill to char the outside of the sweet peppers.
examples.zh: 厨师用烤架「使甜椒表面焦黑」。

examples.en: The high heat can char the edges before the centre has softened.
examples.zh: 热量很高时，会在中心还没软之前「使边缘焦黑」。

words.enDefinition: the outer edges of food that have darkened or blackened from strong heat

examples.en: I liked the charred edges on the peppers we grilled for the sandwiches.
examples.zh: 我喜欢夹三明治的烤甜椒上「焦黑的边缘」。

examples.en: The vegetables had charred edges while their centres stayed soft and sweet.
examples.zh: 这些蔬菜的「边缘焦黑」，里面还是软甜的。

words.enDefinition: To find out whether an ordered dish is ready or pending

examples.en: The server offered to check on a dish that had not arrived yet.
examples.zh: 服务员主动提出帮我们「问一道菜好了没」，那道菜还未上桌。

examples.en: I asked whether someone could check on a dish for my friend.
examples.zh: 我问能否请人帮朋友「问一道菜好了没」。

collocations: ask the kitchen to check on a dish
offer to check on a dish
check on a dish that hasn’t arrived

words.enDefinition: To ask kitchen staff to verify something

examples.en: Could you check with the kitchen whether the dressing contains any sesame oil?
examples.zh: 能请你「向厨房核实」一下沙拉酱里有没有芝麻油吗？

examples.en: I asked the server to check with the kitchen rather than guess about the sauce.
examples.zh: 我请服务员「向厨房核实」酱汁的配料。

collocations: ask someone to check with the kitchen
go and check with the kitchen
check with the kitchen about an ingredient

words.enDefinition: a firm cheese originally from England, sold in mild and stronger varieties

examples.en: I sliced some cheddar for the sandwiches we packed before our trip.
examples.zh: 出门前准备三明治时，我切了几片「切达奶酪」。

examples.en: The café uses cheddar in its toasted sandwiches with tomato and onion.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆的烤三明治夹了「切达奶酪」、番茄和洋葱。

words.enDefinition: the outer layer that forms or is added to some cheeses

examples.en: The deli worker told me which part was the cheese rind on that wedge.
examples.zh: 熟食柜台店员告诉我，那块奶酪哪部分是「奶酪外皮」。

examples.en: I removed the cheese rind before grating the rest into the sauce.
examples.zh: 我先去掉「奶酪外皮」，再把其余部分磨碎拌到酱里。

words.enDefinition: a piece of cheese in a triangular shape cut from a larger piece

examples.en: I chose a small cheese wedge for the picnic because there were only three of us.
examples.zh: 去野餐的只有我们三个人，所以我选了个小「楔形奶酪块」。

examples.en: The deli wrapped the cheese wedge in paper so it would fit in my bag.
examples.zh: 熟食柜台用纸包好「楔形奶酪块」，这样能放进我的包。

words.enDefinition: A broad kitchen knife for many everyday cutting and chopping tasks

examples.en: My roommate asked which drawer held the chef's knife we share.
examples.zh: 室友问我们共用的「厨师刀」放在哪个抽屉里。

examples.en: The teacher showed us the difference between a chef's knife and a smaller knife.
examples.zh: 老师给我们看了「厨师刀」和一把小刀有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: A dish the chef suggests customers try on a menu

examples.en: The chef's recommendation appeared on a small card beside the regular menu.
examples.zh: 「主厨推荐菜」写在一张小卡片上，就放在常规菜单旁边。

examples.en: I tried the chef's recommendation when my classmates chose the same dish.
examples.zh: 同学都点了「主厨推荐菜」，我也点了一份尝尝。

collocations: a dish marked as the chef's recommendation

words.enDefinition: A small round fruit with a hard stone

examples.en: One cherry had lost its stem, but the rest still looked fresh to me.
examples.zh: 有一颗「樱桃」的果梗掉了，其他的在我看来还是新鲜的。

examples.en: I bought cherries on the way to our study group as a snack to share.
examples.zh: 去参加学习小组的路上，我买了些「樱桃」当零食，准备分给大家。

words.enDefinition: A tool that pushes the stones out of individual cherries

examples.en: The class supplied a cherry pitter for the fruit tart demonstration.
examples.zh: 做水果挞的演示课提供了一个「樱桃去核器」。

examples.en: I had never seen a cherry pitter before this baking workshop.
examples.zh: 这次烘焙讲座之前，我没见过「樱桃去核器」。

words.enDefinition: A small round tomato, often sold in packs

examples.en: I bought cherry tomatoes to share at the study session in our flat.
examples.zh: 我买了些「小番茄」，打算在公寓里一起学习时分着吃。

examples.en: One cherry tomato had rolled to the corner of the plastic container.
examples.zh: 有一颗「小番茄」滚到了塑料盒的角落里。

words.enDefinition: a consistency requiring repeated chewing rather than breaking or melting easily

examples.en: These cookies had a chewy texture even after cooling on the rack.
examples.zh: 这些曲奇在晾架上放凉后，口感还是「有嚼劲」。

examples.en: The bread had a chewy texture that worked well for toasted sandwiches.
examples.zh: 这种面包「口感有嚼劲」，做烤三明治很合适。

words.enDefinition: small edible seeds that absorb liquid and form a gel

examples.en: I added chia seeds to the yogurt mixture for tomorrow's breakfast.
examples.zh: 我往准备明天早餐吃的酸奶里加了「奇亚籽」。

examples.en: The grocery store sells chia seeds beside other seeds in the cereal aisle.
examples.zh: 杂货店在早餐麦片通道，把「奇亚籽」和其他籽类放在一起卖。

words.enDefinition: The lean cut of meat from the front of a chicken

examples.en: I bought a chicken breast because I was making lunch for myself.
examples.zh: 我一个人做午饭，所以只买了一块「鸡胸肉」。

examples.en: The recipe called for chicken breast, and my flatmate already had the vegetables.
examples.zh: 菜谱要用「鸡胸肉」，蔬菜室友已经买好了。

words.enDefinition: a savoury liquid made by cooking chicken in water, used in soups or other dishes

examples.en: The recipe used chicken broth to give the noodles a more savoury taste.
examples.zh: 食谱用「清鸡汤」给面条增加鲜味。

examples.en: I opened a carton of chicken broth before chopping vegetables for the soup.
examples.zh: 给汤切蔬菜之前，我打开了一盒「清鸡汤」。

words.enDefinition: The lower portion of a chicken leg sold as a cut

examples.en: My roommate picked a chicken drumstick from the tray at the butcher's.
examples.zh: 室友从肉柜的托盘里挑了一只「鸡小腿」。

examples.en: I asked how much a single chicken drumstick cost at the counter.
examples.zh: 我问肉柜一只「鸡小腿」要多少钱。

words.enDefinition: A chicken leg sold with an attached section of back

examples.en: I compared a chicken leg quarter with the smaller cuts in the display.
examples.zh: 我把「带背鸡全腿」跟展示柜里其他更小的部位作了比较。

examples.en: The butcher pointed out the piece of back on the chicken leg quarter.
examples.zh: 肉柜店员指给我看「带背鸡全腿」上连着的那块鸡背。

collocations: a pack of chicken leg quarters

words.enDefinition: A narrow muscle attached underneath a chicken breast

examples.en: I asked why the chicken tenderloin was smaller than the breast cut.
examples.zh: 我问为什么「鸡胸里脊」比鸡胸肉小。

examples.en: The chicken tenderloin was sold in a pack marked with its weight.
examples.zh: 「鸡胸里脊」装在标明重量的包装里出售。

words.enDefinition: A cut from the upper part of a chicken's leg

examples.en: The butcher showed me the difference between a whole leg and a chicken thigh.
examples.zh: 肉柜店员给我看了整只鸡腿和「鸡大腿肉」有什么区别。

examples.en: I chose one chicken thigh to add to the noodle soup.
examples.zh: 我选了一块「鸡大腿肉」，打算加到汤面里。

words.enDefinition: A cut of meat from the wing of a chicken

examples.en: The butcher put an extra chicken wing in the bag after asking me.
examples.zh: 肉柜店员问过我之后，在袋子里多放了一只「鸡翅」。

examples.en: We picked up a chicken wing for each person at the picnic.
examples.zh: 我们给每个去野餐的人都买了一只「鸡翅」。

words.enDefinition: round beige pulses used in dishes such as hummus and curries

examples.en: I used chickpeas to make a spread for sandwiches on the picnic.
examples.zh: 我用「鹰嘴豆」做了一份抹酱，野餐时抹在三明治里。

examples.en: The supermarket sold chickpeas beside the other canned beans on the lower shelf.
examples.zh: 超市把「鹰嘴豆」和其他罐装豆类放在下面那层货架。

words.enDefinition: A selection of dishes and portions intended for young diners

examples.en: My friend asked for the children's menu when her son arrived.
examples.zh: 朋友的儿子到了之后，她要了一份「儿童菜单」。

examples.en: The children's menu had pictures beside the names of the dishes.
examples.zh: 「儿童菜单」的菜名旁印了图片。

words.enDefinition: Keeping food at a low temperature without freezing it

examples.en: The sheet marked which lunch deliveries needed chilled storage before the event.
examples.zh: 清单标出了活动前哪些送到的午餐需要「冷藏储存」。

examples.en: I asked the coordinator where the hall had space for chilled storage.
examples.zh: 我问协调员大厅里哪里有可以「冷藏储存」的地方。

words.enDefinition: small pieces of chocolate added to cookies, cakes or other foods

examples.en: I put chocolate chips in the biscuits we made for the club stall.
examples.zh: 我们给社团摊位做饼干，我往里面放了「巧克力豆」。

examples.en: The supermarket sold dark chocolate chips in a small resealable bag.
examples.zh: 超市有黑巧克力做的「巧克力豆」，装在可以重新封口的小袋里。

words.enDefinition: To cut food into pieces without making them small or even

examples.en: The soup recipe says to chop roughly because the vegetables will be blended.
examples.zh: 汤的菜谱上说蔬菜最后会打碎，所以先「粗切」就行。

examples.en: I asked what it meant to chop roughly in the salad recipe.
examples.zh: 我问沙拉菜谱里说的「粗切」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: A Spanish-style pork sausage commonly seasoned with ground red peppers

examples.en: The shop displayed Spanish chorizo beside the other cured meats.
examples.zh: 店里把西班牙「伊比利亚辣香肠」摆在其他腌制肉旁边。

examples.en: I found sliced chorizo in the deli section of the market.
examples.zh: 我在市场熟食区找到了切成片的「伊比利亚辣香肠」。

words.enDefinition: A thick cut from the beef shoulder sold for roasting

examples.en: The chuck roast was too large for the pan in our shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 那块「厚切牛肩肉」大得放不进共用厨房的锅。

examples.en: I asked whether the chuck roast on sale was sold by weight.
examples.zh: 我问打折的「厚切牛肩肉」是不是按重量卖。

words.enDefinition: The fresh leaves and stems of the coriander plant

examples.en: I asked for cilantro at the grocery store near my campus in California.
examples.zh: 我在加利福尼亚州学校旁的杂货店问店员有没有「香菜」。

examples.en: The cilantro was sold in small bunches next to the spring onions.
examples.zh: 「香菜」是小把卖的，就在青葱旁边。

words.enDefinition: Fruit such as oranges, lemons, and grapefruits

examples.en: The citrus fruit was stacked beside the apples, with a sign for each variety.
examples.zh: 「柑橘类水果」堆在苹果旁边，每个品种都标了牌子。

examples.en: I asked where to find citrus fruit because I needed both lemons and oranges.
examples.zh: 我问「柑橘类水果」在哪儿，因为我既要买柠檬，也要买橙子。

words.enDefinition: A device designed to squeeze juice from citrus fruits

examples.en: I borrowed a citrus juicer for the lemons we had bought.
examples.zh: 我借了一个「柑橘榨汁器」，用来榨我们买的柠檬。

examples.en: The citrus juicer was on the shelf next to the mixing bowls.
examples.zh: 「柑橘榨汁器」在架子上，放在搅拌碗旁边。

words.enDefinition: A tool made to remove the colored outer peel from citrus

examples.en: I asked whether the shared kitchen had a citrus zester for lemons.
examples.zh: 我问共用厨房有没有给柠檬用的「柑橘刨皮器」。

examples.en: The instructor showed us a citrus zester beside the other small tools.
examples.zh: 老师给我们看了摆在其他小工具旁边的「柑橘刨皮器」。

words.enDefinition: Bivalve shellfish sold for the flesh inside their paired shells

examples.en: The clams were displayed next to the mussels in the case.
examples.zh: 展示柜里，「蛤蜊」摆在贻贝旁边。

examples.en: We asked for a small bag of clams for our soup.
examples.zh: 我们想煮汤，就向店员要了一小袋「蛤蜊」。

words.enDefinition: A hinged container with a top and bottom

examples.en: The blueberries came in a clamshell container that opened from the long side.
examples.zh: 蓝莓装在一个可以从长边打开的「翻盖盒」里。

examples.en: I checked the bottom of the clamshell container before choosing which berries to buy.
examples.zh: 挑莓果前，我先看了看「翻盖盒」的底部。

words.enDefinition: To remove used plates from the table after people finish eating

examples.en: The server waited until we had finished to clear our plates.
examples.zh: 服务员等我们吃完才来「收走我们的盘子」。

examples.en: We asked if she could clear our plates to make room for dessert.
examples.zh: 为了给甜点腾出地方，我们请她「收走我们的盘子」。

collocations: ask someone to clear our plates

words.enDefinition: very thick British cream with a rich texture, traditionally served with scones

examples.en: The small café served warm scones with jam and clotted cream on Sunday.
examples.zh: 周日小咖啡馆供应热司康，配果酱和「凝脂奶油」。

examples.en: I bought a pot of clotted cream for our afternoon tea at home.
examples.zh: 我买了一罐「凝脂奶油」，准备在家喝下午茶时用。

collocations: spread clotted cream on a scone

words.enDefinition: powder made by grinding cocoa solids after removing much of the cocoa butter

examples.en: I mixed cocoa powder into the flour while making brownies with my flatmate.
examples.zh: 和室友做布朗尼时，我把「可可粉」混进了面粉。

examples.en: The shop stores cocoa powder next to flour and the other baking supplies.
examples.zh: 商店把「可可粉」摆在面粉等烘焙用品旁边。

words.enDefinition: a thick coconut product generally richer in coconut fat than coconut milk

examples.en: The recipe used coconut cream to make the dessert filling thicker and richer.
examples.zh: 食谱用「浓椰浆」让甜点的馅更浓稠。

examples.en: The shop put coconut cream beside the thinner coconut milk on the shelf.
examples.zh: 商店把「浓椰浆」放在更稀的椰浆旁边。

words.enDefinition: a white liquid made from the flesh of coconuts, often used in cooking

examples.en: We used coconut milk to make the sauce for our vegetable curry.
examples.zh: 我们用「椰浆」给咖喱蔬菜做酱汁。

examples.en: I found coconut milk in cans near the other ingredients for curries.
examples.zh: 我在其他咖喱食材附近找到了罐装「椰浆」。

collocations: use coconut milk in a curry

words.enDefinition: A marine fish with mild-flavored white flesh sold as food

examples.en: I picked cod because it was the least expensive white fish.
examples.zh: 我选了「鳕鱼」，因为它是最便宜的白肉鱼。

examples.en: The fishmonger showed us two different sizes of cod fillets.
examples.zh: 鱼柜店员给我们看了两种大小的「鳕鱼」鱼柳。

words.enDefinition: A bowl with holes that lets liquid drain from food

examples.en: I left the pasta in a colander while finding a bowl.
examples.zh: 我把意面先放在「滤水篮」里，去找个碗。

examples.en: The colander was big enough for all of the salad leaves.
examples.zh: 「滤水篮」足够大，能放下做沙拉用的所有菜叶。

words.enDefinition: Sliced, prepared meats usually served cold in sandwiches or platters

examples.en: We chose some cold cuts for sandwiches on the train tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我们买了些「冷切熟肉片」，准备明天在火车上吃三明治。

examples.en: The deli offered three kinds of cold cuts in one small pack.
examples.zh: 熟食柜有一种小盒装，里面配了三种「冷切熟肉片」。

words.enDefinition: A meal in which several items are offered together as one order

examples.en: The student café offered a combo meal with soup and a sandwich.
examples.zh: 学生咖啡馆提供一种含汤和三明治的「组合套餐」。

examples.en: I asked which drink came with the combo meal on the board.
examples.zh: 我问牌子上的「组合套餐」配哪种饮料。

collocations: a combo meal with a drink

words.enDefinition: A large eating table shared by people from different groups

examples.en: We found two empty seats at the communal table in the dining hall.
examples.zh: 我们在食堂的「共用长桌」旁找到了两个空位。

examples.en: A group from our class joined us at the communal table.
examples.zh: 我们班的几个同学也坐到了这张「共用长桌」旁边。

words.enDefinition: a small sealed packet containing seasoning or a sauce

examples.en: I found a condiment packet at the bottom of the bag after eating the fries.
examples.zh: 吃完薯条后，我在袋子底下发现了一包「袋装调味料」。

examples.en: The staff added a condiment packet to each boxed lunch before sealing the bag.
examples.zh: 封袋之前，店员给每份盒装午餐加了一包「袋装调味料」。

words.enDefinition: To check exactly what a dish contains

examples.en: The server went back to confirm the ingredients in the salad dressing.
examples.zh: 服务员回厨房「确认了沙拉酱的配料」。

examples.en: Could you confirm the ingredients in this soup before I choose a main dish?
examples.zh: 我选主菜之前，你能「确认一下这碗汤的配料」吗？

collocations: ask someone to confirm the ingredients
confirm the ingredients with the cook

words.enDefinition: a delivery in which the order is left for the customer to collect

examples.en: I selected contactless delivery and asked for the bag to be left by the porch.
examples.zh: 我选择了「无接触送餐」，请对方把袋子放在门廊旁边。

examples.en: The restaurant offers contactless delivery, so I left a note about where to put the order.
examples.zh: 餐厅提供「无接触送餐」，所以我备注了餐要放在哪里。

words.enDefinition: A phrase stating that alcohol is present

examples.en: The dessert menu said the sauce contains alcohol and marked it separately.
examples.zh: 甜点菜单写明那种酱汁「含有酒精」，并单独作了标记。

examples.en: I asked whether the note saying contains alcohol referred to the whole dessert.
examples.zh: 我问写着「含有酒精」的说明是不是指整份甜点。

collocations: a warning that a dish contains alcohol

words.enDefinition: A label statement identifying allergens present as ingredients

examples.en: The U.S. snack packet had a “Contains” statement in bold below the ingredients.
examples.zh: 美国那包零食在配料表下方用粗体印了「“含有”过敏原声明」。

examples.en: I read the “Contains” statement on the box before choosing a snack for the trip.
examples.zh: 为出行挑零食之前，我读了盒子上的「“含有”过敏原声明」。

collocations: a contains statement below the ingredients

words.enDefinition: an oven that heats food without using a fan to circulate hot air

examples.en: Our conventional oven browned the vegetables more quickly on the upper rack.
examples.zh: 我们的「无风扇传统烤箱」上层烤架上的蔬菜更快上色。

examples.en: The recipe lists a separate temperature for people using a conventional oven.
examples.zh: 食谱为用「无风扇传统烤箱」的人单列了一个温度。

words.enDefinition: Grown using methods outside organic production standards

examples.en: The shop had two kinds of strawberries, and this pack was labelled conventionally grown.
examples.zh: 店里有两种草莓，这盒标的是「采用常规方式种植的」。

examples.en: I asked which apples were conventionally grown because the signs were hard to read.
examples.zh: 标签不太好辨认，我就问哪些苹果是「采用常规方式种植的」。

words.enDefinition: To express ingredient amounts in a different system of units

examples.en: We used the chart to convert the measurements in the American recipe.
examples.zh: 我们用对照表给这份美国菜谱「换算计量单位」。

examples.en: I asked my roommate to convert the measurements before starting the batter.
examples.zh: 我请室友在开始调面糊之前先「换算计量单位」。

collocations: convert the measurements to metric units

words.enDefinition: to start cooking food while it is still frozen

examples.en: The package says to cook from frozen when preparing these vegetables.
examples.zh: 包装上说，这些蔬菜要「不解冻直接烹调」。

examples.en: Before opening the bag, I checked whether the label said to cook from frozen.
examples.zh: 我开袋前确认了标签是否写着要「不解冻直接烹调」。

collocations: follow directions to cook from frozen

words.enDefinition: to heat food gently in a container surrounded by hot water

examples.en: The recipe leaves the custard to cook in a water bath in the oven.
examples.zh: 食谱把蛋奶糊放进烤箱「隔水加热烹制」。

examples.en: I watched the pudding cook in a water bath during the baking lesson.
examples.zh: 烘焙课上，我看着布丁「隔水加热烹制」的过程。

collocations: cook in a water bath in the oven
leave custard to cook in a water bath
let the mixture cook in a water bath

words.enDefinition: to cause a liquid or moisture to evaporate by continuing to heat it

examples.en: The recipe says to cook off any excess water before adding the seasoning.
examples.zh: 食谱说，调味前要「加热使多余的水分蒸发」。

examples.en: I left the mixture on the stove to cook off some liquid.
examples.zh: 我把混合物继续放在炉子上，「加热使一部分液体蒸发」。

words.enDefinition: to heat food on a stove's upper cooking surface rather than inside an oven

examples.en: I decided to cook on the hob because someone else was using the oven.
examples.zh: 因为有人在用烤箱，我决定「在炉灶上烹煮」。

examples.en: The recipe says to cook on the hob for the first stage.
examples.zh: 食谱说，开始阶段需要「在炉灶上烹煮」。

collocations: cook on the hob over low heat
leave the sauce to cook on the hob
suitable to cook on the hob

words.enDefinition: to become cooked all the way to the centre of the food

examples.en: The largest potato took longer to cook through than the smaller ones.
examples.zh: 最大的土豆比其他小土豆更久才「熟透」。

examples.en: I checked whether the largest dumpling had enough time to cook through.
examples.zh: 我看了下最大的饺子有没有足够的时间「熟透」。

words.enDefinition: to heat food until it changes from opaque to partially transparent

examples.en: The recipe says to cook until translucent before adding the rice to the pan.
examples.zh: 食谱说，先把配料「炒至半透明」，再把米加进锅里。

examples.en: The instructor told us that the onions should cook until translucent without turning brown.
examples.zh: 老师说，洋葱要「炒至半透明」，不要变褐。

collocations: cook until translucent over low heat

words.enDefinition: to let food lose heat on an open rack that allows air to circulate

examples.en: I left the small cakes to cool on a rack by the window.
examples.zh: 我让小蛋糕「放在晾架上冷却」，架子就搁在窗边。

examples.en: The recipe says the biscuits should cool on a rack before being packed.
examples.zh: 食谱说，饼干打包前应该「放在晾架上冷却」。

collocations: leave cakes to cool on a rack
let bread cool on a rack
allow to cool on a rack

words.enDefinition: To remove the central part of an apple containing seeds

examples.en: The recipe shows a photo of a tool to core an apple.
examples.zh: 菜谱上有一张工具照片，展示的是用来「去掉苹果核」的工具。

examples.en: The teaching assistant showed us which tool to use to core an apple.
examples.zh: 助教给我们看了用什么工具可以「去掉苹果核」。

collocations: core an apple for a snack
core an apple for a tart
a tool to core an apple

words.enDefinition: Sweetcorn still attached to its central cob

examples.en: I picked up corn on the cob for the barbecue at our student residence.
examples.zh: 我买了「整穗玉米」，准备在学生宿舍的烧烤会上吃。

examples.en: The farm stand offered corn on the cob in bundles of three that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上，农场直销摊的「整穗玉米」三根一捆卖。

collocations: served as corn on the cob

words.enDefinition: ground dried maize, commonly used in baking and for making dishes such as polenta

examples.en: I bought cornmeal for the loaf we planned to serve with soup.
examples.zh: 我买了「粗玉米粉」，给要配汤吃的面包用。

examples.en: The grocery store sells cornmeal in three grades with different grain sizes.
examples.zh: 杂货店的「粗玉米粉」按颗粒大小分三档。

words.enDefinition: maize starch used to thicken liquids, called cornflour in British English

examples.en: I found cornstarch on the shelf near the other baking ingredients.
examples.zh: 我在其他烘焙食材附近的货架上找到了「玉米淀粉」。

examples.en: The recipe uses cornstarch to give the sauce a thicker consistency.
examples.zh: 食谱用「玉米淀粉」让酱汁变稠。

words.enDefinition: A restaurant bill changed to fix an error in the original

examples.en: The server brought a corrected bill after removing the extra dessert.
examples.zh: 服务员扣掉多算的甜点后，拿来一份「更正后的账单」。

examples.en: I checked the corrected bill while my friends waited by the door.
examples.zh: 朋友们在门边等我时，我核对了「更正后的账单」。

words.enDefinition: a fresh cheese made of soft individual curds, often with a little liquid

examples.en: My roommate mixed cottage cheese with chopped herbs for our baked potatoes.
examples.zh: 室友把「茅屋奶酪」和切碎的香草拌在一起，配烤土豆吃。

examples.en: I found cottage cheese next to the yogurt in the supermarket cooler.
examples.zh: 我在超市冷柜的酸奶旁找到了「茅屋奶酪」。

words.expression: Could I get half a pound of that?
words.lemma: could i get half a pound of that?
words.enDefinition: A polite request for a half-pound portion of an item
acceptedEnVariants: Could I get half a pound of that?

examples.en: At the deli I asked, "Could I get half a pound of that?"
examples.zh: 我在熟食柜台问「这个能给我半磅吗？」

examples.en: My roommate pointed to the ham and asked, "Could I get half a pound of that?"
examples.zh: 室友指着火腿问「这个能给我半磅吗？」

collocations: ask "Could I get half a pound of that, please?"
say "Could I get half a pound of that?"
start with "Could I get half a pound of that?"

words.zhGloss: 能再给我们一点时间吗
words.enDefinition: A polite request for longer to decide before ordering food
acceptedZhAnswers: 能再给我们一点时间吗

examples.en: When the server returned, I asked, "Could we have another minute?" and kept reading.
examples.zh: 服务员回来时，我问「能再给我们一点时间吗？」然后继续看菜单。

examples.en: I asked, "Could we have another minute?" because my friend was still choosing lunch.
examples.zh: 我问「能再给我们一点时间吗？」因为朋友还没选好午饭。

collocations: say "Could we have another minute to decide?"
ask "Could we have another minute, please?"

words.enDefinition: A polite phrase used to request an item for a group

examples.en: I asked, "Could you bring us another spoon?" when our dessert arrived.
examples.zh: 甜点端上来时，我问「能给我们再拿把勺子吗？」

examples.en: My roommate said, "Could you bring us some napkins?" after the soup spilled.
examples.zh: 汤洒了之后，室友问「能给我们拿些餐巾吗？」

collocations: could you bring us another spoon
could you bring us some water
could you bring us the dessert menu

words.expression: could you check inside the bag
words.lemma: could you check inside the bag
words.zhGloss: 能帮我检查一下袋子里面吗
words.enDefinition: asks someone to check what the food bag contains
acceptedZhAnswers: 能帮我检查一下袋子里面吗
acceptedEnVariants: could you check inside the bag

examples.en: Could you check inside the bag to make sure both sandwiches are in there?
examples.zh: 「能帮我检查一下袋子里面吗」？我想确认两份三明治都装进去了。

examples.en: Could you check inside the bag for the sauce we ordered with the dumplings?
examples.zh: 「能帮我检查一下袋子里面吗」？我们点了饺子配的酱料。

collocations: could you check inside the bag for the drinks?
could you check inside the bag before I leave?
before you seal it, could you check inside the bag?

words.expression: Could you slice that for me?
words.lemma: could you slice that for me?
words.enDefinition: A polite request for the seller to cut food into slices
acceptedEnVariants: Could you slice that for me?

examples.en: I pointed to the salami and asked, "Could you slice that for me?"
examples.zh: 我指着萨拉米香肠问「能帮我把它切片吗？」

examples.en: At the deli counter, my roommate asked, "Could you slice that for me?"
examples.zh: 在熟食柜台，室友问「能帮我把它切片吗？」

collocations: ask "Could you slice that for me, please?"
say "Could you slice that for me?"
ask "Could you slice that for me?" at the counter

words.enDefinition: Places for diners to sit directly along a restaurant counter

examples.en: We chose counter seating because we could see the kitchen from there.
examples.zh: 我们选了「吧台座位」，因为那里能看到厨房。

examples.en: The café had counter seating but only two tables for larger groups.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆有「吧台座位」，但能坐较多人的桌子只有两张。

words.enDefinition: Service in which staff help customers directly across a counter

examples.en: I chose counter service because I wanted a specific amount of ham.
examples.zh: 我想买指定分量的火腿，所以选择了「柜台人工服务」。

examples.en: The store ended counter service before the rest of the shop closed.
examples.zh: 这家店的「柜台人工服务」比其他区域更早结束。

words.enDefinition: The country where a product comes from

examples.en: The country of origin was printed in small letters below the name of the fruit.
examples.zh: 水果名称下方用小字标出了「原产国」。

examples.en: I checked the country of origin on both packs because they looked almost identical.
examples.zh: 这两份看上去几乎一模一样，所以我看了看两个包装上的「原产国」。

words.enDefinition: a status showing someone has been chosen to deliver the order

examples.en: The app showed 'Courier assigned' just as I was leaving campus with my flatmate.
examples.zh: 我刚和室友离开学校，应用就显示「已分配配送员」。

examples.en: I checked the map after 'Courier assigned' appeared on the screen for our lunch.
examples.zh: 我们点的午餐在屏幕上显示「已分配配送员」后，我查看了地图。

words.enDefinition: tiny granules of wheat semolina used in North African cooking

examples.en: I packed couscous with roasted peppers in my lunch container for class.
examples.zh: 我把「库斯库斯」配烤甜椒装进饭盒，带去上课。

examples.en: The student café served couscous with a tomato stew and chickpeas.
examples.zh: 学生咖啡馆的「库斯库斯」配的是炖番茄和鹰嘴豆。

words.enDefinition: A container with a lid or covering over it

examples.en: The café put the spare rolls in a covered container under the counter.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆把多出来的餐包放在柜台下的「有盖容器」里。

examples.en: I brought the biscuits to the meeting in a covered container from home.
examples.zh: 我用家里拿来的「有盖容器」把饼干带到了会议上。

collocations: store something in a covered container
a covered container on the counter

words.enDefinition: a cultured cream with a rich texture and mild tang, used in French cooking

examples.en: I stirred crème fraîche into the mushroom sauce just before serving dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭端上桌前，我将「法式酸奶油」拌进了蘑菇酱。

examples.en: The shop keeps crème fraîche in small pots near the plain yogurt.
examples.zh: 这家店把小杯装的「法式酸奶油」放在原味酸奶旁边。

words.enDefinition: The legs of a crab sold for their meat

examples.en: My flatmate compared the crab legs with the whole crabs nearby.
examples.zh: 室友把「蟹腿」与旁边的整只蟹作了比较。

examples.en: The seafood worker weighed the crab legs before giving me the total.
examples.zh: 海鲜柜店员给「蟹腿」称过重，才告诉我总价。

words.enDefinition: A small red fruit with a tart flavour

examples.en: One cranberry rolled out when I opened the bag to check the berries.
examples.zh: 我打开袋子查看莓果时，一颗「蔓越莓」滚了出来。

examples.en: I found fresh cranberries on the lower shelf beside the apples at the market.
examples.zh: 我在市场里苹果旁边的下层货架上找到了新鲜的「蔓越莓」。

words.enDefinition: To beat butter and sugar together until light and fluffy

examples.en: The recipe says to cream butter and sugar before mixing in the egg.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，拌入鸡蛋之前先「将黄油和糖打发」。

examples.en: I checked why the instructions said to cream butter and sugar for this cake.
examples.zh: 我查了一下，这款蛋糕为什么要求「将黄油和糖打发」。

collocations: cream butter and sugar until fluffy
use a mixer to cream butter and sugar

words.enDefinition: a soft, smooth fresh cheese that is often spread or used in baking

examples.en: I spread cream cheese on a bagel before leaving for my morning lecture.
examples.zh: 出门上早课前，我在贝果上抹了「奶油奶酪」。

examples.en: The recipe needed cream cheese for the frosting on the carrot cake.
examples.zh: 这份食谱要用「奶油奶酪」做胡萝卜蛋糕的糖霜。

words.enDefinition: having firm, brittle edges while the centre may be softer

examples.en: The potato cakes became crisp around the edges but stayed soft inside.
examples.zh: 土豆饼「边缘酥脆」，里面还是软的。

examples.en: I liked the biscuits best when they were crisp around the edges.
examples.zh: 我最喜欢吃「边缘酥脆」的饼干。

collocations: bake until crisp around the edges

words.enDefinition: to become firm and brittle on the surface when heated

examples.en: I waited for the potato skins to crisp up before taking the tray out.
examples.zh: 我等土豆皮「变脆」后，才把烤盘拿出来。

examples.en: The recipe says the bread will crisp up as the surface dries.
examples.zh: 食谱说，面包表面变干时就会「变脆」。

words.enDefinition: Unintended transfer of contaminants between foods or surfaces

examples.en: The kitchen workshop discussed cross-contamination when foods touch the same board or counter.
examples.zh: 厨房工作坊讲到了食物接触同一块砧板或台面时的「交叉污染」。

examples.en: A notice in the shared kitchen explained why cross-contamination was a concern there.
examples.zh: 共用厨房的告示解释了为什么那里要留意「交叉污染」。

words.enDefinition: To press one segment of garlic until it breaks apart

examples.en: I needed the small press to crush a garlic clove for the dressing.
examples.zh: 我要用那个小压蒜器「压碎一瓣大蒜」，用来调酱汁。

examples.en: The recipe says to crush a garlic clove before adding the yogurt.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，放酸奶之前要先「压碎一瓣大蒜」。

collocations: crush a garlic clove for dressing
use a press to crush a garlic clove
crush a garlic clove for a marinade

words.enDefinition: the firmer outer layer of bread or another baked food

examples.en: The bread had a crisp crust even after it had cooled completely.
examples.zh: 面包完全放凉之后，「外皮」仍很酥脆。

examples.en: I liked the dark crust on the loaf we bought for lunch.
examples.zh: 我喜欢午饭买的面包上那层深色的「烘烤形成的外皮」。

words.enDefinition: An aquatic animal with a hard outer covering

examples.en: The menu named prawn as the crustacean used in the cold noodle dish.
examples.zh: 菜单写明这道凉面用到的「甲壳类水产」是虾。

examples.en: I looked up which crustacean the label meant before buying the prepared soup.
examples.zh: 买现成的汤之前，我查了标签指的是哪种「甲壳类水产」。

words.enDefinition: A long vegetable with green skin and watery flesh

examples.en: I picked up a cucumber to take home after the afternoon study session.
examples.zh: 下午的学习活动结束后，我买了根「黄瓜」带回家。

examples.en: The cucumber I bought at the market was short enough for my lunch bag.
examples.zh: 我在市场买的「黄瓜」够短，能放进午餐袋。

words.enDefinition: a band around a cup that makes it easier to hold

examples.en: I asked for a cup sleeve on my coffee before walking back to the library.
examples.zh: 走回图书馆前，我请店员给我的咖啡加一个「杯套」。

examples.en: The cup sleeve slipped off while I was getting my student card out.
examples.zh: 我掏学生证时，「杯套」滑了下来。

collocations: put a cup sleeve on a drink

words.enDefinition: To slice meat across the direction of its muscle fibers

examples.en: The recipe says to cut across the grain when slicing the beef for sandwiches.
examples.zh: 菜谱上说，把牛肉切片夹三明治时要「横着纹理切」。

examples.en: I asked whether the arrows in the picture meant to cut across the grain.
examples.zh: 我问图里的箭头是不是表示要「横着纹理切」。

collocations: cut across the grain for serving
cut across the grain of the beef
remember to cut across the grain

words.enDefinition: To divide food into fairly large pieces for a dish

examples.en: The vegetable stew recipe said the carrots should be cut into chunks.
examples.zh: 蔬菜炖菜的菜谱说，胡萝卜要「切成大块」。

examples.en: The pumpkin was already cut into chunks when my flatmate brought it home.
examples.zh: 室友带回家的南瓜已经「切成大块」了。

words.enDefinition: To divide food into pieces shaped like small boxes

examples.en: The instructions asked for firm tofu already cut into cubes for the salad.
examples.zh: 菜谱要求沙拉用已经「切成方丁」的硬豆腐。

examples.en: I picked up a pack of cheese that was already cut into cubes.
examples.zh: 我买了一盒已经「切成方丁」的奶酪。

collocations: cut into cubes for a salad

words.enDefinition: To divide an ingredient into four roughly equal pieces

examples.en: The recipe says that the apples should be cut into quarters for the platter.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，用来拼盘的苹果要「切成四等份」。
