examples.en: I checked which vegetables had already been cut into quarters before measuring them.
examples.zh: 量之前，我核对了哪些蔬菜已经「切成四等份」。

words.enDefinition: To divide a round food into pieces with pointed centers

examples.en: The limes had already been cut into wedges when I arrived to help.
examples.zh: 我到厨房帮忙时，青柠已经被「切成楔形块」了。

examples.en: I checked which fruit should be cut into wedges for the platter.
examples.zh: 我核对了果盘里哪种水果应该「切成楔形块」。

words.enDefinition: A piece of meat identified by the part it comes from

examples.en: I asked which cut of meat the sign above the tray referred to.
examples.zh: 我问托盘上方的牌子指的是哪种「某个部位的肉」。

examples.en: The butcher suggested a smaller cut of meat for our two-person dinner.
examples.zh: 肉柜店员推荐了一块较小的「某个部位的肉」，够我们两个人吃晚饭。

words.enDefinition: Cut into a requested size or shape when someone orders

examples.en: The sign said that thicker steaks could be cut to order here.
examples.zh: 牌子上说这里的牛排可以「按顾客要求分切」得厚一点。

examples.en: The butcher keeps a whole piece ready to be cut to order.
examples.zh: 肉柜备有一整块肉，随时可以「按顾客要求分切」。

words.enDefinition: A flat board protecting a surface while food is cut

examples.en: I put our cutting board on the counter beside the vegetables.
examples.zh: 我把「切菜板」放在操作台上，就在蔬菜旁边。

examples.en: The cutting board was large enough for the whole loaf of bread.
examples.zh: 「切菜板」够大，放得下一整条面包。

words.enDefinition: A large, typically white radish from East Asia

examples.en: I found a daikon beside the Napa cabbage in the international grocery shop.
examples.zh: 我在国际食品杂货店的大白菜旁找到了一根「白萝卜」。

examples.en: The daikon was longer than my shopping bag, so I carried it separately.
examples.zh: 那根「白萝卜」比我的购物袋还长，我就另外拎着。

words.enDefinition: A dish offered in addition to the restaurant's regular choices that day

examples.en: The server told us about the daily special while we read the menu.
examples.zh: 我们看菜单时，服务员介绍了「当日特色菜」。

examples.en: I chose the daily special because I had never tried that dish.
examples.zh: 我选了「当日特色菜」，因为之前没吃过那道菜。

collocations: a board listing the daily special

words.enDefinition: the supermarket aisle where milk and other dairy products are sold

examples.en: I went back to the dairy aisle for yogurt after finding the bread.
examples.zh: 找到面包后，我回到「乳制品货架区」拿酸奶。

examples.en: The staff moved the dairy aisle closer to the fruit and vegetables.
examples.zh: 店员把「乳制品货架区」搬到了更靠近果蔬的地方。

collocations: find something in the dairy aisle

words.enDefinition: a dark Chinese soy sauce often used to give dishes a deeper colour

examples.en: My flatmate used dark soy sauce to give the braised dish a darker colour.
examples.zh: 室友用「老抽」给炖菜上色，颜色更深。

examples.en: The label on the dark soy sauce was easy to spot from the aisle.
examples.zh: 站在通道里很容易看到「老抽」瓶上的标签。

collocations: a bottle of dark soy sauce
colour a sauce with dark soy sauce

words.enDefinition: A set of printed characters representing a date

examples.en: I found a date code next to the seam of the bag.
examples.zh: 我在包装袋接缝旁找到了一串「日期编码」。

examples.en: The assistant explained which part of the date code identified the month.
examples.zh: 店员解释了「日期编码」里的哪部分代表月份。

words.enDefinition: Date information printed or stamped on food packaging

examples.en: The worksheet explained date marking using examples from two products in the campus shop.
examples.zh: 练习单用学校商店两种食品作例子解释了「日期标示」。

examples.en: I found the date marking close to the fold at the bottom of the packet.
examples.zh: 我在包装袋底部靠近折边的地方找到了「日期标示」。

collocations: a date marking on the package

words.enDefinition: To write the date on stored leftover food

examples.en: My flatmate asked me to date the leftovers before we cleared the counter.
examples.zh: 我们收拾台面前，室友让我「给剩菜标注日期」。

examples.en: I used a blank sticker to date the leftovers from our group dinner.
examples.zh: 我用一张空白贴纸「给聚餐剩下的菜标注日期」。

collocations: use a sticker to date the leftovers
date the leftovers before storing them

words.enDefinition: An area reserved for preparing particular foods

examples.en: The dining manager showed us the dedicated prep area during the kitchen tour.
examples.zh: 参观厨房时，餐厅经理给我们看了「专用备料区」。

examples.en: I asked which dishes were made in the dedicated prep area at the café.
examples.zh: 我问咖啡馆哪些菜是在「专用备料区」做的。

collocations: set up a dedicated prep area
a dedicated prep area in the kitchen

words.enDefinition: to cook food fully immersed in hot oil

examples.en: The cook decided to deep-fry the potato strips for the café's lunch service.
examples.zh: 厨师决定把午餐要卖的土豆条「浸油炸」。

examples.en: We watched the chef deep-fry dough pieces during a demonstration at college.
examples.zh: 我们在学院的演示课上看厨师把小面团「浸油炸」。

words.zhGloss: 用液体溶开锅底焦香残渣
words.enDefinition: to add liquid to a hot pan to loosen and dissolve browned bits
acceptedZhAnswers: 用液体溶开锅底焦香残渣

examples.en: I used a little stock to deglaze the pan after cooking the mushrooms.
examples.zh: 做完蘑菇后，我用了少量高汤「溶解锅底焦褐残渣」。

examples.en: The instructor explained why she would deglaze the pan before making the sauce.
examples.zh: 老师解释了做酱汁前为什么要「用液体溶开锅底焦香残渣」。

collocations: deglaze the pan for a sauce

words.enDefinition: A shop worker who serves customers at a prepared-food counter

examples.en: The deli clerk asked whether I wanted thin or thick slices of ham.
examples.zh: 「熟食柜店员」问我的火腿要切成薄片还是厚片。

examples.en: I showed the deli clerk the item I wanted through the glass.
examples.zh: 我隔着玻璃指给「熟食柜店员」看我想要的东西。

collocations: a deli clerk behind the counter
tell the deli clerk the weight

words.enDefinition: A shop counter selling prepared foods such as sliced meats

examples.en: I went to the deli counter for some ham and a small salad.
examples.zh: 我去「熟食柜台」买了些火腿和一小份沙拉。

examples.en: My housemate was waiting at the deli counter when I entered the supermarket.
examples.zh: 我进超市时，室友正在「熟食柜台」等我。

words.enDefinition: says the order was left at another door

examples.en: My order was delivered to the wrong door, according to the photo in the app.
examples.zh: 从应用里的照片来看，我的餐「送错门了」。

examples.en: The courier realized it had been delivered to the wrong door after I called.
examples.zh: 我打电话以后，配送员才意识到那袋餐「送错门了」。

collocations: an order delivered to the wrong door
report an order delivered to the wrong door
a bag delivered to the wrong door

words.enDefinition: the set of locations a restaurant or service delivers to

examples.en: I checked the delivery area after moving to a different residence across the river.
examples.zh: 搬到河对岸另一栋宿舍后，我查了「送餐范围」。

examples.en: The café's delivery area includes the main campus but stops before our sports fields.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆的「送餐范围」包括主校区，到我们的运动场之前就结束了。

words.enDefinition: a person who brings a food order to the customer

examples.en: I met the delivery courier by the main gate because my residence has two entrances.
examples.zh: 我的宿舍有两个入口，所以我在正门和「外卖配送员」碰面。

examples.en: The delivery courier called when the café had two bags with the same name.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆有两个写着同一个名字的餐袋，「外卖配送员」打来了电话。

collocations: hand an order to the delivery courier

words.enDefinition: a kitchen preparing food exclusively for delivery orders

examples.en: I couldn't collect the order myself because it came from a delivery-only kitchen off campus.
examples.zh: 餐是校外「只接外送单的厨房」做的，我不能自己去取。

examples.en: The delivery-only kitchen listed its food online so students could order from their rooms.
examples.zh: 这家「只接外送单的厨房」在线上列了餐品，学生可以在房间里下单。

words.enDefinition: a pass or subscription offering benefits on food deliveries

examples.en: I checked what the delivery pass covered before deciding how often to order through the app.
examples.zh: 我查了「送餐优惠会员」包含哪些优惠，再决定多久在应用上点一次。

examples.en: The delivery pass gave me a lower charge for ordering lunch from that café.
examples.zh: 用了「送餐优惠会员」，我向那家咖啡馆点午饭时费用低了一些。

words.enDefinition: a picture showing where the courier left an order

examples.en: I checked the delivery photo to see which entrance the courier had left our food at.
examples.zh: 我查看了「送达现场照片」，想知道配送员把餐放在哪个入口。

examples.en: The delivery photo showed our dinner beside the plant in the shared hallway.
examples.zh: 「送达现场照片」显示我们的晚餐放在共用走廊那盆植物旁边。

words.enDefinition: a short code used to confirm a food delivery handover

examples.en: The courier asked for the delivery PIN when I collected the bag from him.
examples.zh: 我从配送员手里接过袋子时，他问我要「送餐确认码」。

examples.en: I opened the order screen to find the delivery PIN before walking downstairs.
examples.zh: 我打开订单页面找到「送餐确认码」，然后走下楼。

words.enDefinition: A food can with part of its surface pushed in

examples.en: The cashier noticed a dented can among the tins in my shopping basket.
examples.zh: 收银员注意到我购物篮里有一个「有凹痕的罐头」。

examples.en: I pointed out the dented can to the person sorting the food donations.
examples.zh: 我把那个「有凹痕的罐头」指给整理捐赠食品的人看。

words.enDefinition: To remove seeds from a fruit, vegetable, or other ingredient

examples.en: The recipe says to deseed the peppers before adding them to the filling.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，把甜椒放进馅里之前要先「去籽」。

examples.en: I asked whether we should deseed the cucumber for this salad.
examples.zh: 我问做这份沙拉时，黄瓜要不要「去籽」。

words.enDefinition: A list of sweet dishes a restaurant serves after a meal

examples.en: We asked to see the dessert menu after finishing our main dishes.
examples.zh: 我们吃完主菜后，请服务员拿来「甜点菜单」。

examples.en: The dessert menu listed a cake my roommate wanted to try.
examples.zh: 「甜点菜单」上有一种我室友想尝的蛋糕。

words.enDefinition: Shrimp sold after the visible digestive tract has been removed

examples.en: The recipe called for deveined shrimp, so I read the descriptions carefully.
examples.zh: 菜谱要用「去虾线的虾」，所以我仔细看了产品说明。

examples.en: The shop stocked deveined shrimp in both small and large packs.
examples.zh: 店里的「去虾线的虾」有小包装，也有大包装。

words.enDefinition: Food-related needs a meal should accommodate

examples.en: The event form asked for dietary requirements before we selected a meal.
examples.zh: 活动表单在我们选餐之前询问了「饮食要求」。

examples.en: I sent our dietary requirements to the organizer before the welcome dinner.
examples.zh: 迎新晚餐之前，我把大家的「饮食要求」发给了组织者。

words.enDefinition: A limit on what someone can or will eat

examples.en: The booking form let me describe a dietary restriction in my own words.
examples.zh: 预订表单允许我用自己的话说明一项「饮食限制」。

examples.en: I told the organizer about my dietary restriction before the group lunch.
examples.zh: 小组午餐前，我把自己的「饮食限制」告诉了组织者。

words.enDefinition: a French-style mustard with a smooth texture and a distinctive sharp flavour

examples.en: I used Dijon mustard to make a dressing for the potato salad.
examples.zh: 我用「第戎芥末酱」给土豆沙拉做调味汁。

examples.en: The small jar of Dijon mustard was near the pickles at the shop.
examples.zh: 店里小罐装的「第戎芥末酱」放在腌菜附近。

words.enDefinition: A university arrangement giving students meals or funds for campus dining

examples.en: I checked whether my dining plan covered breakfast during the break.
examples.zh: 我查了「校园用餐计划」在假期里是否包含早餐。

examples.en: My roommate changed her dining plan at the start of term.
examples.zh: 室友在学期开始时换了「校园用餐计划」。

words.enDefinition: The room in a restaurant where customers sit and eat

examples.en: The dining room at the café was quieter than the front counter.
examples.zh: 这家咖啡馆的「餐厅用餐区」比前台安静。

examples.en: Our group waited near the entrance to the dining room after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我们一行人在「餐厅用餐区」入口附近等人。

collocations: a table in the dining room
serve diners in the dining room

words.enDefinition: the busy period when many people order dinner at once

examples.en: I ordered before the dinner rush so I could eat in time for choir practice.
examples.zh: 我赶在「晚餐高峰」前点了餐，这样能在合唱排练前吃上。

examples.en: The café stopped taking new orders for a few minutes during the dinner rush.
examples.zh: 「晚餐高峰」时，咖啡馆有几分钟暂停接新单。

words.enDefinition: sauce for dipping pieces of food before eating them

examples.en: The restaurant let me choose a dipping sauce for the dumplings at no extra cost.
examples.zh: 餐厅让我给饺子选一份「蘸料」，不用额外付费。

examples.en: We opened the dipping sauce after setting the takeaway boxes on the dorm kitchen table.
examples.zh: 把外卖盒放到宿舍厨房的桌上后，我们才打开「蘸料」。

words.enDefinition: cooking heat applied straight to food from a flame, hot surface or element

examples.en: I moved the vegetables off the direct heat when the edges browned.
examples.zh: 蔬菜边缘上色后，我把它们从「直接受热」的位置移开。

examples.en: The grill has one area for direct heat and another for slower cooking.
examples.zh: 烧烤架一处可以「直接受热」，另一处能慢慢烤。

collocations: move food away from direct heat

words.enDefinition: forks, knives, or spoons intended to be used once

examples.en: The café included disposable cutlery because we'd said we were eating on the lawn.
examples.zh: 我们说要在草坪上吃，咖啡馆就放了「一次性餐具」。

examples.en: I asked for disposable cutlery after realizing there were no forks in the studio.
examples.zh: 我发现工作室没有叉子，就要了些「一次性餐具」。

words.enDefinition: To separate food into quantities for individual servings or uses

examples.en: I asked how we should divide into portions for the six students.
examples.zh: 我问，给六位同学要怎样把食物「分成若干份」。

examples.en: The recipe says to divide into portions before adding the toppings.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，先「分成若干份」，再加表面的配料。

words.enDefinition: A label instruction against freezing thawed food again

examples.en: The packet said do not refreeze in the line beneath the storage instructions.
examples.zh: 包装袋在储存说明下一行写着「请勿再次冷冻」。

examples.en: I had to turn the box around to find the words do not refreeze.
examples.zh: 我得把盒子转过去，才能找到「请勿再次冷冻」这几个字。

collocations: a label saying do not refreeze

words.zhGloss: 你们接待没订位的客人吗
words.enDefinition: A question asking whether customers can enter without reserving a table
acceptedZhAnswers: 你们接待没订位的客人吗

examples.en: I called the café and asked, "Do you take walk-ins?" before walking over.
examples.zh: 我走过去之前先给咖啡馆打了电话，问「你们接待没订位的客人吗？」

examples.en: My friend asked, "Do you take walk-ins?" when we reached the restaurant near campus.
examples.zh: 我们找到学校附近的那家餐厅时，朋友问「你们接待没订位的客人吗？」

collocations: say "Do you take walk-ins on weekends?"
ask "Do you take walk-ins at lunch?"

words.enDefinition: A question used to ask if something is present

examples.en: Does this contain any milk powder, or should I check the label on the packet?
examples.zh: 「这个含有奶粉吗」，要不我看一下包装上的标签？

examples.en: Does this contain sesame, even though it isn't mentioned in the name of the dish?
examples.zh: 菜名里虽然没提到芝麻，「这个含有芝麻吗」？

words.enDefinition: put something in one bag and then place it inside another

examples.en: Could you double-bag the soup containers for the long walk back to my residence?
examples.zh: 我要走很远才能回宿舍，能给装汤的盒子「套上两层袋子」吗？

examples.en: The staff offered to double-bag my order because the bottom of the bag felt damp.
examples.zh: 店员摸到袋底有点潮，就提出给我的餐「套上两层袋子」。

words.enDefinition: two stacked pans that use steam from the lower pan to heat food in the upper one

examples.en: I used a double boiler to melt chocolate for our small cakes.
examples.zh: 我用「双层隔水加热锅」融化巧克力，做小蛋糕用。

examples.en: The shared kitchen had a double boiler near the other stainless steel pans.
examples.zh: 共用厨房把「双层隔水加热锅」放在其他不锈钢锅旁边。

collocations: melt chocolate in a double boiler

words.enDefinition: a rich British cream with a high milk-fat content, often used for whipping or desserts

examples.en: I bought double cream to serve with the berries after our group dinner.
examples.zh: 我买了「高脂浓奶油」，在小组聚餐后和浆果一起端上桌。

examples.en: The recipe calls for double cream to make the filling rich and smooth.
examples.zh: 食谱用「高脂浓奶油」让馅料口感浓郁顺滑。

words.enDefinition: To use twice each listed amount to make more food

examples.en: We decided to double the recipe when two more friends joined us.
examples.zh: 又有两个朋友要来，我们决定「把菜谱用量翻倍」。

examples.en: My roommate asked whether to double the recipe for the club lunch.
examples.zh: 室友问给社团准备午饭时，要不要「把菜谱用量翻倍」。

words.enDefinition: A curved mixer attachment designed to pull and work dough

examples.en: The dough hook was packed separately from the other mixer attachments.
examples.zh: 「和面钩」和搅拌机其他配件分开包装。

examples.en: I asked which attachment in the box was the dough hook.
examples.zh: 我问盒子里的哪个配件是「和面钩」。

words.enDefinition: A cactus fruit with bright skin and speckled flesh

examples.en: I asked whether this dragon fruit had white or red flesh inside.
examples.zh: 我问这个「火龙果」里面是白色果肉还是红色果肉。

examples.en: A dragon fruit was displayed with its cut side facing up so we could see it.
examples.zh: 一个「火龙果」切面朝上摆着，方便我们看里面。

words.enDefinition: to let oil that is no longer needed flow away from cooked food

examples.en: I used a wire rack to drain excess oil from the potato cakes.
examples.zh: 我用金属网架给土豆饼「沥去多余的油」。

examples.en: I let the fritters cool on paper towels to drain excess oil.
examples.zh: 我把炸饼放在厨房纸上晾一会儿，「沥去多余的油」。

collocations: drain excess oil on a rack
drain excess oil on paper towels

words.enDefinition: To let unwanted liquid run away from food or ingredients

examples.en: The instructions say to drain off the liquid before mixing the beans.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，拌豆子之前先「沥去液体」。

examples.en: I asked which bowl would catch the liquid we needed to drain off.
examples.zh: 我问要用哪个碗来接「沥去的液体」。

collocations: drain off the liquid from a can

words.enDefinition: To cover food lightly with flour before the next preparation step

examples.en: The preparation card says to dredge in flour before the next step.
examples.zh: 备料卡上说，下一步前要先「薄裹面粉」。

examples.en: I asked which pieces the recipe said to dredge in flour first.
examples.zh: 我问菜谱说的是哪几块要先「薄裹面粉」。

words.enDefinition: Dressing served separately rather than mixed into the salad

examples.en: I asked for dressing on the side so we could share the salad.
examples.zh: 我们打算分吃沙拉，我请服务员把「沙拉酱另外放」。

examples.en: The café brought dressing on the side in a small bowl beside my plate.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆把「沙拉酱另外放」，用小碗装着放在我盘子旁边。

collocations: ask for dressing on the side
order with dressing on the side

words.enDefinition: beans with most of their moisture removed for storage before cooking

examples.en: The shop sells dried beans in bags beside the lentils and rice.
examples.zh: 商店把袋装「干豆」放在扁豆和米旁边。

examples.en: I chose dried beans for the stew we were planning for Sunday.
examples.zh: 我挑了「干豆」，打算周日做炖菜。

words.enDefinition: fruit with much of its original water removed, usually for preservation

examples.en: I mixed dried fruit with nuts for the walk to the field site.
examples.zh: 我把「果干」和坚果混在一起，带着步行去实地考察。

examples.en: The shop sells dried fruit in small sealed packets near the cereal.
examples.zh: 商店把小袋密封装的「果干」放在早餐麦片旁边。

words.enDefinition: a tray or holder for carrying several drink cups together

examples.en: I asked for a drink carrier because I had to carry four coffees downstairs.
examples.zh: 我得把四杯咖啡拿下楼，就要了个「饮料杯托」。

examples.en: The drink carrier kept the cups together while my friend opened the door to our residence.
examples.zh: 我朋友开宿舍门时，「饮料杯托」把几个杯子稳稳托在一起。

words.enDefinition: A list of beverages offered in a restaurant or café

examples.en: I checked the drinks menu to see which teas they served.
examples.zh: 我查看了「饮品单」，想看看店里供应哪些茶。

examples.en: The server brought us a drinks menu before taking our food orders.
examples.zh: 服务员在给我们点菜前拿来了一份「饮品单」。

words.enDefinition: extra money a customer chooses to give to the courier

examples.en: I added a driver tip after the courier brought dinner to the correct residence entrance.
examples.zh: 配送员把晚饭送到了正确的宿舍入口，我加了「给配送员的小费」。

examples.en: The app listed my driver tip separately from the other charges for lunch.
examples.zh: 应用把午餐订单里「给配送员的小费」和其他费用分开列出。

words.enDefinition: to pour a thin stream of oil over food

examples.en: The recipe says to drizzle with oil just before serving the soup.
examples.zh: 食谱说，汤快上桌时「淋上少量油」。

examples.en: I chose to drizzle with oil after arranging the tomatoes on the plate.
examples.zh: 我把番茄摆到盘子上后，选择「淋上少量油」。

collocations: drizzle with oil and lemon juice

words.enDefinition: directions telling the courier where or how to leave an order

examples.en: I added drop-off instructions explaining that our building door is behind the library.
examples.zh: 我加了条「送餐交接说明」，告诉配送员我们楼的门在图书馆后面。

examples.en: The courier read the drop-off instructions and left the bag under the porch light.
examples.zh: 配送员看了「送餐交接说明」，把袋子放在门廊灯下面。

words.enDefinition: foods sold in a dry form, such as grains, pasta or beans

examples.en: I start with dry goods so the chilled groceries go into my bag last.
examples.zh: 我先买「干货食材」，把冷藏食品留到最后放进袋子。

examples.en: The smaller shop keeps dry goods on shelves near the baking section.
examples.zh: 小店把「干货食材」放在烘焙区附近的货架上。

words.enDefinition: Solid ingredients such as flour or sugar in a baking recipe

examples.en: We put the dry ingredients in a separate bowl beside the recipe.
examples.zh: 我们把「干性食材」装进另一个碗，放在菜谱旁边。

examples.en: The recipe said to combine the dry ingredients before adding any milk.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，加牛奶之前先把「干性食材」混合。

collocations: a bowl for the dry ingredients

words.enDefinition: A cup designed to measure dry ingredients level with the rim

examples.en: I reached for a dry measuring cup to measure the oats for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我拿了一个「干料量杯」量早餐要用的燕麦。

examples.en: The tutor showed one dry measuring cup beside a jug for liquids.
examples.zh: 老师把一个「干料量杯」摆在液体量杯旁边给我们看。

collocations: a set of dry measuring cups

words.enDefinition: to heat food until browned or fragrant without adding oil or other liquid

examples.en: I planned to dry-roast the cumin seeds before mixing them into the sauce.
examples.zh: 我打算先把孜然籽「无油干烘」，再拌进酱汁。

examples.en: The recipe asks cooks to dry-roast the nuts for the salad topping.
examples.zh: 食谱要求先把撒在沙拉上的坚果「无油干烘」。

words.enDefinition: A fleshy cut taken from the front of a duck

examples.en: The butcher showed me a duck breast with the skin still attached.
examples.zh: 肉柜店员给我看了一块还带皮的「鸭胸肉」。

examples.en: My friend chose duck breast because she wanted to follow her family's recipe.
examples.zh: 朋友想照家里的菜谱做，就选了「鸭胸肉」。

words.enDefinition: To cover a surface lightly with a small amount of flour

examples.en: The recipe says to dust with flour before rolling out the pastry.
examples.zh: 菜谱上说，擀酥皮前要「薄撒一层面粉」。

examples.en: I asked which part of the work surface to dust with flour.
examples.zh: 我问操作台的哪部分要「薄撒一层面粉」。

words.enDefinition: a container with individual spaces that hold eggs in place

examples.en: I opened the egg carton to check the eggs before putting it in my basket.
examples.zh: 我打开「鸡蛋包装盒」检查里面的蛋，然后才把它放进篮子。

examples.en: The eggs came in a cardboard egg carton with the size printed on top.
examples.zh: 鸡蛋装在纸质「鸡蛋包装盒」里，盒顶印着规格。

words.enDefinition: Described as not containing eggs

examples.en: The bakery marked one tray of rolls egg-free on the display card.
examples.zh: 面包房在一盘餐包的展示卡上写着「不含鸡蛋」。

examples.en: I compared two egg-free recipes before shopping for the weekend bake sale.
examples.zh: 为周末义卖采购前，我比较了两份「不含鸡蛋的」食谱。

words.enDefinition: an ingredient or product used in place of eggs for a specified purpose

examples.en: I asked where the shop kept egg substitute for the baking class.
examples.zh: 我想买「鸡蛋替代品」上烘焙课，就问店员在哪里拿。

examples.en: The recipe lists an egg substitute that helps hold the batter together.
examples.zh: 食谱列出了一种「鸡蛋替代品」，它有助于让面糊黏合。

collocations: choose an egg substitute for baking

words.enDefinition: the clear part of an uncooked egg surrounding the yolk

examples.en: I used the egg white in the meringue for our lemon pie.
examples.zh: 我把「蛋清」用来做柠檬派上的蛋白霜。

examples.en: The recipe asks you to whisk the egg white in a separate bowl.
examples.zh: 食谱要求把「蛋清」放在单独的碗里打发。

words.enDefinition: the yellow central part of an egg

examples.en: I brushed the pastry with egg yolk before putting it in the oven.
examples.zh: 把酥皮点心放进烤箱前，我刷了层「蛋黄」。

examples.en: The egg yolk gave the lemon filling a richer color than I expected.
examples.zh: 「蛋黄」让柠檬馅的颜色比我想的更浓。

words.enDefinition: A vegetable with spongy flesh and usually purple skin

examples.en: I found the eggplant beside the peppers in the small grocery shop.
examples.zh: 我在小杂货店的甜椒旁找到了「茄子」。

examples.en: I bought a small eggplant because I was cooking dinner for one person.
examples.zh: 我只做一个人的晚饭，就买了一个小「茄子」。

words.enDefinition: The main dish in a meal on American restaurant menus

examples.en: The American menu listed a side dish with every entrée.
examples.zh: 这份美国菜单上的每道「主菜」都附一份配菜。

examples.en: Our server asked each person to choose an entrée before ordering dessert.
examples.zh: 服务员请每个人在点甜点前选一道「主菜」。

words.enDefinition: the time a meal is expected to be ready for collection

examples.en: The estimated pickup time changed while I was walking over from the sports centre.
examples.zh: 我从体育中心走过去时，「预计取餐时间」变了。

examples.en: I checked the estimated pickup time before deciding whether I could collect the order myself.
examples.zh: 我先看了「预计取餐时间」，再决定自己能不能过去拿。

words.enDefinition: The approximate amount of time before a table may become available

examples.en: The estimated wait was shorter for a table by the entrance.
examples.zh: 入口旁的桌子「预计等候时间」比较短。

examples.en: I repeated the estimated wait to my friends waiting outside the café.
examples.zh: 我把「预计等候时间」告诉了正在咖啡馆外等的朋友。

words.enDefinition: concentrated milk made by removing part of its water, generally without added sugar

examples.en: The dessert recipe called for evaporated milk rather than a carton of cream.
examples.zh: 甜点食谱需要「淡炼乳」，没用盒装奶油。

examples.en: I found evaporated milk beside the tins of coconut cream at the supermarket.
examples.zh: 我在超市的椰浆罐头旁边找到了「淡炼乳」。

collocations: use evaporated milk in a dessert

words.expression: excuse me, we’re still waiting for
words.lemma: excuse me, we’re still waiting for
words.enDefinition: A polite lead-in for asking about an order that has not arrived
acceptedEnVariants: excuse me, we’re still waiting for

examples.en: I said, "Excuse me, we’re still waiting for the soup," when the server came back.
examples.zh: 服务员回来时，我说「不好意思，我们还在等那份汤」。

examples.en: My friend said, "Excuse me, we’re still waiting for our tea," while we finished lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭快吃完时，朋友说「不好意思，我们还在等那份茶」。

collocations: say "Excuse me, we're still waiting for our soup."
say "Excuse me, we're still waiting for the rice."
say "Excuse me, we're still waiting for one dish."

words.enDefinition: An added piece or amount of lemon served with an order

examples.en: I asked for extra lemon with the water at our table.
examples.zh: 我请店员给桌上的水「多加点柠檬」。

examples.en: The server offered extra lemon when she brought me the tea.
examples.zh: 服务员给我端来茶时，问要不要「多加点柠檬」。

words.enDefinition: Additional pieces of cloth or paper for use while eating

examples.en: I asked for extra napkins after we ordered the sharing platter.
examples.zh: 我们点了分享拼盘后，我又要了「多几张餐巾」。

examples.en: The server left extra napkins on the table with the plates.
examples.zh: 服务员放下盘子，还给我们「多拿了几张餐巾」。

words.enDefinition: an additional ingredient added on top of a dish

examples.en: I chose an extra topping for my pizza because two of us were sharing it.
examples.zh: 两个人要分吃这份披萨，所以我给它「加了一份配料」。

examples.en: The menu charged for each extra topping, so I only added mushrooms this time.
examples.zh: 菜单上每「加一份配料」都要钱，所以这次我只加了蘑菇。

words.enDefinition: olive oil from mechanical extraction that meets specified quality and flavour standards

examples.en: I used extra virgin olive oil in the dressing for our tomato salad.
examples.zh: 我用「特级初榨橄榄油」给番茄沙拉做调味汁。

examples.en: The deli sold extra virgin olive oil in small dark glass bottles.
examples.zh: 熟食店的「特级初榨橄榄油」装在深色小玻璃瓶里。

collocations: a bottle of extra virgin olive oil
dress a salad with extra virgin olive oil

words.enDefinition: Still sealed as packaged by the manufacturer

examples.en: The salesperson showed me a factory-sealed jar from the same delivery at the shop.
examples.zh: 店员给我看了同一批到货的一个「原厂封装的」玻璃罐。

examples.en: I wrote factory-sealed beside the jars we had not opened for the cooking class.
examples.zh: 我在烹饪课还没开过的几个罐子旁标了「原厂封装」。

words.enDefinition: cooked so softly that the pieces can separate with very little pressure

examples.en: The onions were fall-apart tender after cooking slowly in the covered pan.
examples.zh: 洋葱在盖着盖子的锅里慢慢煮过后，「软烂到轻碰就散」。

examples.en: The slow-cooked squash was fall-apart tender by the time we served dinner.
examples.zh: 端上晚饭时，慢炖的南瓜已经「软烂到轻碰就散」。

words.enDefinition: a set of food items intended to feed several people

examples.en: We ordered a family meal to share while working on the presentation in our kitchen.
examples.zh: 我们在厨房里一起做演示稿时，点了份「多人家庭套餐」分着吃。

examples.en: The family meal included rice and three mains, so everyone had something they liked.
examples.zh: 「多人家庭套餐」有米饭和三道主菜，每个人都能选到爱吃的。

words.enDefinition: A stall selling produce directly from a farm

examples.en: The farm stand near campus had peaches from the farm's own trees that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上，学校附近的「农场直销摊」有农场自家树上结的桃子。

examples.en: We bought two corn cobs at the farm stand on our way back from town.
examples.zh: 我们从镇上回来的路上，在「农场直销摊」买了两根玉米。

words.enDefinition: The proportion or amount of fat present in a food

examples.en: I checked the fat content on both packs of ground beef.
examples.zh: 我核对了两盒牛肉末各自的「脂肪含量」。

examples.en: The labels showed a different fat content for each of the products.
examples.zh: 标签显示，两种产品的「脂肪含量」不同。

collocations: the fat content of ground beef

words.enDefinition: a crumbly brined cheese originating in Greece, typically made with sheep's milk

examples.en: We crumbled feta over cucumber and tomato for our lunch in the garden.
examples.zh: 我们午饭在花园吃，把「菲达奶酪」捏碎撒到黄瓜和番茄上。

examples.en: The grocery shop sells feta in a small packet near the olives.
examples.zh: 杂货店在橄榄旁卖小包装的「菲达奶酪」。

words.enDefinition: A soft sweet fruit with many tiny seeds

examples.en: I bought a fig from the stall after the seller offered me a sample.
examples.zh: 摊主让我试吃以后，我在摊位上买了一个「无花果」。

examples.en: This fig looked softer than the others, so I kept it on top.
examples.zh: 这个「无花果」看起来比其他的软，所以我把它放在最上面。

words.enDefinition: A small, thick steak cut from the narrower beef tenderloin

examples.en: The butcher pointed to the filet mignon at the top of the case.
examples.zh: 肉柜店员指着展示柜上层的「菲力牛排」。

examples.en: I checked the price of the filet mignon before deciding what to buy.
examples.zh: 我先看了「菲力牛排」的价格，再决定买什么。

words.enDefinition: A tool with small sharp openings for making fine shavings

examples.en: The recipe listed a fine grater among the equipment we needed.
examples.zh: 菜谱在所需用具中列了「细刨器」。

examples.en: My flatmate found the fine grater next to the measuring spoons.
examples.zh: 室友在量勺旁边找到了「细刨器」。

words.enDefinition: A strainer with very small openings for separating fine particles

examples.en: I borrowed a fine-mesh strainer for the little seeds in the dressing.
examples.zh: 我借了一个「细网滤筛」，用来滤掉酱汁里的小籽。

examples.en: The tutor explained why a fine-mesh strainer differed from a colander.
examples.zh: 老师解释了「细网滤筛」和滤水篮有什么不同。

words.enDefinition: To cut an ingredient into many very small pieces

examples.en: The recipe says to finely chop the onion for the filling.
examples.zh: 菜谱上说，要把做馅用的洋葱「剁碎」。

examples.en: We forgot to finely chop the herbs before adding them to the bowl.
examples.zh: 我们忘了把香草「剁碎」，就直接放进了碗里。

words.enDefinition: to add fresh herbs at the last stage of preparing a dish

examples.en: The recipe says to finish with fresh herbs just before serving the soup.
examples.zh: 食谱说，汤上桌前要「出锅时加新鲜香草」。

examples.en: We decided to finish with fresh herbs from the pots outside our window.
examples.zh: 我们决定「出锅时加新鲜香草」，用的是窗外花盆里种的。

collocations: finish with fresh herbs before serving
choose to finish with fresh herbs
finish with fresh herbs for freshness

words.enDefinition: Not soft when lightly pressed

examples.en: I chose a peach that was still firm to the touch for the weekend.
examples.zh: 我挑了一个「摸起来还比较硬的」桃子，打算周末吃。

examples.en: The cucumbers looked similar, so I picked one that was firm to the touch.
examples.zh: 黄瓜看起来都差不多，我就挑了一根「摸起来硬实的」。

collocations: choose fruit that's firm to the touch

words.enDefinition: A shop counter selling fish and sometimes other seafood

examples.en: I checked the fish counter for a piece of cod after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我去「鱼柜」看看有没有鳕鱼卖。

examples.en: The shop put a price board above the fish counter last week.
examples.zh: 商店上周在「鱼柜」上方装了一块价目牌。

words.enDefinition: A piece of fish cut from one side along the backbone

examples.en: We chose a fish fillet that was small enough for our pan.
examples.zh: 我们挑了一块能放进锅里的「鱼柳」。

examples.en: The counter label showed the weight of each fish fillet in grams.
examples.zh: 鱼柜标签用克标明了每块「鱼柳」的重量。

words.enDefinition: a salty liquid seasoning usually made by fermenting fish with salt

examples.en: I added fish sauce to the dressing we served with the noodle salad.
examples.zh: 我们的凉拌面配调味汁，我往里面加了「鱼露」。

examples.en: The recipe uses fish sauce with lime juice and a little sugar.
examples.zh: 食谱用「鱼露」搭配青柠汁和少量糖。

words.enDefinition: A thick crosswise slice of fish, often including a central bone

examples.en: I asked whether the fish steak was cut across the middle of the fish.
examples.zh: 我问「横切鱼排」是不是从鱼身中段横着切下来的。

examples.en: The fish steak had a round piece of bone in the center.
examples.zh: 那块「横切鱼排」中间有一块圆骨头。

collocations: a fish steak with the bone in

words.enDefinition: Oblong pieces of fish coated with breadcrumbs or batter

examples.en: My roommate bought fish sticks for an easy dinner after class.
examples.zh: 室友买了「裹糠鱼条」，打算下课后简单吃一顿。

examples.en: The picture on the fish sticks box showed how big each portion was.
examples.zh: 「裹糠鱼条」盒子上的图片展示了每份有多大。

words.enDefinition: A person who sells fish and seafood to the public

examples.en: The fishmonger showed me a smaller piece from the same fish.
examples.zh: 「鱼贩」给我看了从同一条鱼上切下的一小块。

examples.en: My roommate bought cod from a fishmonger near our campus.
examples.zh: 室友在学校附近的一位「鱼贩」那里买了鳕鱼。

words.enDefinition: a consistency that breaks naturally into thin layers or flakes

examples.en: The pastry had a flaky texture around the edges after it cooled.
examples.zh: 酥皮放凉后，边缘呈现「层层易剥开的口感」。

examples.en: The cook described how the baked fish developed a flaky texture without drying out.
examples.zh: 厨师解释烤鱼怎样在不变干的情况下，呈现「一片片易剥开的口感」。

words.enDefinition: A flat beef steak cut from the abdominal muscles

examples.en: My friend chose flank steak because the butcher could sell a smaller piece.
examples.zh: 肉柜能切一小块卖，朋友就选了「牛腹肉排」。

examples.en: The flank steak was displayed beside a card showing the cut names.
examples.zh: 「牛腹肉排」旁边放着一张写有不同部位名称的标签。

words.enDefinition: the way different flavours complement each other without one overpowering the others

examples.en: The instructor asked us to describe the flavour balance of the dressing.
examples.zh: 老师让我们描述调味汁的「风味平衡」。

examples.en: A little lemon changed the flavour balance of the soup we made.
examples.zh: 加了一点柠檬，就改变了汤里各类「风味平衡」。

words.enDefinition: the small edible seed of the flax plant

examples.en: The recipe used ground flaxseed to add texture to the homemade oat bars.
examples.zh: 食谱用磨碎的「亚麻籽」为自制燕麦棒增加口感。

examples.en: I found flaxseed on the lower shelf beside the packets of other seeds.
examples.zh: 我在下面一层货架上其他籽类包装旁边找到了「亚麻籽」。

words.enDefinition: A common name for various flatfish sold for their white flesh

examples.en: I asked where the flounder came from before buying a fillet.
examples.zh: 买鱼柳之前，我问了「鲽鱼」的产地。

examples.en: The smaller pieces of flounder were sold together in one tray.
examples.zh: 较小的几块「鲽鱼」装在一只托盘里一起卖。

words.enDefinition: A kitchen tool used to pass flour through a fine screen

examples.en: I found the flour sifter in our student kitchen's baking cupboard.
examples.zh: 我在学生厨房放烘焙用具的柜子里找到了「面粉筛」。

examples.en: The workshop displayed a flour sifter beside a bowl of flour.
examples.zh: 讲座把一个「面粉筛」摆在一碗面粉旁边。

words.enDefinition: To incorporate an ingredient while keeping a light mixture airy

examples.en: The cake recipe says to fold in the beaten egg whites.
examples.zh: 蛋糕菜谱上说，要把打发的蛋白「轻轻翻拌加入」。

examples.en: My tutor explained how the term fold in differs from vigorous mixing.
examples.zh: 老师解释了「轻轻翻拌加入」这个说法和用力搅拌有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: A card listing foods someone is allergic to

examples.en: My classmate showed a food allergy card to the staff before ordering lunch.
examples.zh: 同学点午餐之前，向店员出示了「食物过敏提示卡」。

examples.en: The food allergy card had the ingredients printed in English and Chinese.
examples.zh: 「食物过敏提示卡」用英文和中文印出了需要说明的配料。

words.enDefinition: A combination chosen so a drink complements a particular dish

examples.en: I asked the server about a food and drink pairing for the salty dishes.
examples.zh: 我问服务员偏咸的菜该怎么做「餐点饮品搭配」。

examples.en: The menu suggested a food and drink pairing with iced tea for the meal.
examples.zh: 菜单建议用冰茶做这顿饭的「餐点饮品搭配」。

collocations: suggest a food and drink pairing
try a food and drink pairing
a suggested food and drink pairing

words.enDefinition: an app used to order meals for delivery

examples.en: I opened the food delivery app to see which kitchens were still serving dinner.
examples.zh: 我打开「外卖应用」，看看还有哪些店在供应晚饭。

examples.en: We used a food delivery app because nobody at the rehearsal had time to cook.
examples.zh: 排练的人都没时间做饭，所以我们用了「外卖应用」。

collocations: order through a food delivery app

words.enDefinition: a balance available for future orders through a food delivery service

examples.en: The app offered food delivery credit that I could use on a future order.
examples.zh: 应用给了「外卖平台抵扣余额」，我可以在以后下单时用。

examples.en: I checked whether the food delivery credit would cover part of my next dinner order.
examples.zh: 我查了「外卖平台抵扣余额」能不能抵扣下次点晚饭的一部分费用。

collocations: apply food delivery credit to an order

words.enDefinition: Difficulty digesting a food or one of its ingredients

examples.en: The lunch form had a separate box for describing a food intolerance.
examples.zh: 午餐表单上有个单独的框，用来说明「食物不耐受」情况。

examples.en: My housemate mentioned a food intolerance before we planned the shared menu.
examples.zh: 我们一起定菜单前，室友提到了自己的「食物不耐受」。

words.enDefinition: Printed information identifying and describing a food product

examples.en: I turned the carton around so I could read the food label properly.
examples.zh: 我把纸盒转过来，好仔细看「食品标签」。

examples.en: Our class compared the food label on a jar with the one on its box.
examples.zh: 我们班对比了罐子上的「食品标签」和外包装盒上的标签。

words.enDefinition: A restaurant worker who carries finished dishes from kitchen to tables

examples.en: The food runner checked our table number before setting down two plates.
examples.zh: 「传菜员」核对了桌号，才把两个盘子放下。

examples.en: I told the food runner which person had ordered the soup.
examples.zh: 我告诉「传菜员」哪位客人点了汤。

collocations: a food runner from the kitchen

words.enDefinition: soft enough for a fork to go through with little resistance

examples.en: The potatoes were fork-tender when I checked them at the end of cooking.
examples.zh: 我在煮到最后检查土豆时，它们已经「能用叉子轻松扎透」。

examples.en: The roasted carrots were fork-tender, with a little colour on their edges.
examples.zh: 烤胡萝卜「用叉子能轻松扎透」，边缘还有点上色。

words.enDefinition: a soft drink served from a dispenser into a cup

examples.en: I ordered a fountain drink with my sandwich and took both back to the studio.
examples.zh: 我点三明治时配了一杯「饮料机现接的饮料」，都带回了工作室。

examples.en: The fountain drink came in a cup with a lid and a wrapped straw.
examples.zh: 「饮料机现接的饮料」装在有盖杯里，还配了单独包装的吸管。

words.enDefinition: eggs from hens raised in a system that provides access to the outdoors

examples.en: I picked up free-range eggs from the shelf under the mixed-size cartons.
examples.zh: 我从混合规格蛋盒下方的那层架子拿了「散养鸡蛋」。

examples.en: The campus café lists free-range eggs on its breakfast menu for the weekend.
examples.zh: 校内咖啡馆把「散养鸡蛋」列在周末早餐菜单上。

words.zhGloss: 建议最晚冷冻日期（美国）
words.enDefinition: Recommended last date to freeze for best quality
acceptedZhAnswers: 建议最晚冷冻日期（美国）

examples.en: I saw a freeze-by date printed beside the label on a U.S. food carton.
examples.zh: 我看到一个美国食品盒的标签旁印着「建议最晚冷冻日期」。

examples.en: The worksheet asked us to find the freeze-by date on the American sample package.
examples.zh: 练习单让我们找出美国包装样本上的「建议最晚冷冻日期」。

collocations: a freeze-by date on the box

words.enDefinition: To freeze food in separate serving-sized amounts

examples.en: I bought smaller tubs for soup because it was easier to freeze in portions.
examples.zh: 我买了些小盒子装汤，这样更容易「分份冷冻」。

examples.en: The class discussed which foods were easy to freeze in portions at home.
examples.zh: 课堂上讨论了哪些食物在家里容易「分份冷冻」。

collocations: label foods you freeze in portions

words.enDefinition: A bag designed for storing food in the freezer

examples.en: I wrote the contents on the freezer bag before putting it in our drawer.
examples.zh: 我先在「冷冻保鲜袋」上写明装的是什么，再把它放进冷冻抽屉。

examples.en: My roommate asked for a freezer bag from the box near the sink.
examples.zh: 室友让我从洗手池旁边的盒子里拿一个「冷冻保鲜袋」。

words.enDefinition: Suitable for use in a household freezer

examples.en: The label said the small container was freezer-safe and showed a snowflake symbol.
examples.zh: 标签写明这个小盒子「适合冷冻使用」，还画了一个雪花符号。

examples.en: I checked whether the lids were freezer-safe before choosing a set for the flat.
examples.zh: 给公寓挑一套盒子前，我查看了盒盖是不是也「适合冷冻使用」。

words.enDefinition: Keeping food in a freezer

examples.en: The packet included different dates for pantry storage and freezer storage.
examples.zh: 包装上分别标出了食品柜常温储存和「冷冻储存」的日期。

examples.en: My flatmates asked how much space we had available for freezer storage.
examples.zh: 室友问我们还有多大空间可以用来「冷冻储存」。

words.enDefinition: Fresh fruit and vegetables sold as food

examples.en: I stopped for fresh produce on my way back from the university library.
examples.zh: 我从学校图书馆回来的路上顺便买了些「新鲜蔬果」。

examples.en: The shop near my flat puts the fresh produce beside the entrance every morning.
examples.zh: 我住处附近的店每天早上都会把「新鲜蔬果」摆在入口旁。

words.enDefinition: Frozen completely until hard

examples.en: The soup was frozen solid when I checked the container in the drawer.
examples.zh: 我在冷冻抽屉里查看盒子时，汤已经「冻得硬邦邦的」。

examples.en: The two packs were frozen solid and stuck together in the bag.
examples.zh: 袋子里的两包东西都「冻得硬邦邦的」，还粘在了一起。

words.enDefinition: to fry small groups of food one at a time instead of all together

examples.en: I had to fry in batches because our pan was too small.
examples.zh: 我们的平底锅太小，我只好「分批煎炸」。

examples.en: The cook chose to fry in batches so the pieces would not crowd the pan.
examples.zh: 厨师选择「分批煎炸」，这样锅里放的食材不会太挤。

collocations: fry in batches to avoid crowding
fry in batches in the same pan

words.enDefinition: An edible bulb with a strong distinctive flavour

examples.en: I bought garlic at the farm stand near the bus stop after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我在公交站附近的农场直销摊买了「大蒜」。

examples.en: The garlic was in a small basket next to the bags of onions.
examples.zh: 「大蒜」放在小篮子里，旁边是几袋洋葱。

words.enDefinition: A whole head of garlic containing several cloves

examples.en: I bought a garlic bulb because the recipe only called for a few cloves.
examples.zh: 菜谱只要几瓣蒜，所以我买了「一整头大蒜」。

examples.en: The garlic bulb I chose had a dry outer skin with no visible damage.
examples.zh: 我挑的「整头大蒜」外皮干燥，看不出有破损。

words.enDefinition: A hand tool that crushes garlic by squeezing it through holes

examples.en: I found the garlic press in the drawer beside the peeler.
examples.zh: 我在抽屉里找到了「压蒜器」，就摆在削皮器旁边。

examples.en: My flatmate asked whether we had a garlic press for the dressing.
examples.zh: 室友问我们调酱汁时有没有「压蒜器」可用。

words.enDefinition: to add a small decorative or flavourful item to food before serving

examples.en: I used chopped parsley to garnish the soup before bringing it to the table.
examples.zh: 我用切碎的欧芹「点缀」这道汤，再把汤端上桌。

examples.en: The instructor showed us how to garnish the plate with thin cucumber slices.
examples.zh: 老师示范了怎样用黄瓜薄片「点缀菜品」。

words.enDefinition: a numbered oven-temperature setting used in British recipes and on some gas ovens

examples.en: The recipe gave a gas mark instead of a temperature in degrees.
examples.zh: 食谱用「燃气烤箱温度档」表示火力，没有写多少度。

examples.en: I checked which gas mark the dial was showing before baking the rolls.
examples.zh: 烤面包卷之前，我核对了旋钮指在哪个「燃气烤箱温度档」。

collocations: set the oven to gas mark four

words.enDefinition: An animal-derived substance used to set or thicken food

examples.en: I checked for gelatin before buying the dessert for our student group's lunch.
examples.zh: 我为学生小组的午餐买甜点前，查看了有没有「明胶」。

examples.en: The packet listed gelatin among the ingredients for the fruit sweets inside.
examples.zh: 包装在里面那些水果软糖的配料表中列出了「明胶」。

words.enDefinition: a type of clarified butter made by cooking butter and separating out the milk solids

examples.en: I found ghee on the shelf beside the other cooking oils and spices.
examples.zh: 我在货架上其他食用油和香料的旁边找到了「南亚式澄清黄油」。

examples.en: My flatmate used a little ghee when making rice for our shared meal.
examples.zh: 室友给我们做饭时，在煮饭里用了一点「南亚式澄清黄油」。

words.enDefinition: A knobbly underground stem with a spicy flavour

examples.en: I bought a small piece of ginger from the loose produce bin by the door.
examples.zh: 我从门边的散装蔬果箱里买了一小块「姜」。

examples.en: The ginger was next to the garlic rather than with the other root vegetables.
examples.zh: 「姜」在大蒜旁边，没和其他根菜放在一起。

words.enDefinition: To yield a little under gentle pressure

examples.en: The pears near the front give slightly when pressed, unlike the ones behind them.
examples.zh: 靠前的梨「轻按时微微下陷」，后面的那些则不同。

examples.en: I asked whether the mango should give slightly or feel completely firm today.
examples.zh: 我问这个芒果今天应该「轻按时微微下陷」，还是摸起来很硬。

words.enDefinition: Containing gluten or ingredients made with it

examples.en: The course handout asked us to underline gluten-containing grains on each sample label.
examples.zh: 课程讲义让我们在每个标签样本上给「含麸质的」谷物画下划线。

examples.en: The dining guide grouped gluten-containing dishes together for students choosing meals in advance.
examples.zh: 餐厅指南把「含麸质的」菜集中列出，方便学生提前选餐。

words.enDefinition: Proteins found in wheat and certain other grains

examples.en: The handout explained where gluten was listed on the food labels we read.
examples.zh: 讲义解释了「麸质」在我们阅读的食品标签上标在哪里。

examples.en: I checked the menu for a note about gluten before choosing the soup.
examples.zh: 选汤之前，我看了菜单上有没有关于「麸质」的说明。

words.enDefinition: a warm yellow-brown colour developed on food during cooking

examples.en: The top of the bread turned golden brown while we were setting the table.
examples.zh: 我们摆餐具时，面包顶部变成了「金褐色」。

examples.en: I took the biscuits out after their edges became golden brown in the oven.
examples.zh: 饼干边缘在烤箱里变成「金褐色」后，我把它们拿了出来。

words.enDefinition: a thick golden syrup made from sugar, common in British cooking and baking

examples.en: The British recipe listed golden syrup as an ingredient in the oat bars.
examples.zh: 那份英国食谱把「金黄糖浆」列为燕麦棒的一项配料。

examples.en: I found golden syrup in a tin near the jars of baking ingredients.
examples.zh: 我在一排瓶装烘焙食材旁找到了罐装的「金黄糖浆」。

words.enDefinition: white sugar sold as visible crystals of standard size

examples.en: I picked up a bag of granulated sugar for the kitchen's tea station.
examples.zh: 我拿了一袋「普通白砂糖」，放在厨房泡茶的地方。

examples.en: I stirred granulated sugar into the tea while it was still hot.
examples.zh: 茶还热的时候，我把「普通白砂糖」搅了进去。

words.enDefinition: A small juicy fruit that grows in clusters

examples.en: I bought grapes to share at our study group in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 我买了点「葡萄」，准备下午和学习小组的人分着吃。

examples.en: One grape had fallen from the bunch and rolled under the market stall.
examples.zh: 有一颗「葡萄」从那串上掉了下来，滚到了摊位下面。

words.enDefinition: A large citrus fruit with tart, sometimes bitter flesh

examples.en: The shop sells grapefruit individually near the oranges and lemons.
examples.zh: 店里「葡萄柚」按个卖，就在橙子和柠檬旁边。

examples.en: I picked a grapefruit from the display with the pink flesh shown on its sign.
examples.zh: 我从标签上画着粉色果肉的展台上挑了一个「葡萄柚」。

words.enDefinition: to coat the inside of a baking tin with fat to help prevent sticking

examples.en: My flatmate showed me how to grease a baking tin for the loaf.
examples.zh: 室友教我怎样「给烤模抹油」，好烤这条面包。

examples.en: I forgot to grease a baking tin before pouring the batter into it.
examples.zh: 我忘了先「给烤模抹油」，就把面糊倒进去了。

collocations: grease a baking tin with butter
grease a baking tin before adding the batter

words.enDefinition: paper that resists grease and is used to wrap food

examples.en: The café wrapped my toasted sandwich in greaseproof paper before putting it in the bag.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆先用「防油纸」包好我的烤三明治，再放进袋子。

examples.en: I unfolded the greaseproof paper and used it as a plate at the picnic.
examples.zh: 野餐时，我把「防油纸」摊开，当盘子用。

collocations: line a tray with greaseproof paper

words.enDefinition: a thick yogurt traditionally made by straining away some of its liquid

examples.en: I served Greek yogurt with chopped walnuts and a drizzle of honey.
examples.zh: 我在「希腊式浓酸奶」上撒了碎核桃，淋了点蜂蜜。

examples.en: The sandwich filling used Greek yogurt to keep the mixture thick and creamy.
examples.zh: 三明治馅用了「希腊式浓酸奶」，拌出来黏稠顺滑。

words.enDefinition: A long green pod eaten whole as a vegetable

examples.en: The market sold green beans loose, so I only took a small handful.
examples.zh: 市场的「四季豆」是散卖的，所以我只拿了一小把。

examples.en: The seller snapped a green bean in half to show how crisp it was.
examples.zh: 摊主把一根「四季豆」掰成两段，给我看它有多脆。

words.enDefinition: A person who sells fresh fruit and vegetables

examples.en: The greengrocer near my university helped me pick pears that were ready to eat.
examples.zh: 学校附近的「蔬果商」帮我挑了能直接吃的梨。

examples.en: I asked the greengrocer when the next delivery of fresh herbs would arrive.
examples.zh: 我问「蔬果商」下一批新鲜香草什么时候到货。

words.enDefinition: to cook food using strong direct heat from above or below

examples.en: We decided to grill the peppers for the sandwiches at our weekend lunch.
examples.zh: 我们决定把甜椒「烤一下」，夹进周末午饭的三明治里。

examples.en: The British recipe says to grill the cheese under the oven's top element.
examples.zh: 那份英国食谱说，把奶酪放在烤箱顶部的加热元件下面「烤」。

words.enDefinition: dark lines left on food where it touched the hot bars of a grill

examples.en: The aubergine had clear grill marks after we turned each piece over.
examples.zh: 茄子一片片翻面后，能看到清楚的「烤架焦纹」。

examples.en: My flatmate noticed the grill marks before taking the peppers off the rack.
examples.zh: 室友先看到了「烤架焦纹」，然后才把甜椒从烤架上拿下来。

words.enDefinition: Beef cut or processed into very small loose pieces

examples.en: I chose a small pack of ground beef for our shared pasta dinner.
examples.zh: 我选了一小盒「牛肉末」，晚上和室友一起做意面。

examples.en: The shop had ground beef near the other meat for burgers.
examples.zh: 店里把「牛肉末」放在其他适合做汉堡的肉旁边。

words.enDefinition: Chicken meat cut or processed into very small loose pieces

examples.en: The shop had ground chicken beside the turkey and pork mince.
examples.zh: 店里把「鸡肉末」放在火鸡肉末和猪肉末旁边。

examples.en: We bought ground chicken because our dumpling recipe used chicken rather than pork.
examples.zh: 我们的饺子菜谱用的是鸡肉，所以买了「鸡肉末」。

words.enDefinition: coffee beans that have been crushed or ground for brewing

examples.en: I bought ground coffee because I do not own a coffee grinder.
examples.zh: 我没有磨豆机，所以买了「研磨咖啡粉」。

examples.en: The shop keeps ground coffee on the shelf near the reusable filters.
examples.zh: 店里把「研磨咖啡粉」放在可重复使用的滤网附近。

words.enDefinition: powder made from cumin seeds and used as an aromatic spice

examples.en: I added ground cumin to the lentil soup we cooked for dinner.
examples.zh: 我们煮扁豆汤当晚饭，我加了「孜然粉」。

examples.en: The packet of ground cumin was on the top shelf near the curry powder.
examples.zh: 那包「孜然粉」放在最上层货架，靠近咖喱粉。

words.enDefinition: Pork that has been cut into very small loose pieces

examples.en: We bought ground pork to make dumplings with the students next door.
examples.zh: 我们买了「猪肉末」，要和隔壁的同学一起包饺子。

examples.en: The butcher put the ground pork in a separate bag for us.
examples.zh: 肉柜店员把「猪肉末」单独装了个袋子。

words.enDefinition: Turkey meat processed into very small loose pieces

examples.en: The smaller pack of ground turkey fit our budget for the meal.
examples.zh: 小盒的「火鸡肉末」在我们这顿饭的预算内。

examples.en: My roommate compared the price of ground turkey with the price of beef mince.
examples.zh: 室友比较了「火鸡肉末」和牛肉末的价格。

words.enDefinition: one order that combines food choices from several people

examples.en: Our group order let everyone choose a different lunch from the same café menu.
examples.zh: 我们用「多人合点订单」，每个人都能从同一家咖啡馆的菜单上选不同的午饭。

examples.en: I started a group order for my project team before the afternoon presentation rehearsal.
examples.zh: 下午排练汇报前，我给项目组开了个「多人合点订单」。

words.enDefinition: A tropical fruit with fragrant flesh and many seeds

examples.en: The sign said the guava in this box had pink flesh rather than white.
examples.zh: 标签写着这盒「番石榴」是粉色果肉的，不是白色的。

examples.en: I picked a guava while my roommate was choosing a bag of green grapes.
examples.zh: 室友在选一袋青葡萄时，我挑了一个「番石榴」。

words.enDefinition: sticky and somewhat rubbery in a way that can make food hard to chew

examples.en: The middle of the loaf was gummy even though the outside looked done.
examples.zh: 面包表面看着已经好了，里头却「黏韧得难嚼」。

examples.en: The noodles became gummy after I left them sitting in a crowded bowl.
examples.zh: 面条放在装得太满的碗里一会儿后，变得「黏韧得难嚼」。

words.enDefinition: A North Atlantic fish with lean, mild-tasting white flesh

examples.en: The British shop displayed haddock beside the cod and salmon.
examples.zh: 英国这家店把「黑线鳕」摆在鳕鱼和三文鱼旁边。

examples.en: I asked whether the recipe meant fresh or smoked haddock.
examples.zh: 我问菜谱指的是新鲜的还是熏制的「黑线鳕」。

words.enDefinition: Permitted under Islamic dietary rules

examples.en: I asked which meals were halal before sending our group order to the café.
examples.zh: 把团体订单发给咖啡馆之前，我问了哪些餐点「符合清真饮食要求」。

examples.en: The dinner form had a separate tick box for halal meals at the event.
examples.zh: 晚餐表单有个可单独勾选的框，用来选择活动上的「清真餐」。

words.enDefinition: Certified by an organization as meeting halal standards

examples.en: The caterer listed two halal-certified meals on the form for the campus dinner.
examples.zh: 餐饮供应商在学校晚餐的表单上列了两份「经清真认证的」餐食。

examples.en: I checked whether the halal-certified label applied to the sauce as well as the main dish.
examples.zh: 我查看了「经清真认证」的标签是不是也适用于酱汁和主菜。

words.enDefinition: Half the amount of food normally prepared in one batch

examples.en: We made half a batch because our bowl was the smallest one.
examples.zh: 我们用的是最小的碗，所以只做了「半批」。

examples.en: I asked if half a batch would be enough for our study group.
examples.zh: 我问做「半批」够不够我们学习小组吃。

words.enDefinition: a North American dairy mixture of milk and cream, often added to coffee

examples.en: The breakfast counter had half-and-half in a small jug near the cups.
examples.zh: 早餐柜台的杯子旁放着一小壶「牛奶与奶油混合乳」。

examples.en: I added half-and-half to my coffee because the milk jug was empty.
examples.zh: 装牛奶的壶空了，我就往咖啡里加了「牛奶与奶油混合乳」。

words.enDefinition: a pizza with different toppings on each of its two halves

examples.en: We ordered a half-and-half pizza because my roommate wanted mushrooms and I wanted peppers.
examples.zh: 我们点了「双拼披萨」，因为室友想吃蘑菇，我想吃甜椒。

examples.en: The shop labeled both sides of the half-and-half pizza on the outside of the box.
examples.zh: 店家在盒子外面标明了「双拼披萨」每一半是什么口味。

words.enDefinition: An order containing about half the amount of a standard portion

examples.en: I asked whether the café offered a half portion of pasta.
examples.zh: 我问咖啡馆的意面能不能点「半份」。

examples.en: My friend ordered a half portion because she wanted dessert later.
examples.zh: 朋友想过会儿再吃甜点，所以只点了「半份」。

words.enDefinition: A large marine flatfish sold for its firm white flesh

examples.en: The halibut was priced higher than the other white fish.
examples.zh: 「大比目鱼」的标价比其他白肉鱼高。

examples.en: I asked whether the fishmonger had one smaller piece of halibut.
examples.zh: 我问鱼柜店员，有没有小一点的「大比目鱼」。

words.enDefinition: a firm Cypriot cheese that holds its shape when heated

examples.en: Our café sandwich came with grilled halloumi, peppers and a little spinach.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆给我们的三明治夹了烤「哈罗米奶酪」、甜椒和一点菠菜。

examples.en: I sliced the halloumi before putting it on the grill with the vegetables.
examples.zh: 我先把「哈罗米奶酪」切片，再和蔬菜一起放上烤架。

words.enDefinition: To divide something into two equal or nearly equal parts

examples.en: I read the recipe twice before deciding which tomatoes to halve.
examples.zh: 我看了两遍菜谱，才弄清楚该把哪些番茄「对半切开」。

examples.en: My roommate asked if she should halve the lemons for us.
examples.zh: 室友问她要不要帮大家把柠檬「对半切开」。

words.enDefinition: To use half each listed amount to make less food

examples.en: I decided to halve the recipe because we had only one small bowl.
examples.zh: 我们只有一个小碗，所以我决定「把菜谱用量减半」。

examples.en: We asked the instructor whether we could halve the recipe for practice.
examples.zh: 我们问老师练习时可不可以「把菜谱用量减半」。

words.enDefinition: asks the courier to give you the order in person

examples.en: Could you hand it to me by the main entrance when you get here?
examples.zh: 你到了以后，能在正门「把餐当面交给我」吗？

examples.en: Please hand it to me because the building has nowhere sheltered to leave the bag.
examples.zh: 这栋楼没有遮雨的地方可以放袋子，「请把餐当面交给我」。

collocations: could you hand it to me at the entrance?
ask the courier to hand it to me

words.enDefinition: to boil an egg until both its white and yolk are firm

examples.en: I planned to hard-boil some eggs for the lunches we were packing.
examples.zh: 我们正准备带出门的午饭，我打算「把一些鸡蛋煮熟透」。

examples.en: The recipe says to hard-boil the eggs before adding them to the salad.
examples.zh: 食谱说，先「把鸡蛋煮熟透」，再放进沙拉。

words.enDefinition: A whole lettuce with its leaves still attached

examples.en: I bought a head of lettuce because four people were coming to dinner.
examples.zh: 有四个人要来吃晚饭，所以我买了「一整棵生菜」。

examples.en: The stallholder handed me a head of lettuce with bright green outer leaves.
examples.zh: 摊主递给我「一整棵生菜」，外层叶子是鲜绿色的。

words.enDefinition: A measuring tablespoon filled with an amount mounding above its rim

examples.en: The British recipe asked for a heaped tablespoon of cocoa powder.
examples.zh: 这份英国菜谱要求舀「满尖一汤匙」可可粉。

examples.en: My flatmate asked how a heaped tablespoon differed from a level one.
examples.zh: 室友问「满尖一汤匙」和平汤匙量有什么不同。

words.enDefinition: a rich North American cream with enough milk fat to whip well

examples.en: The pastry recipe asked for heavy cream to make the chocolate filling.
examples.zh: 糕点食谱用「高脂淡奶油」做巧克力馅。

examples.en: I found heavy cream in the refrigerated section by the half-and-half cartons.
examples.zh: 我在冷藏区半奶半奶油的盒子旁边找到了「高脂淡奶油」。

collocations: add heavy cream to a sauce

words.enDefinition: A small oily sea fish sold fresh, smoked, or pickled

examples.en: I spotted herring on the counter next to the smoked mackerel.
examples.zh: 我看到柜台上摆着「鲱鱼」，就在熏鲭鱼旁边。

examples.en: My roommate pointed to the herring in our market's fish display.
examples.zh: 室友指着市场鱼柜里的「鲱鱼」。

words.enDefinition: A tall chair allowing a small child to sit at table height

examples.en: We asked for a high chair when my friend brought her toddler.
examples.zh: 朋友带着她刚学会走路的孩子来了，我们就要了把「儿童餐椅」。

examples.en: The server moved an adult seat to make room for the high chair.
examples.zh: 服务员挪开一个成人座位，腾出地方放「儿童餐椅」。

words.enDefinition: To leave onions out of the food being ordered

examples.en: I asked the server to hold the onions on my sandwich.
examples.zh: 我请服务员在我的三明治里「不放洋葱」。

examples.en: My roommate wanted to hold the onions on one of our dishes.
examples.zh: 室友想请店员在我们的一道菜里「不放洋葱」。

collocations: a request to hold the onions

words.expression: hold the order at the counter
words.lemma: hold the order at the counter
words.zhGloss: 把餐留在柜台等我来拿
words.enDefinition: keep prepared food at the counter until the customer arrives
acceptedZhAnswers: 把餐留在柜台等我来拿
acceptedEnVariants: hold the order at the counter

examples.en: Could you hold the order at the counter until I get there after class?
examples.zh: 能「把餐留在柜台等我来拿」吗？我下课后就到。

examples.en: The staff agreed to hold the order at the counter while I finished my lab.
examples.zh: 我上完实验课前，店员同意「把餐留在柜台等我来拿」。

collocations: please hold the order at the counter
ask them to hold the order at the counter
hold the order at the counter until I arrive

words.enDefinition: A smooth-skinned melon usually with pale green flesh

examples.en: A picture on the sign showed the pale green inside of a honeydew melon.
examples.zh: 标签上的图片展示了「蜜露甜瓜」浅绿色的果肉。

examples.en: The cashier asked whether the melon in my basket was a honeydew melon.
examples.zh: 收银员问我篮子里的瓜是不是「蜜露甜瓜」。

words.enDefinition: The station where restaurant staff greet guests and assign seating

examples.en: The host stand was just inside the entrance on our left.
examples.zh: 「迎宾台」就在入口进去左手边。

examples.en: I left our reservation details with the person at the host stand.
examples.zh: 我把订位信息留给了「迎宾台」的店员。

collocations: check in at the host stand

words.enDefinition: A staffed or self-service counter offering hot prepared food

examples.en: My roommate waited at the hot food station for a bowl of rice.
examples.zh: 室友在「热食档口」等一碗米饭。

examples.en: The hot food station near the entrance served soup and baked potatoes.
examples.zh: 入口旁的「热食档口」供应汤和烤土豆。

collocations: line up at the hot food station
choose from the hot food station

words.enDefinition: A salad dressing featured as the restaurant's own choice

examples.en: I asked what the house dressing tasted like before ordering my salad.
examples.zh: 选沙拉之前，我问了「店家招牌沙拉酱」是什么味道。

examples.en: The server poured the house dressing into a small dish for me.
examples.zh: 服务员把「店家招牌沙拉酱」倒进一个小碟子给了我。

words.expression: how much longer will it be
words.lemma: how much longer will it be
words.enDefinition: asks how much more time something will take
acceptedEnVariants: how much longer will it be

examples.en: Excuse me, how much longer will it be for the two takeaway noodle bowls?
examples.zh: 你好，两碗外带面「还要等多久」？

examples.en: How much longer will it be if I add another sandwich to the order?
examples.zh: 如果再加一份三明治，「还要等多久」？

collocations: roughly, how much longer will it be?
how much longer will it be for my order?
sorry, how much longer will it be?

words.enDefinition: A question about the strength of a dish's chili heat

examples.en: I asked, "How spicy is it?" when my friend pointed out the noodle soup.
examples.zh: 朋友指着那碗汤面时，我问「这道菜有多辣？」

examples.en: My roommate said, "How spicy is it?" before deciding whether to try it.
examples.zh: 室友先问「这道菜有多辣？」再决定要不要尝。

collocations: say "How spicy is it compared with the curry?"
ask "How spicy is it without the sauce?"

words.expression: How thick would you like it sliced?
words.lemma: how thick would you like it sliced?
words.enDefinition: A counter question asking what thickness a customer prefers
acceptedEnVariants: How thick would you like it sliced?

examples.en: The clerk held up the ham and asked, "How thick would you like it sliced?"
examples.zh: 店员举起火腿问「您想切多厚？」

examples.en: The deli worker asked me, "How thick would you like it sliced?"
examples.zh: 熟食柜店员问我：「您想切多厚？」

collocations: ask "How thick would you like it sliced?"
answer "How thick would you like it sliced?"
hear "How thick would you like it sliced?" at the deli

words.enDefinition: To remove the green tops and attached cores from strawberries

examples.en: I asked whether the recipe expected us to hull strawberries for the topping.
examples.zh: 我问菜谱是不是要求把做表面装饰的草莓「去掉草莓蒂」。

examples.en: Our tutor demonstrated what it meant to hull strawberries in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 老师在厨房里给我们演示了「去掉草莓蒂」指的是什么。

words.enDefinition: says you cannot locate the building at the address given

examples.en: I can't find your building from the bike path shown on my map.
examples.zh: 按我地图上的自行车道走，「我找不到你那栋楼」。

examples.en: Sorry, I can't find your building, but I can see the main library entrance.
examples.zh: 不好意思，「我找不到你那栋楼」，不过我能看到图书馆正门。

collocations: sorry, I can't find your building
I can't find your building from the side road
I can't find your building on this map

words.enDefinition: says the food delivered was meant for a different customer

examples.en: I got someone else's order, and the name on the receipt isn't mine.
examples.zh: 「我收到了别人的餐」，小票上的名字也不是我的。

examples.en: I got someone else's order when two bags were left by the residence entrance.
examples.zh: 宿舍入口放了两袋餐，「我收到了别人的餐」。

collocations: I got someone else's order by mistake
it looks like I got someone else's order
I got someone else's order from the same restaurant

words.enDefinition: A phrase confirming your choice of the item just discussed

examples.en: The server described the soup, and I said, "I’ll go with that," right away.
examples.zh: 服务员介绍了那份汤，我当即说「我就选这个。」

examples.en: I read the description and told the server, "I’ll go with that," instead.
examples.zh: 看过说明后，我改口对服务员说「我就选这个。」

collocations: confirm with "I'll go with that, please."

words.enDefinition: A phrase telling a server to repeat someone else's order

examples.en: After my roommate ordered the soup, I said, "I’ll have the same," and smiled.
examples.zh: 室友点了汤，我笑着说「我也要一样的。」

examples.en: I pointed to her plate and said, "I’ll have the same," to the server.
examples.zh: 我指着她的盘子跟服务员说「我也要一样的」。

collocations: order by saying "I'll have the same."

words.expression: I think this is for another table
words.lemma: i think this is for another table
words.enDefinition: A polite way to tell staff a dish belongs elsewhere
acceptedEnVariants: I think this is for another table

examples.en: I said, "I think this is for another table," when the server brought us noodles.
examples.zh: 服务员给我们端来面条时，我说「这应该是另一桌点的」。

examples.en: My roommate looked at the plate and said, "I think this is for another table."
examples.zh: 室友看了看盘子，说「这应该是另一桌点的」。

collocations: say "I think this is for another table."
tell the server "I think this is for another table."
politely say "I think this is for another table."

words.enDefinition: A chilled or frozen pack used to keep things cool

examples.en: I found the ice pack in the bottom of the bag after the picnic.
examples.zh: 野餐结束后，我在袋底找到了「保冷冰袋」。

examples.en: The volunteer put an ice pack next to the bottles in the insulated bag.
examples.zh: 志愿者把一个「保冷冰袋」放在保温袋里的瓶子旁边。

collocations: pack drinks with an ice pack

words.enDefinition: A round lettuce with tightly packed crisp leaves

examples.en: I picked up iceberg lettuce because it was sold in smaller heads that day.
examples.zh: 那天「脆球生菜」有比较小的整棵卖，所以我买了一棵。

examples.en: The iceberg lettuce was next to the bags of salad in the chilled display.
examples.zh: 冷藏柜里的「脆球生菜」就在袋装沙拉菜旁边。

words.enDefinition: very finely powdered sugar used for icing, dusting or other baking

examples.en: I dusted the small cakes with icing sugar before the club meeting.
examples.zh: 社团开会前，我在小蛋糕上撒了「糖粉」。

examples.en: The frosting recipe uses icing sugar because the mixture should be smooth.
examples.zh: 糖霜食谱用的是「糖粉」，因为成品应该顺滑。

words.expression: I'll come down to get it
words.lemma: i'll come down to get it
words.enDefinition: says you will go downstairs to collect the food
acceptedEnVariants: I'll come down to get it

examples.en: I'll come down to get it as soon as my online lecture finishes.
examples.zh: 线上课一结束，「我就会下楼来取餐」。

examples.en: I'll come down to get it when you reach the entrance near the bike racks.
examples.zh: 你到了自行车架旁边的入口时，「我会下楼来取餐」。

collocations: I'll come down to get it now
I'll come down to get it from reception
wait there and I'll come down to get it

words.expression: I'll wait by the main gate
words.lemma: i'll wait by the main gate
words.enDefinition: says you will wait for someone at the main gate
acceptedEnVariants: I'll wait by the main gate

examples.en: I'll wait by the main gate with my phone while you approach the residence.
examples.zh: 你往宿舍走的时候，「我会拿着手机在正门旁等」。

examples.en: I'll wait by the main gate because the entrance near the library is closed.
examples.zh: 图书馆旁的入口关了，「我会在正门旁等」。

collocations: I'll wait by the main gate after class
I'll wait by the main gate with my phone
if it's easier, I'll wait by the main gate

words.expression: I'm here to pick up my order
words.lemma: i'm here to pick up my order
words.enDefinition: tells restaurant staff you have come to collect your order
acceptedEnVariants: I'm here to pick up my order

examples.en: Hi, I'm here to pick up my order from the app for two rice bowls.
examples.zh: 你好，「我是来取餐的」，在应用里点了两份盖饭。

examples.en: I'm here to pick up my order, but I may be a few minutes early.
examples.zh: 「我是来取餐的」，不过可能早到了几分钟。

collocations: hello, I'm here to pick up my order
I'm here to pick up my order from earlier
I'm here to pick up my order for lunch

words.expression: I'm on my way to pick it up
words.lemma: i'm on my way to pick it up
words.enDefinition: says you are travelling to collect the order now
acceptedEnVariants: I'm on my way to pick it up

examples.en: I'm on my way to pick it up and should be there before seven.
examples.zh: 「我正在过去拿餐」，应该七点前能到。

examples.en: I'm on my way to pick it up, but the bus is running late.
examples.zh: 「我正在过去拿餐」，不过公交晚点了。

collocations: I'm on my way to pick it up now
I'm on my way to pick it up from campus
just to let you know, I'm on my way to pick it up

words.expression: I'm on my way with your order
words.lemma: i'm on my way with your order
words.enDefinition: says the courier has the order and is bringing it to you
acceptedEnVariants: I'm on my way with your order

examples.en: I'm on my way with your order and should reach your building in five minutes.
examples.zh: 「我正带着你的餐过去」，大概五分钟就能到你那栋楼。

examples.en: Hi, I'm on my way with your order, but the main gate looks closed.
examples.zh: 你好，「我正带着你的餐过去」，不过正门看起来关着。

collocations: I'm on my way with your order now
I'm on my way with your order from the café
hi, I'm on my way with your order

words.enDefinition: says you are waiting outside the building at the delivery address

examples.en: I'm outside your building now, just beside the path that leads to the library.
examples.zh: 「我在你那栋楼外面」，就在通往图书馆的小路旁。

examples.en: I'm outside your building with the food, but the front door is locked.
examples.zh: 「我在你那栋楼外面」，餐也带来了，不过正门锁着。

collocations: I'm outside your building by the front door
just to let you know, I'm outside your building

words.enDefinition: says the speaker's vehicle is parked just outside the building

examples.en: I'm parked outside by the main gate because the courtyard doesn't allow cars inside.
examples.zh: 「我把车停在正门外面了」，因为院子里不让车进去。

examples.en: I'm parked outside near the library steps with two bags from the noodle shop.
examples.zh: 「我把车停在外面了」，就在图书馆台阶附近，带着面馆的两袋餐。

collocations: I'm parked outside by the main gate
I'm parked outside near the entrance

words.enDefinition: A seafood product usually made from fish paste flavored like crab

examples.en: The fish counter had imitation crab beside the tubs of real crab meat.
examples.zh: 鱼柜把「仿蟹肉」摆在装真蟹肉的盒子旁边。

examples.en: I checked the label to see what fish the imitation crab contained.
examples.zh: 我看了一下「仿蟹肉」用的是哪种鱼。

words.enDefinition: Fruit and vegetables brought in from another country

examples.en: The signs show which fruit comes from nearby farms and which is imported produce.
examples.zh: 标签标出了哪些水果来自附近农场，哪些是「进口蔬果」。

examples.en: I compared the labels on the imported produce before choosing a bag of grapes.
examples.zh: 选一袋葡萄之前，我对照看了「进口蔬果」的标签。

words.enDefinition: a message service for help without leaving the app

examples.en: I opened the in-app support chat after receiving only one of the two lunch boxes.
examples.zh: 两份盒装午餐只收到一份，我就打开了「应用内客服聊天」。

examples.en: The in-app support chat asked which restaurant had prepared the order we received.
examples.zh: 「应用内客服聊天」里问我们收到的餐是哪家餐厅做的。

collocations: contact someone through the in-app support chat

words.enDefinition: At the usual time of harvest and availability

examples.en: The stallholder said the figs were in season and would come in again on Friday.
examples.zh: 摊主说，无花果「正当季」，周五还会再到货。

examples.en: I asked whether asparagus was in season when I saw it near the entrance.
examples.zh: 我在入口附近看到芦笋，就问现在是不是「正当季」。

words.enDefinition: A smaller dish that is part of the meal as listed

examples.en: The salad was an included side on the menu we saw online.
examples.zh: 我们在网上看的菜单上，沙拉是「随餐配菜」。

examples.en: I asked if rice was an included side for the fish.
examples.zh: 我问那道鱼有没有米饭当「随餐配菜」。

collocations: an included side with the meal

words.enDefinition: heat that reaches food from around it rather than from directly underneath or above

examples.en: The recipe uses indirect heat to cook the vegetables more gently on the grill.
examples.zh: 食谱让蔬菜在烤架上「间接受热」，这样火候更柔和。

examples.en: I asked which side of the grill was set up for indirect heat.
examples.zh: 我问烧烤架哪一侧设成了「间接受热」区。

words.enDefinition: A list of the items needed to make a recipe

examples.en: We checked the ingredient list before heading to the campus grocery store.
examples.zh: 去学校的食品杂货店之前，我们核对了「食材清单」。

examples.en: The ingredient list showed the amount of flour needed for each batch.
examples.zh: 「食材清单」写明每一批需要多少面粉。

words.enDefinition: The use of one ingredient in place of another

examples.en: I asked whether the ingredient substitution had changed the allergen information for the dish.
examples.zh: 我问「配料替换」是否改变了这道菜的过敏原信息。

examples.en: The dining team explained why an ingredient substitution wasn't possible for that sauce.
examples.zh: 餐厅工作人员解释了为什么那种酱汁不能做「配料替换」。

collocations: an ingredient substitution on the menu

words.enDefinition: fine dry yeast that is commonly mixed directly with dry ingredients

examples.en: I checked whether the recipe called for instant yeast before buying the packet.
examples.zh: 我在买那包酵母前，确认食谱用的是「即溶干酵母」。

examples.en: The shop sold instant yeast in a small box of individual sachets.
examples.zh: 商店的「即溶干酵母」是小盒装，里面分成了小袋。

words.enDefinition: A bag lined to slow temperature changes

examples.en: I brought an insulated bag for the groceries I was carrying back on the bus.
examples.zh: 我带了个「保温袋」，装要坐公交带回去的食品。

examples.en: The shop delivered the chilled items in an insulated bag with a zip.
examples.zh: 店家用一个带拉链的「保温袋」运送冷藏食品。

collocations: carry food in an insulated bag
pack groceries in an insulated bag

words.enDefinition: a lined bag designed to keep food warm or cold during delivery

examples.en: The courier placed both meals in an insulated delivery bag before leaving the café.
examples.zh: 配送员把两份餐都放进「保温送餐袋」，然后离开了咖啡馆。

examples.en: I saw the insulated delivery bag first when the driver arrived at the main gate.
examples.zh: 配送员到正门时，我最先看到的是「保温送餐袋」。

collocations: put an order in an insulated delivery bag

words.enDefinition: A seal that has not been broken

examples.en: I noticed the intact seal below the lid when I picked up the tub.
examples.zh: 我拿起盒子时，看到盖子下面有「完好的封口」。

examples.en: The volunteer asked which jars still had an intact seal at the food stall.
examples.zh: 志愿者在食品摊上问哪些罐子还有「完好的封口」。

collocations: a jar with an intact seal
an intact seal under the cap

words.enDefinition: A question about whether food is prepared apart

examples.en: Is it prepared separately from the dishes that have peanuts in the sauce?
examples.zh: 「这道菜是和酱里含花生的那些菜分开做的吗」？

examples.en: I asked, “Is it prepared separately?” before choosing a dish from the buffet.
examples.zh: 从自助餐里选菜前，我问：「这道菜是分开做的吗？」

collocations: check by asking “Is it prepared separately?”

words.enDefinition: A question about whether broth contains meat or fish

examples.en: I asked, “Is the broth vegetarian?” before choosing the noodle soup with mushrooms.
examples.zh: 我选蘑菇汤面前问：「汤底是素的吗？」

examples.en: Is the broth vegetarian, or does it contain chicken stock from the kitchen?
examples.zh: 「汤底是素的吗」，还是厨房在里面加了鸡高汤？

collocations: “Is the broth vegetarian or made with chicken stock?”

words.enDefinition: says the ordering system does not recognize your address

examples.en: It can't find my address when I type the name of my residence.
examples.zh: 我输入宿舍名字时，「系统找不到我的地址」。

examples.en: It can't find my address, so I'm checking what postcode the university uses.
examples.zh: 「系统找不到我的地址」，所以我在查学校用的是哪个邮编。

collocations: it can't find my address in the app
it can't find my address on campus
for some reason, it can't find my address

words.expression: it won't let me select pickup
words.lemma: it won't let me select pickup
words.enDefinition: reports that the ordering system will not allow pickup
acceptedEnVariants: it won't let me select pickup

examples.en: It won't let me select pickup, but I'm already walking past the café after class.
examples.zh: 「系统不让我选自提」，可我下课后正好会经过咖啡馆。

examples.en: It won't let me select pickup for the soup, even though the café is open.
examples.zh: 点这份汤时「系统不让我选自提」，可咖啡馆明明还开着。

collocations: it won't let me select pickup today
it won't let me select pickup for this order
for some reason, it won't let me select pickup

words.enDefinition: a fragrant variety of long-grain rice associated especially with Thailand

examples.en: My roommate used jasmine rice for the meal we shared after class.
examples.zh: 下课后一起吃的那顿饭，室友用的是「茉莉香米」。

examples.en: I compared the price of jasmine rice in two shops near campus.
examples.zh: 我比较了学校附近两家店的「茉莉香米」价格。

collocations: serve a curry with jasmine rice

words.enDefinition: To cut vegetables or fruit into thin matchstick-shaped pieces

examples.en: The recipe says to julienne the carrots before mixing the salad.
examples.zh: 菜谱说胡萝卜要「切成细条」，然后再拌沙拉。

examples.en: My roommate asked what it meant to julienne a cucumber.
examples.zh: 室友问，把黄瓜「切成细条」具体指什么样的切法。

words.enDefinition: Shrimp sold under a label indicating a notably large size

examples.en: The worker showed me jumbo shrimp and another size that cost less.
examples.zh: 店员给我看了「特大虾」，还有一种更便宜的规格。

examples.en: I counted the jumbo shrimp through the clear top of the pack.
examples.zh: 我透过透明盒盖数了数里面有几只「特大虾」。

words.enDefinition: A cabbage relative with loose, often curly leaves

examples.en: The market sold kale in bunches beside the crates of other leafy vegetables.
examples.zh: 市场把「羽衣甘蓝」按把出售，摆在其他叶菜的箱子旁边。

examples.en: I chose the kale with smaller leaves because I was buying for just myself.
examples.zh: 我只买自己吃的量，就选了叶子小一点的「羽衣甘蓝」。

words.enDefinition: A label instruction to store food frozen

examples.en: The packet of berries had the words keep frozen printed near the fold.
examples.zh: 莓果包装靠近折边的位置印着「请冷冻保存」。

examples.en: I found keep frozen below the picture on the side of the pizza box.
examples.zh: 我在披萨盒侧面图片的下方找到了「请冷冻保存」。

words.enDefinition: A label instruction to keep food in a refrigerator

examples.en: The words keep refrigerated were printed on the side of the juice bottle.
examples.zh: 果汁瓶侧面印着「请冷藏保存」。

examples.en: I turned the carton to check which side said keep refrigerated before unpacking the groceries.
examples.zh: 拆开买的东西前，我转了转纸盒，看看哪一面写着「请冷藏保存」。

words.enDefinition: a fermented milk drink traditionally made with a mixed culture of bacteria and yeast

examples.en: I tried kefir for the first time with fruit from the breakfast bar.
examples.zh: 我第一次喝「开菲尔发酵乳」，配着早餐台上的水果。

examples.en: The convenience store sells kefir in small bottles beside the other yogurt drinks.
examples.zh: 便利店把小瓶装「开菲尔发酵乳」和其他酸奶饮品放在一起卖。

words.enDefinition: beans shaped like a kidney, commonly available in red or white varieties

examples.en: We added kidney beans to the tomato stew for our student society dinner.
examples.zh: 我们给学生社团聚餐做炖番茄，往里加了「芸豆」。

examples.en: I found kidney beans in a can next to the chickpeas and lentils.
examples.zh: 我在鹰嘴豆和扁豆旁边找到了罐装「芸豆」。

collocations: add kidney beans to a stew

words.enDefinition: Relatively large prawns marketed under a common British retail name

examples.en: The British shop sold king prawns alongside smaller prawns in the case.
examples.zh: 英国这家商店把「大虾」和小一些的虾摆在同一个柜里。

examples.en: I checked how much the king prawns weighed before choosing a pack.
examples.zh: 选包装之前，我看了里面的「大虾」有多重。

words.enDefinition: Words used to say food preparation has ended for the day

examples.en: The server said, "The kitchen is closed," but offered us drinks.
examples.zh: 服务员说「厨房停止接单了」，不过还可以给我们上饮料。

examples.en: The notice said, "The kitchen is closed," so we chose another café.
examples.zh: 告示上写着「厨房停止接单了」，我们就换了家咖啡馆。

collocations: a sign saying the kitchen is closed
be told the kitchen is closed
hear that the kitchen is closed

words.enDefinition: A device used to measure the weight of food or ingredients

examples.en: The kitchen scale showed how much flour was still in the bowl.
examples.zh: 「厨房秤」显示碗里还剩多少面粉。

examples.en: I asked whether the student kitchen had a kitchen scale we could borrow.
examples.zh: 我问学生厨房有没有「厨房秤」可以借用。

collocations: weigh ingredients on a kitchen scale

words.enDefinition: A small fruit with brown skin and seed-filled flesh

examples.en: The kiwifruit near the bananas had a label showing green flesh inside.
examples.zh: 香蕉旁边的「猕猴桃」有个标签，图上画的是绿色果肉。

examples.en: I put three kiwifruit in the basket to share with my flatmates after dinner.
