examples.zh: 我往篮子里放了三个「猕猴桃」，打算晚饭后和室友分着吃。

words.zhGloss: 符合犹太教饮食要求的
words.enDefinition: Permitted under Jewish dietary rules
acceptedZhAnswers: 符合犹太教饮食要求的

examples.en: I asked whether a kosher meal could be ordered for the campus welcome dinner.
examples.zh: 我问学校的迎新晚餐能不能订一份「符合犹太教饮食要求的」餐点。

examples.en: The dinner organizer noted the kosher request beside the name on the list.
examples.zh: 晚餐组织者在名单姓名旁记下了「犹太教饮食要求」。

words.enDefinition: A mark used to indicate kosher certification

examples.en: I looked for a kosher symbol beside the ingredients on the snack packet.
examples.zh: 我查看零食包装的配料表旁有没有「犹太洁食认证标志」。

examples.en: The website showed the kosher symbol printed on each pack from this supplier.
examples.zh: 网站展示了这家供应商每个包装上印的「犹太洁食认证标志」。

collocations: a kosher symbol on the package

words.enDefinition: put identifying labels on the containers holding each person's food

examples.en: Could you label the boxes with our names so we can hand them out faster?
examples.zh: 能「给餐盒贴上每个人名字的标签」吗？这样我们能发得快些。

examples.en: The café offered to label the boxes before stacking them in the delivery bag.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆提出先「给餐盒贴标签」，再叠放到送餐袋里。

collocations: ask them to label the boxes

words.enDefinition: To mark a container with identifying information

examples.en: I borrowed a marker to label the container with my name before dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭前，我借了支记号笔，「在容器上标了我的名字」。

examples.en: My roommate asked whether we could label the container before putting it away.
examples.zh: 室友问我们能不能在把盒子收起来前先「给容器贴标签」。

collocations: label the container with a date
use a sticker to label the container

words.enDefinition: A vegetarian who eats both dairy and eggs

examples.en: The welcome dinner form let me specify that I was a lacto-ovo vegetarian.
examples.zh: 迎新晚餐的表单允许我注明自己是「蛋奶素食者」。

examples.en: My classmate described herself as a lacto-ovo vegetarian when we planned the group lunch.
examples.zh: 我们筹划小组午餐时，同学说自己是「蛋奶素食者」。

words.enDefinition: Labelled as free of lactose, a milk sugar

examples.en: I bought lactose-free milk after my roommate pointed out the shelf label.
examples.zh: 室友指给我看货架标签后，我买了「不含乳糖的」牛奶。

examples.en: The café's menu listed lactose-free milk in a note under the hot drinks.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆在热饮下的注释里列出了「不含乳糖的」牛奶。

words.enDefinition: milk made suitable for a lactose-free diet by removing or breaking down its lactose

examples.en: I bought lactose-free milk because a guest asked for it with breakfast.
examples.zh: 有客人想在早餐时喝「无乳糖牛奶」，我就买了一盒。

examples.en: The campus shop carries lactose-free milk in the same cooler as whole milk.
examples.zh: 校内商店把「无乳糖牛奶」和全脂牛奶放在同一个冷柜。

words.enDefinition: Meat from a young sheep sold as food

examples.en: The market sold lamb in small cuts suitable for two people.
examples.zh: 市场里有小块的「羊羔肉」卖，够两个人吃。

examples.en: Our recipe called for lamb, so we went to the butcher's counter.
examples.zh: 我们的菜谱要用「羊羔肉」，就去了肉柜。

words.enDefinition: A small cut of lamb often containing a rib or loin bone

examples.en: I bought one lamb chop because my flatmate had brought other food.
examples.zh: 室友带了其他吃的，所以我只买了一块「羊排」。

examples.en: The butcher picked a lamb chop of the size I had requested.
examples.zh: 肉柜店员照我说的大小挑了一块「羊排」。

collocations: a lamb chop from the loin

words.enDefinition: A cut of lamb from the lower part of the leg

examples.en: The butcher showed me which tray held the lamb shank I had ordered.
examples.zh: 肉柜店员指给我看哪个托盘里放着我预订的「羊小腿肉」。

examples.en: I bought a lamb shank to share with my roommate on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我买了一块「羊小腿肉」，准备周日和室友一起吃。

words.enDefinition: Rendered pig fat used in cooking

examples.en: I asked whether the pastry contained lard before ordering it for the meeting.
examples.zh: 我问了糕点是否含「猪油」，再决定要不要给会议订。

examples.en: The guide listed lard as an ingredient in one version of the pastry.
examples.zh: 指南把「猪油」列在其中一种糕点的配料表里。

words.enDefinition: The final time when customers can request food or drinks

examples.en: We arrived before last orders and still had time to choose.
examples.zh: 我们在「最后一轮点单」之前到了，还有时间选菜。

examples.en: The café announced last orders as our study group was leaving.
examples.zh: 学习小组准备离开时，咖啡馆提醒大家「最后一轮点单」了。

words.enDefinition: the latest time a restaurant will hand over a prepared order

examples.en: I checked the last pickup time before offering to collect dinner after band practice.
examples.zh: 提出乐队排练后去拿晚饭前，我查了「最晚取餐时间」。

examples.en: The last pickup time is earlier during the break, even on Friday evenings.
examples.zh: 放假期间「最晚取餐时间」提前了，连周五晚上也一样。

collocations: ask about the last pickup time
make it before the last pickup time

words.enDefinition: Vegetables grown mainly for their edible green leaves

examples.en: I looked for leafy greens that would fit in our small shared fridge.
examples.zh: 我找了些放得进我们共用小冰箱的「绿叶蔬菜」。

examples.en: The stallholder moved the leafy greens into the shade when the market opened.
examples.zh: 市场开门时，摊主把「绿叶蔬菜」搬到了阴凉处。

words.enDefinition: A container designed to stop liquid escaping

examples.en: I packed the dressing in a leakproof container before putting it in my bag.
examples.zh: 我先把沙拉酱装进「防漏容器」，再放进包里。

examples.en: My flatmate lent me a leakproof container for the soup left after dinner.
examples.zh: 室友借给我一个「防漏容器」，用来装晚饭剩下的汤。

collocations: pack soup in a leakproof container

words.enDefinition: Ground meat sold as having a relatively low fat content

examples.en: I found lean mince near the bottom of the supermarket display.
examples.zh: 我在超市展示柜的下层找到了「瘦肉末」。

examples.en: The lean mince came in a smaller pack than the regular kind.
examples.zh: 比起普通肉末，「瘦肉末」的包装要小一些。

words.enDefinition: asks the courier to put the order outside your door

examples.en: Could you leave it at my door while I'm finishing an online seminar upstairs?
examples.zh: 我在楼上快上完线上研讨课了，能「把餐放我门口」吗？

examples.en: Please leave it at my door and send me a message once you're downstairs.
examples.zh: 「请把餐放我门口」，等你下楼后给我发个消息。

collocations: please leave it at my door
could you leave it at my door?
ask the courier to leave it at my door

words.enDefinition: asks the courier to give the order to staff at reception

examples.en: Please leave it with reception because I'm running late at the library this afternoon.
examples.zh: 我今天下午在图书馆耽误了，「请把餐交给前台」。

examples.en: Could you leave it with reception so my flatmate can pick it up later?
examples.zh: 能「把餐交给前台」吗？我室友一会儿可以去拿。

collocations: could you leave it with reception?
ask the courier to leave it with reception

words.enDefinition: To avoid getting too full to enjoy something sweet afterward

examples.en: My roommate picked a small dish to leave room for dessert after lunch.
examples.zh: 室友点了一份小菜，要「留点肚子吃甜点」。

examples.en: We decided to share the pasta so we could leave room for dessert.
examples.zh: 我们决定分着吃意面，好「留点肚子吃甜点」。

collocations: try to leave room for dessert
want to leave room for dessert
remember to leave room for dessert

words.enDefinition: A mild onion relative with a long pale stalk

examples.en: The leek wouldn't fit in my small bag, so I carried it by hand.
examples.zh: 这根「韭葱」放不进我的小袋子，我就拿在手上。

examples.en: I asked whether each leek was sold separately or priced by the bunch.
examples.zh: 我问「韭葱」是按根卖还是按把计价。

words.enDefinition: A cut of meat from one of a lamb's hind legs

examples.en: I asked whether the shop sold half a leg of lamb around the holidays.
examples.zh: 我问店里节日期间有没有半条「羊腿肉」卖。

examples.en: My neighbor picked a leg of lamb for a meal with visiting friends.
examples.zh: 邻居选了一条「羊腿肉」，准备和来访的朋友一起吃。

words.enDefinition: A yellow citrus fruit with sour juice

examples.en: I bought a lemon because the ones at home had already been used.
examples.zh: 家里的都用完了，我又买了一个「柠檬」。

examples.en: The lemon I picked had smooth yellow skin and felt heavy for its size.
examples.zh: 我挑的「柠檬」果皮又黄又光滑，个头不大但拿着挺沉。

words.enDefinition: To leave a prepared mixture of flour and liquid undisturbed

examples.en: The recipe says to let the dough rest while we prepare the filling.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，准备馅料时可以「让面团静置」。

examples.en: I asked why we needed to let the dough rest before shaping it.
examples.zh: 我问为什么整形之前要「让面团静置」。

collocations: let the dough rest before shaping
let the dough rest in the bowl
let the dough rest on the counter

words.enDefinition: To make dry ingredients even with the rim of a measure

examples.en: The tutor explained what it means to level off the top of the cup.
examples.zh: 老师解释了给量杯「刮平顶部」是什么意思。

examples.en: I asked whether we should level off the top before adding the flour.
examples.zh: 我问把面粉倒进去之前需不需要「刮平顶部」。

collocations: level off the top of the cup
use a straight edge to level off the top

words.enDefinition: The amount that fills a measuring tablespoon exactly to its rim

examples.en: I checked whether the recipe meant a level tablespoon of sugar.
examples.zh: 我核对了菜谱说的是不是一「平汤匙量」的糖。

examples.en: The tutor showed us what a level tablespoon of cocoa looked like.
examples.zh: 老师给我们看了一「平汤匙量」可可粉是什么样子。

words.enDefinition: Prepared with less salt than would normally be used

examples.en: My roommate asked for the fries light on the salt at lunch today.
examples.zh: 今天午饭时，室友请店员给薯条「少放点盐」。

examples.en: I told the server I preferred the soup light on the salt this time.
examples.zh: 我告诉服务员，这次希望汤里「少放点盐」。

collocations: ask for it light on the salt
serve it light on the salt

words.enDefinition: a thinner Chinese soy sauce used mainly for flavouring and seasoning

examples.en: I added light soy sauce to the dressing for our noodle salad.
examples.zh: 我在凉拌面的调料里加了「生抽」。

examples.en: The shop keeps light soy sauce separately from the darker type used for colour.
examples.zh: 商店把「生抽」和用来上色的深色酱油分开摆放。

collocations: a splash of light soy sauce

words.enDefinition: to coat a pan with a small amount of cooking oil

examples.en: I remembered to lightly oil the pan before adding the first pancake.
examples.zh: 放第一张薄饼前，我记得「在锅里薄薄抹油」。

examples.en: The recipe says to lightly oil the pan so the cakes lift easily.
examples.zh: 食谱说要「在锅里薄薄抹油」，这样饼比较容易铲起来。

collocations: lightly oil the pan before cooking
lightly oil the pan with a brush
make sure to lightly oil the pan

words.enDefinition: A small citrus fruit with sour juice and typically green skin

examples.en: The limes were next to the lemons in a separate crate by the door.
examples.zh: 「青柠」就在柠檬旁边，摆在门边一个单独的箱子里。

examples.en: I asked whether I could buy one lime instead of taking the whole bag.
examples.zh: 我问能不能只买一个「青柠」，不用买整袋。

words.enDefinition: to cover the inside of a baking tin with paper or another lining

examples.en: The recipe says to line the tin before making the brownie mixture.
examples.zh: 食谱说，制作布朗尼面糊之前，要「给烤模铺纸」。

examples.en: I used a small sheet of parchment to line the tin for baking.
examples.zh: 我用一小片烘焙纸「给烤模铺纸」，准备烘烤。

words.enDefinition: A marked container with space for measuring and pouring liquids

examples.en: I used the liquid measuring cup for the milk in the recipe.
examples.zh: 我用「液体量杯」量菜谱所需的牛奶。

examples.en: The liquid measuring cup had lines for both milliliters and fluid ounces.
examples.zh: 「液体量杯」上同时有毫升和液量盎司刻度。

words.enDefinition: Amounts explicitly stated in an ingredient list or recipe

examples.en: I put all the listed quantities into one column on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我把所有「列明的用量」都填在了练习表的一栏。

examples.en: We followed the listed quantities when testing the recipe for class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上试做这个菜谱时，按的是「列明的用量」。

words.enDefinition: The rear section of a lobster sold for its meat

examples.en: I checked the price of a lobster tail at the market.
examples.zh: 我在市场看了一下一个「龙虾尾」的价格。

examples.en: The fishmonger put the lobster tail in a separate bag for us.
examples.zh: 鱼柜店员把「龙虾尾」单独装了个袋子给我们。

words.enDefinition: Grown within the surrounding area

examples.en: I asked which apples were locally grown before choosing some for my flatmates.
examples.zh: 给室友挑苹果前，我先问了哪些是「本地种植的」。

examples.en: The label said the pears were locally grown and named the farm that supplied them.
examples.zh: 标签写明梨是「本地种植的」，还列了供货农场的名字。

words.enDefinition: rice with slender grains that generally stay separate when cooked

examples.en: I used long-grain rice in the lunch boxes we made for the trip.
examples.zh: 我们做出游便当时用了「长粒米」。

examples.en: The grocery store sells long-grain rice in bags of three different sizes.
examples.zh: 杂货店的「长粒米」有三种大小的包装。

words.enDefinition: A flour-based mixture thin enough to pour or spread easily

examples.en: A little more milk gave us a loose batter for the pancakes.
examples.zh: 多加了一点牛奶后，我们得到了做薄饼用的「稀面糊」。

examples.en: The recipe photo showed a loose batter running off the spoon.
examples.zh: 菜谱照片里的「稀面糊」正从勺子上往下流。

words.enDefinition: tea leaves sold loose instead of sealed inside individual tea bags

examples.en: I used loose-leaf tea in the small pot we kept in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我用厨房里的小茶壶泡了「散装茶叶」。

examples.en: The market sold loose-leaf tea by weight from large labelled tins.
examples.zh: 市场把「散装茶叶」放在标了标签的大罐里，按重量卖。

words.enDefinition: Fruit and vegetables sold without fixed packaging

examples.en: I bought loose produce because I only needed two pears and one pepper.
examples.zh: 我只要两个梨和一个甜椒，所以买了「散装蔬果」。

examples.en: The shop has separate labels for loose produce and bags of the same vegetables.
examples.zh: 这家店把「散装蔬果」和同款袋装蔬菜分开贴标签。

words.enDefinition: a gentle cooking setting that supplies relatively little heat

examples.en: I kept the sauce over low heat while the others set the table.
examples.zh: 其他人摆餐具时，我让酱汁用「小火」继续加热。

examples.en: The recipe used low heat to melt the butter without browning it.
examples.zh: 食谱用「小火」把黄油融化，同时不让它变褐。

words.enDefinition: Picked crab meat sold in recognizable chunks rather than shreds

examples.en: I asked whether the lump crab meat came in a smaller container.
examples.zh: 我问「块状蟹肉」有没有更小的盒装。

examples.en: We chose the lump crab meat for a salad we planned to share.
examples.zh: 我们选了「块状蟹肉」，打算做一份大家一起吃的沙拉。

collocations: a tub of lump crab meat
a pack of lump crab meat

words.enDefinition: A mixture in which all visible lumps have been broken up

examples.en: The recipe photo showed a lump-free mixture before the cocoa was added.
examples.zh: 菜谱照片展示了加可可粉之前「无结块的混合物」。

examples.en: I compared our lump-free mixture with the picture on the recipe page.
examples.zh: 我把我们的「无结块的混合物」和菜谱页上的图片作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A list of dishes offered specifically during lunch service

examples.en: The café still had its lunch menu when we arrived after class.
examples.zh: 我们下课后到咖啡馆时，还能点「午餐菜单」上的菜。

examples.en: I showed my friend the lunch menu posted outside the entrance.
examples.zh: 我给朋友看了入口外贴着的「午餐菜单」。

words.enDefinition: A legume whose seeds are processed into food ingredients

examples.en: I first saw lupin listed as an ingredient on a packet in England.
examples.zh: 我第一次看到配料表中列出「羽扇豆」，是在英格兰。

examples.en: The ingredient guide explained why lupin appeared in the flour blend for these rolls.
examples.zh: 配料说明解释了为什么做这些餐包的混合面粉里有「羽扇豆」。

words.enDefinition: A small fruit with rough skin and translucent flesh

examples.en: The shop had a picture showing how much flesh was inside one lychee.
examples.zh: 店里有张图片，展示了一颗「荔枝」里面有多少果肉。

examples.en: I chose lychees from the market stall to share during our afternoon break.
examples.zh: 我在市场摊位上挑了些「荔枝」，准备下午休息时和大家分享。

words.enDefinition: An oily sea fish with a strong, distinctive flavor

examples.en: The deli used the same case for smoked mackerel and salmon.
examples.zh: 熟食柜把熏制的「鲭鱼」和三文鱼放在一个展示柜里。

examples.en: I found one mackerel left in the fishmonger's ice display.
examples.zh: 我发现鱼柜的冰台上只剩一条「鲭鱼」。

words.enDefinition: Produced using machinery that handles other foods too

examples.en: The packet says the biscuits are made on shared equipment with products containing nuts.
examples.zh: 包装说，这些饼干和含坚果的产品「使用共用设备生产」。

examples.en: I asked what else was made on shared equipment at the bakery by campus.
examples.zh: 我问学校旁那家面包店，还有什么食品「使用同一套设备生产」。

collocations: made on shared equipment with other products
marked as made on shared equipment

words.enDefinition: A dining counter where staff prepare dishes for each individual order

examples.en: We chose the made-to-order station so we could select our sandwich fillings.
examples.zh: 为了自己选三明治的馅料，我们去了「现点现做档口」。

examples.en: The made-to-order station was open when I arrived after my lecture.
examples.zh: 我下课后赶到时，「现点现做档口」还在营业。

words.expression: make a well in the center
words.lemma: make a well in the center
words.enDefinition: To create a hollow in the middle of dry ingredients
acceptedEnVariants: make a well in the center
make a well in the centre

examples.en: The card says to make a well in the center once the flour is in the bowl.
examples.zh: 菜谱卡上说，面粉放进碗里后要「在中间挖个凹坑」。

examples.en: I checked whether to make a well in the center before adding the eggs.
examples.zh: 我核对了加鸡蛋之前是否要「在中间挖个凹坑」。

collocations: make a well in the center of the flour
make a well in the center before pouring
use a spoon to make a well in the center

words.enDefinition: to prepare food before the time when it will be needed or served

examples.en: The sauce was easy to make ahead for our evening group dinner.
examples.zh: 为晚上聚餐，可以很方便地把酱汁「提前做好」。

examples.en: I chose a dessert that I could make ahead before my class.
examples.zh: 我挑了一种能在上课前「提前做好」的甜点。

collocations: a dish you can make ahead
choose a recipe to make ahead

words.enDefinition: A small round citrus fruit with loose skin

examples.en: I bought a mandarin orange for my bag because it's easy to peel.
examples.zh: 我买了一个「橘子」放在包里，因为它好剥皮。

examples.en: My roommate put a mandarin orange and some grapes on each lunch tray.
examples.zh: 室友在每个午餐盘里放了一个「橘子」和几颗葡萄。

words.enDefinition: A board-shaped kitchen tool for cutting food into even slices

examples.en: The demo showed the mandoline slicer beside a tray of cucumber slices.
examples.zh: 演示时，「板式切片器」放在一盘黄瓜片旁边。

examples.en: I asked whether the mandoline slicer belonged to our shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 我问这个「板式切片器」是不是我们共用厨房的。

words.enDefinition: A sweet tropical fruit with one large flat stone

examples.en: I chose a mango from the smaller crate for our picnic on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我从小一点的箱子里挑了一个「芒果」，准备周六野餐吃。

examples.en: The sticker on this mango showed its variety and the country where it grew.
examples.zh: 这个「芒果」的贴纸上写了品种和种植国。

words.enDefinition: a sweet syrup made by concentrating the sap of maple trees

examples.en: We poured maple syrup over the pancakes at our shared Sunday breakfast.
examples.zh: 周日一起吃早饭时，我们往薄煎饼上淋了「枫糖浆」。

examples.en: The shop sells maple syrup near the honey and other sweet spreads.
examples.zh: 商店把「枫糖浆」放在蜂蜜和其他甜味抹酱旁边。

words.enDefinition: Small streaks of fat distributed within the muscle of meat

examples.en: The butcher showed me the marbling in two different steaks.
examples.zh: 肉柜店员给我看了两块牛排「肉里的脂肪纹理」。

examples.en: I asked what the word marbling meant on the display card.
examples.zh: 我问展示标签上那个词「肉里的脂肪纹理」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a butter-like spread usually made from vegetable oils

examples.en: I used margarine to grease the tin before making the banana loaf.
examples.zh: 我做香蕉面包前，用「人造黄油」给烤模抹了油。

examples.en: The recipe notes that margarine can be used in some versions of the cake.
examples.zh: 食谱注明，这种蛋糕有些做法可以用「人造黄油」。

words.enDefinition: A flavored liquid used to season food before it is cooked

examples.en: I mixed the marinade while my flatmate checked the recipe.
examples.zh: 我调「腌汁」时，室友在核对菜谱。

examples.en: The marinade for the tofu included soy sauce and lemon juice.
examples.zh: 豆腐用的「腌汁」里有酱油和柠檬汁。

words.zhGloss: 标为已送达但还没收到
words.enDefinition: says the app shows delivery completed although the food is missing
acceptedZhAnswers: 标为已送达但还没收到

examples.en: My dinner is marked delivered but hasn't arrived at the residence desk or door.
examples.zh: 我的晚餐「标为已送达但还没收到」，宿舍前台和门口都没有。

examples.en: It's marked delivered but hasn't arrived, and the driver hasn't sent me a photo.
examples.zh: 「标为已送达但还没收到」，配送员也没给我发照片。

collocations: my order is marked delivered but hasn't arrived
report that it is marked delivered but hasn't arrived
the food is marked delivered but hasn't arrived

words.enDefinition: To crush soft food into a thick and mostly uniform mixture

examples.en: I used a fork to mash the banana for the batter.
examples.zh: 我用叉子把香蕉「捣成泥」，拿去拌面糊。

examples.en: The recipe says to mash the avocado before adding the lemon juice.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，加入柠檬汁之前要把牛油果「捣成泥」。

words.enDefinition: A label phrase indicating something may be present

examples.en: The label says the biscuits may contain sesame, so I showed it to my roommate.
examples.zh: 标签写着饼干「可能含有」芝麻，所以我把包装给室友看了。

examples.en: I found the words may contain below the list of ingredients on the packet.
examples.zh: 我在包装的配料表下方找到了「可能含有」这几个字。

words.enDefinition: One meal redeemed from a campus dining plan using an account

examples.en: I used a meal swipe before heading to my evening seminar.
examples.zh: 去参加晚上的研讨课之前，我用了一次「食堂刷卡餐次」。

examples.en: My roommate asked whether a meal swipe included the salad bar.
examples.zh: 室友问一次「食堂刷卡餐次」包不包括自助沙拉台。

words.enDefinition: To determine an amount by the space it occupies

examples.en: The recipe says we can measure by volume if our scale is unavailable.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，没有秤时可以「按体积量取」。

examples.en: I asked why one version used grams and another said to measure by volume.
examples.zh: 我问为什么有的版本用克数，有的说要「按体积量取」。

collocations: measure by volume with a cup
measure by volume for the recipe

words.enDefinition: To determine ingredient amounts using a scale rather than container volume

examples.en: The baking tutor showed how to measure by weight when preparing flour.
examples.zh: 烘焙老师示范了备面粉时怎样「按重量称量」。

examples.en: My roommate prefers to measure by weight because our measuring cups are missing.
examples.zh: 我们的量杯找不到了，室友更愿意「按重量称量」。

collocations: measure by weight on a scale

words.enDefinition: A cup with a known volume used to measure ingredients

examples.en: I borrowed a measuring cup before trying the recipe from my roommate.
examples.zh: 尝试室友给我的菜谱之前，我借了个「量杯」。

examples.en: One measuring cup in our set had markings that were hard to read.
examples.zh: 我们这套「量杯」里有一个的刻度不容易看清。

words.enDefinition: A spoon sized to measure small, specified ingredient volumes

examples.en: I found the measuring spoon in the drawer beside the teaspoons.
examples.zh: 我在放茶匙的抽屉里找到了「量勺」。

examples.en: My roommate asked which measuring spoon matched the amount in the recipe.
examples.zh: 室友问哪把「量勺」对应菜谱上的用量。

words.enDefinition: a cooking heat setting between low and high

examples.en: I cooked the vegetables over medium heat while my flatmate prepared the rice.
examples.zh: 我用「中火」做蔬菜，室友在旁边准备米饭。

examples.en: The recipe asks for medium heat so the onions soften without browning quickly.
examples.zh: 食谱要求用「中火」，让洋葱软下来，同时别太快变褐。

collocations: set the pan over medium heat

words.enDefinition: a cooking setting hotter than medium but below the strongest setting

examples.en: I used medium-high heat to brown the mushrooms in the shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 我在共用厨房用「中大火」把蘑菇煎到上色。

examples.en: The pan was already over medium-high heat when I added the vegetables.
examples.zh: 我放蔬菜时，锅已经是「中大火」在加热。

collocations: heat a pan over medium-high heat

words.enDefinition: asks somebody to meet you at the entrance to a building

examples.en: Could you meet me at the entrance so I can hand you the food?
examples.zh: 能「到入口来和我碰面」吗？我把餐递给你。

examples.en: Please meet me at the entrance next to the bike racks after you arrive.
examples.zh: 你到了以后，「请到自行车架旁边的入口来和我碰面」。

collocations: could you meet me at the entrance?
please meet me at the entrance
ask them to meet me at the entrance

words.enDefinition: an increase over the price on the restaurant's own menu

examples.en: I noticed a menu markup when I compared the app with the café's own menu.
examples.zh: 我把应用和咖啡馆自己的菜单一比，发现有「平台餐品加价」。

examples.en: The shop said there was no menu markup on the two lunch deals that week.
examples.zh: 店家说那一周的两个午餐套餐都没有「平台餐品加价」。

collocations: a menu markup on delivery orders

words.enDefinition: Quantities expressed in units such as grams or milliliters

examples.en: I switched to the recipe's metric measurements because our scale displays grams.
examples.zh: 我们的秤显示克数，所以我改按菜谱上的「公制用量」来量。

examples.en: The note gave metric measurements beside the amounts in cups.
examples.zh: 备注在以杯为单位的用量旁列出了「公制用量」。

words.enDefinition: Milk-setting enzymes made using microorganisms

examples.en: I looked for microbial rennet on the cheese packet at the campus shop.
examples.zh: 我在学校商店查看奶酪包装上有没有标「微生物凝乳酶」。

examples.en: The cheese label listed microbial rennet in a line beneath the main ingredients.
examples.zh: 奶酪标签在主要配料下方一行列出了「微生物凝乳酶」。

words.zhGloss: 用微波炉最高功率加热
words.enDefinition: to use the strongest heating setting on a microwave for the food
acceptedZhAnswers: 用微波炉最高功率加热

examples.en: The rice packet says to microwave on full power for the time shown.
examples.zh: 米饭包装说，按标示的时间「用微波炉最高功率加热」。

examples.en: I checked what the instruction to microwave on full power meant for this appliance.
examples.zh: 我核实了这台机器上「用微波炉最高功率加热」的具体含义。

collocations: microwave on full power according to the packet
microwave on full power as directed
instructions to microwave on full power

words.enDefinition: Protein naturally found in milk

examples.en: The label listed milk protein separately from sugar on the powdered drink packet.
examples.zh: 饮料粉包装把「乳蛋白」和糖分开列出。

examples.en: I checked whether the new recipe still included milk protein before buying the biscuits.
examples.zh: 买饼干前，我核对了新配方是否仍含「乳蛋白」。

words.enDefinition: The solid components of milk after removing water

examples.en: The packet listed milk solids in bold under the name of the biscuit.
examples.zh: 饼干名称下方的包装上用粗体列了「乳固形物」。

examples.en: I asked the café where milk solids appeared in the supplier's ingredient information.
examples.zh: 我问咖啡馆，供应商的配料说明在哪儿列了「乳固形物」。

words.enDefinition: To cut garlic into very small pieces for a recipe

examples.en: The recipe says to mince garlic before mixing it with the yogurt.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，把蒜拌入酸奶前要先「把大蒜剁成末」。

examples.en: My flatmate volunteered to mince garlic while I got the bowls ready.
examples.zh: 我在准备碗的时候，室友主动提出帮我「把大蒜剁成末」。

words.enDefinition: Ingredients and equipment arranged in advance for preparing a dish

examples.en: The tutor checked our mise en place before we started making the dressing.
examples.zh: 指导老师在我们调酱汁前检查了食材是否「备齐并摆好」。

examples.en: I used a tray to keep my mise en place together beside the recipe.
examples.zh: 我用托盘把「备齐并摆好」的食材集中放在菜谱旁。

collocations: set up your mise en place
a tray for mise en place

words.enDefinition: Fruit and vegetables with unusual shapes

examples.en: The stall sells misshapen produce in a separate crate next to the potatoes.
examples.zh: 摊位把「形状不规则的蔬果」放在土豆旁的一个单独的箱子里卖。

examples.en: I found carrots and pears in the box marked misshapen produce on the counter.
examples.zh: 我在柜台上标着「形状不规则的蔬果」的箱子里找到了胡萝卜和梨。

words.enDefinition: A dish included in the order that has not reached the table

examples.en: We asked about the missing dish after the other plates arrived.
examples.zh: 其他菜都上桌之后，我们问了那道「漏上的菜」。

examples.en: The server checked our order slip for the missing dish from lunch.
examples.zh: 服务员查看了午餐点菜单，确认那道「漏上的菜」。

words.enDefinition: To combine ingredients until the mixture has no noticeable lumps

examples.en: Our recipe says to mix until smooth before adding the remaining milk.
examples.zh: 我们的菜谱说，加剩余牛奶之前先「拌至顺滑」。

examples.en: I asked how the mixture should look after we mix until smooth.
examples.zh: 我问「拌至顺滑」之后，混合物应是什么样子。

collocations: mix until smooth with a spatula
mix until smooth before adding more
the instruction to mix until smooth

words.enDefinition: A combination of several kinds of berries

examples.en: The mixed berries in the chilled case included blueberries and two kinds of red berries.
examples.zh: 冷藏柜里的「混合莓果」包括蓝莓和两种红色莓果。

examples.en: I bought a small pack of mixed berries to share after our last lecture.
examples.zh: 我买了一小盒「混合莓果」，准备最后一节课结束后和大家一起吃。

words.enDefinition: A deep container used for combining ingredients by hand or mixer

examples.en: I borrowed a mixing bowl because my usual bowl was too shallow.
examples.zh: 我常用的碗太浅，所以借了一个「搅拌碗」。

examples.en: The mixing bowl had enough space for all the salad ingredients.
examples.zh: 「搅拌碗」够大，装得下做沙拉的所有食材。

words.enDefinition: A mixed drink resembling a cocktail without containing alcohol

examples.en: My friend ordered a mocktail with lime and mint for lunch.
examples.zh: 朋友午餐点了有青柠和薄荷的「无酒精调饮」。

examples.en: The drinks menu listed one mocktail made with ginger and apple.
examples.zh: 饮品单上有一款用姜和苹果做的「无酒精调饮」。

collocations: a mocktail on the drinks menu

words.enDefinition: A soft-bodied animal such as a mussel or squid

examples.en: I asked which mollusc was included in the seafood mix on the menu.
examples.zh: 我问菜单上的海鲜拼盘里包括哪种「软体类水产」。

examples.en: The course handout used a mussel as an example of a mollusc.
examples.zh: 课程讲义用贻贝作为「软体类水产」的例子。

words.enDefinition: An Italian cooked sausage with visible pieces of pork fat

examples.en: I asked how much a few slices of mortadella would cost.
examples.zh: 我问几片「意式博洛尼亚香肠」要多少钱。

examples.en: The deli sliced mortadella for a sandwich we shared at lunch.
examples.zh: 熟食柜切了些「意式博洛尼亚香肠」，我们午饭时夹在三明治里分着吃。

words.enDefinition: A strong bowl and matching tool for crushing ingredients together

examples.en: The class had one mortar and pestle for every pair of students.
examples.zh: 课堂上给每两位学生配了一套「研钵和研杵」。

examples.en: We borrowed a mortar and pestle to prepare the dressing from the recipe.
examples.zh: 我们借了一套「研钵和研杵」，准备照菜谱调酱汁。

collocations: grind spices with a mortar and pestle

words.enDefinition: a mild cheese with a soft or stretchy texture, often used on pizza

examples.en: I added mozzarella to the pizza we made in our shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 我们在共用厨房做比萨时，我放了「马苏里拉奶酪」。

examples.en: The shop stocks mozzarella in both balls and bags of pre-grated cheese.
examples.zh: 商店既卖球形的「马苏里拉奶酪」，也卖磨好装袋的。

words.enDefinition: A type of fungus commonly used as food

examples.en: I picked up a small pack of mushrooms before walking back to my flat.
examples.zh: 我走回住处前顺手买了一小盒「蘑菇」。

examples.en: I put one more mushroom in the bag before taking it to the scale.
examples.zh: 拿去称重前，我又往袋里加了一朵「蘑菇」。

words.enDefinition: unpleasantly soft and lacking a clear shape or texture

examples.en: The rice turned mushy after sitting in too much liquid for too long.
examples.zh: 米饭在太多水里放得太久，变得「软烂成糊」。

examples.en: I did not like the carrots once they became mushy in the stew.
examples.zh: 胡萝卜在炖菜里变得「软烂成糊」后，我就不爱吃了。

words.enDefinition: Shellfish usually sold with dark, oblong shells and soft meat inside

examples.en: My roommate bought a bag of mussels at the weekend market.
examples.zh: 室友在周末市场买了一袋「贻贝」。

examples.en: The shop labeled the mussels with the weight of each bag.
examples.zh: 商店给「贻贝」标出了每袋的重量。

words.enDefinition: Food or seasoning made from mustard plant seeds

examples.en: I asked whether mustard was already mixed into the dressing for the salad.
examples.zh: 我问沙拉酱里是不是已经加了「芥末类配料」。

examples.en: The ingredient label listed mustard in bold on the jar of pickle relish.
examples.zh: 酸黄瓜酱罐子的配料标签用粗体列出了「芥末类配料」。

words.enDefinition: says changes to the food order did not reach the restaurant

examples.en: It looks like my changes didn't come through because the kitchen saw the old order.
examples.zh: 后厨看到的是旧订单，看来「我的改动没传到餐厅」。

examples.en: My changes didn't come through after the app briefly lost its connection to the restaurant.
examples.zh: 应用和餐厅短暂断开连接后，「我的改动没传到餐厅」。

collocations: it looks like my changes didn't come through
my changes didn't come through this time
tell the restaurant my changes didn't come through

words.zhGloss: 我的订单登记在某人名下
words.enDefinition: introduces the name used to identify your food order
acceptedZhAnswers: 我的订单登记在某人名下

examples.en: My order is under the name Chen, and I ordered the soup and two sandwiches.
examples.zh: 「我用陈这个姓下的单」，点了汤和两份三明治。

examples.en: My order is under Maya's name because she placed it for all of us.
examples.zh: 「我的单登记在玛雅名下」，因为是她帮我们大家点的餐。

collocations: my order is under my surname
my order is under my friend's name
my order is under the name I gave online

words.enDefinition: The name used to identify a reserved table in restaurant records

examples.en: The host asked me for the name on the reservation before checking the tablet.
examples.zh: 迎宾员问我「订位登记姓名」是什么，然后查了平板。

examples.en: I gave my friend the name on the reservation in case she arrived first.
examples.zh: 我把「订位登记姓名」告诉朋友，免得她先到时不知道报什么名字。

collocations: check the name on the reservation
give the name on the reservation
confirm the name on the reservation

words.enDefinition: An elongated cabbage with tightly packed pale leaves

examples.en: I chose a small napa cabbage that would fit in our shared vegetable drawer.
examples.zh: 我挑了棵小一点的「大白菜」，能放进我们共用的蔬菜抽屉。

examples.en: The sign for napa cabbage showed a picture of its pale inner leaves.
examples.zh: 「大白菜」的标签上印着一张照片，展示它浅色的内叶。

words.enDefinition: A sweet orange with a navel-like mark at one end

examples.en: I picked a navel orange from the display near the shop's front door.
examples.zh: 我从店门口附近的展台上挑了一个「脐橙」。

examples.en: The sign showed a navel orange cut in half beside the fruit's variety name.
examples.zh: 标签在水果品种名称旁放了一张切开一半的「脐橙」图片。

words.enDefinition: A variety of peach with smooth skin

examples.en: The nectarine looked like a peach but had smooth skin instead of fuzz.
examples.zh: 「油桃」看着像桃子，但皮很光滑，没有绒毛。

examples.en: I bought a nectarine for the afternoon because the peaches still felt hard.
examples.zh: 桃子摸着还硬，我就买了一个「油桃」下午吃。

words.enDefinition: The weight of an item excluding its packaging

examples.en: The sticker gave the net weight of the berries below the name of the farm.
examples.zh: 贴纸在农场名称下方写了这盒莓果的「净重」。

examples.en: I checked the net weight because the two bags looked almost the same size.
examples.zh: 两个袋子看起来差不多大，我就看了看「净重」。

collocations: the net weight on the label

words.enDefinition: a cooking oil with little distinctive flavour of its own

examples.en: The recipe asked for neutral oil to let the lemon flavour stand out.
examples.zh: 食谱要求用「风味清淡的食用油」，让柠檬味更突出。

examples.en: I used neutral oil to grease the pan for the sponge cake.
examples.zh: 烤海绵蛋糕之前，我用「风味清淡的食用油」给模具抹了一层。

words.enDefinition: A label saying sugar was not added

examples.en: The label said no added sugar below the picture of the fruit.
examples.zh: 标签在水果图案下方写着「无添加糖」。

examples.en: I compared the drinks after noticing that one carton said no added sugar.
examples.zh: 我注意到一个饮料盒上写着「无添加糖」，就对比了一下这几种饮料。

collocations: no added sugar on the label
a drink with no added sugar

words.enDefinition: asks the restaurant to leave utensils out of the order

examples.en: I wrote 'No cutlery, please' because we were eating in my flat's kitchen.
examples.zh: 我们要在我住处的厨房吃，所以我备注了「请不用放餐具」。

examples.en: I said 'No cutlery, please' when I collected the noodles at the counter.
examples.zh: 在柜台拿面条时，我说了声「请不用放餐具」。

collocations: a note saying no cutlery, please
no cutlery, please, for this order

words.enDefinition: A request for a drink to be served without ice

examples.en: I asked for my iced tea with no ice this time.
examples.zh: 这次我请店员给我的冰茶「不加冰」。

examples.en: My roommate said "No ice, please" when the server brought water.
examples.zh: 服务员送来水时，室友说「不加冰」。

collocations: a glass of water with no ice

words.enDefinition: specifies that unavailable items should not be replaced with alternatives

examples.en: I selected no substitutions because our lunch group had already agreed on the menu.
examples.zh: 我们午餐小组已经商量好吃什么，所以我选了「不接受替换」。

examples.en: The order note said no substitutions, so the café called when the sandwich sold out.
examples.zh: 备注写着「不接受替换」，所以三明治卖完后咖啡馆打了电话。

words.enDefinition: Having a moderate amount of heat from ingredients like chili

examples.en: My friend asked for something not too spicy while reading the lunch menu.
examples.zh: 朋友看午餐菜单时，问有没有「别太辣」的菜。

examples.en: I chose the noodles after the server said they were not too spicy.
examples.zh: 服务员说面条「不太辣」，我就点了它。

collocations: ask for it not too spicy

words.enDefinition: a milk-like drink made from oats and water

examples.en: The coffee stand asked whether I wanted oat milk in my usual latte.
examples.zh: 咖啡摊问我平时喝的拿铁要不要加「燕麦奶」。

examples.en: I used oat milk because it was the only carton open in the fridge.
examples.zh: 我用了「燕麦奶」，因为冰箱里只有那一盒开过封。

words.enDefinition: The long arms of an octopus sold as seafood portions

examples.en: The seafood counter had octopus tentacles in a tray beside the squid.
examples.zh: 海鲜柜有一盘「章鱼触腕」，就摆在鱿鱼旁边。

examples.en: I asked how many octopus tentacles were in the smaller pack.
examples.zh: 我问小包装里有几条「章鱼触腕」。

words.enDefinition: An unexpected unpleasant smell

examples.en: I noticed an off smell when I opened the carton and mentioned it to my roommate.
examples.zh: 我打开纸盒时闻到一股「异样的气味」，就告诉了室友。

examples.en: The customer described an off smell when she spoke to the shop assistant.
examples.zh: 那位顾客向店员描述了她闻到的「异样的气味」。

words.enDefinition: with a pan or food no longer over an active source of heat

examples.en: I stirred the cheese into the sauce off the heat before serving.
examples.zh: 我在「离火后」把奶酪搅进酱汁，再端上桌。

examples.en: The recipe says to leave the pan off the heat while adding butter.
examples.zh: 食谱说，要在锅「离火后」加黄油。

collocations: add the butter off the heat
leave the pan off the heat

words.enDefinition: A spreading tool with a raised handle above its flat blade

examples.en: I used a small offset spatula for the frosting on our cake.
examples.zh: 我用了一把小「弯柄抹刀」给我们的蛋糕抹糖霜。

examples.en: The instructor set the offset spatula next to the cake for our group.
examples.zh: 老师把「弯柄抹刀」放在蛋糕旁边留给我们这组。

collocations: spread frosting with an offset spatula

words.enDefinition: From the time the package has been opened

examples.en: The label gave different instructions for the jar once opened than for an unopened jar.
examples.zh: 标签给罐子「开封后」和未开封时列了不同的储存说明。

examples.en: The bottle had a second line of information beginning with the words once opened.
examples.zh: 瓶子的第二行说明以「开封后」开头。

collocations: instructions for a product once opened

words.enDefinition: An additional plate requested for someone at a dining table

examples.en: I asked for one more plate so our friend could share the food.
examples.zh: 我请服务员「再来一个盘子」，好让朋友也能分着吃。

examples.en: The server brought one more plate when the sharing dish arrived.
examples.zh: 服务员端来分享菜，还「拿来了一个盘子」。

words.enDefinition: a meal cooked in a single pot or other main cooking vessel

examples.en: We made a one-pot meal because the shared kitchen had only one burner free.
examples.zh: 共用厨房只空出一个灶眼，所以我们做了「一锅做成的一餐」。

examples.en: The recipe for a one-pot meal included rice, vegetables and a little stock.
examples.zh: 这份「一锅做成的一餐」的食谱用到米、蔬菜和一点高汤。

words.enDefinition: a bread interior with relatively large, irregular air spaces

examples.en: The loaf had an open crumb that was visible as soon as we cut it.
examples.zh: 面包一切开，就能看出「内部大孔组织」。

examples.en: The baker showed us what an open crumb looked like in sourdough.
examples.zh: 面包师给我们看了酸面包的「内部大孔组织」是什么样。

words.enDefinition: A label introducing the date a package was opened

examples.en: I wrote opened on above the date on the sticker for our shared jar.
examples.zh: 我在共用罐子的贴纸上，日期上方写了「开封日期」。

examples.en: The jar had a label saying opened on followed by a handwritten date.
examples.zh: 罐子上有张标签写着「开封日期」，后面是手写的日期。

collocations: write opened on beside the date

words.enDefinition: place a food order before you arrive or want it ready

examples.en: I like to order ahead when I only have half an hour between lectures.
examples.zh: 如果两节课之间只有半小时，我喜欢「提前点餐」。

examples.en: We decided to order ahead so we wouldn't spend our study break waiting for food.
examples.zh: 我们决定「提前点餐」，免得学习间歇都花在等饭上。

words.enDefinition: To request another set of drinks for the same group

examples.en: We stayed to talk and decided to order another round of tea.
examples.zh: 我们留下来聊天，决定「再点一轮」茶。

examples.en: My roommate asked if we could order another round before the café closed.
examples.zh: 室友问，咖啡馆关门之前能不能「再点一轮」。

words.enDefinition: To request food at a service counter rather than from a table

examples.en: The sign said to order at the counter before finding a table upstairs.
examples.zh: 牌子上说，先「到柜台点单」，再上楼找座位。

examples.en: My friend asked whether we should order at the counter or wait for a server.
examples.zh: 朋友问我们是该「到柜台点单」，还是等服务员过来。

collocations: ask guests to order at the counter
tell people to order at the counter
need to order at the counter

words.enDefinition: place a food order with the restaurant itself

examples.en: We chose to order directly from the restaurant because we knew its phone number.
examples.zh: 我们知道这家店的电话号码，所以选择「直接向餐厅点餐」。

examples.en: I can order directly from the restaurant if you tell me which dishes you want.
examples.zh: 你告诉我想吃哪些菜，我可以「直接向餐厅点餐」。

collocations: choose to order directly from the restaurant
call to order directly from the restaurant
order directly from the restaurant for pickup

words.enDefinition: request that a restaurant send the food to your address

examples.en: We decided to order for delivery because nobody wanted to cycle across campus in the rain.
examples.zh: 谁也不想冒雨骑车穿过校园，所以我们决定「点餐叫外送」。

examples.en: You can order for delivery from this café even when its seating area is closed.
examples.zh: 即使堂食座位区关闭了，你也能在这家咖啡馆「点餐叫外送」。

collocations: order for delivery through an app

words.enDefinition: To request food intended for everyone seated at the same table

examples.en: My classmates asked me to order for the table because I knew the menu.
examples.zh: 我熟悉菜单，同学便请我「给全桌人点」菜。

examples.en: We decided to order for the table after agreeing on three dishes to share.
examples.zh: 商量好分吃哪三道菜后，我们决定「给全桌人点」。

collocations: choose dishes to order for the table
ask who will order for the table

words.enDefinition: A mistake in recording, preparing, or serving what someone ordered

examples.en: The server apologized for the order mix-up before bringing my soup.
examples.zh: 服务员先为「弄错点单」道了歉，然后端来我的汤。

examples.en: We noticed an order mix-up when two sandwiches came to our table.
examples.zh: 两份三明治端到桌上时，我们发现店里「弄错点单」了。

words.enDefinition: a slip listing the items to prepare or hand over

examples.en: The order ticket showed two sandwiches, so the staff checked the bag a second time.
examples.zh: 「餐厅点单小票」上写着两份三明治，所以店员又检查了一遍餐袋。

examples.en: The café taped the order ticket to the bag before placing it on the shelf.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆先把「餐厅点单小票」贴在餐袋上，再把餐袋放到架子上。

words.enDefinition: Fruit and vegetables grown under organic production standards

examples.en: The shop labels its organic produce on a separate shelf near the entrance.
examples.zh: 这家店把「有机蔬果」标示在入口附近单独的货架上。

examples.en: I checked the label because the organic produce looked similar to the other vegetables.
examples.zh: 「有机蔬果」看着和其他蔬菜差不多，所以我看了一下标签。

words.enDefinition: The package in which a product was supplied

examples.en: I photographed the original packaging so my roommate could see which biscuits I meant.
examples.zh: 我拍下「原包装」，这样室友就知道我说的是哪种饼干。

examples.en: The label was easier to read on the original packaging than in the photo I had taken.
examples.zh: 「原包装」上的标签比我拍的照片更容易看清。

words.enDefinition: Past a labelled best-before or use-by date

examples.en: We found some tins marked out of date while checking the shared cupboard.
examples.zh: 我们查看共用食品柜时，发现几罐标记为「已过标示日期」的食品。

examples.en: I asked which date the volunteer meant when she said the packet was out of date.
examples.zh: 志愿者说那包食品「已过标示日期」时，我问她指的是哪个日期。

collocations: check whether food is out of date
mark a packet as out of date

words.enDefinition: No longer having any remaining portions of a particular dish

examples.en: The server said they were out of that dish and suggested the soup.
examples.zh: 服务员说「那道菜售完了」，推荐我们点汤。

examples.en: The café was out of that dish by the time we reached the counter.
examples.zh: 我们走到柜台时，餐厅「那道菜售完了」。

collocations: say you're out of that dish
apologize for being out of that dish

words.enDefinition: Tables and chairs set outside for diners to use

examples.en: We asked about outdoor seating because the air inside was quite warm.
examples.zh: 店里有点热，我们就问有没有「户外座位」。

examples.en: The restaurant opened its outdoor seating when the rain stopped before lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭前雨停了，餐厅便开放了「户外座位」。

words.enDefinition: a selected function or operating mode on an oven

examples.en: I checked which oven setting the recipe used before putting the tray inside.
examples.zh: 把烤盘放进去前，我查了一下食谱选的是哪种「烤箱模式」。

examples.en: The person who owns our flat showed me the oven setting for ordinary baking.
examples.zh: 房东给我看了普通烘烤用的是哪种「烤箱模式」。

words.enDefinition: the rapid expansion of bread dough during the first part of baking

examples.en: The instructor pointed out the oven spring just after we put in the loaves.
examples.zh: 老师在面包刚送入烤箱时，让我们看「入炉后迅速膨胀」的现象。

examples.en: The baker discussed how the cuts on top affected the oven spring.
examples.zh: 面包师谈了表面的割口怎样影响「入炉后迅速膨胀」。

words.enDefinition: cooked too long or at too much heat, reducing the desired quality

examples.en: The green beans were overcooked, so they broke apart when I moved them.
examples.zh: 四季豆「烹煮过头」了，一挪动就断开。

examples.en: I realized the pasta was overcooked when the pieces stopped holding their shape.
examples.zh: 面条不成形了，我才发现已经「烹煮过头」。

words.enDefinition: Past the stage of being fully ripe

examples.en: I chose the firmer pears because the softer ones already looked overripe to me.
examples.zh: 我挑了硬一点的梨，因为软的那些看起来已经「熟过头了」。

examples.en: The shop put overripe bananas in a separate box by the produce display.
examples.zh: 店家把「熟过头的」香蕉另外放进生鲜货架旁的箱子里。

words.enDefinition: The tail of cattle sold as a cut of meat

examples.en: My roommate found oxtail at the market near our student residence.
examples.zh: 室友在学生公寓附近的市场找到了「牛尾」。

examples.en: The butcher had oxtail behind the counter even though none was displayed.
examples.zh: 展示柜里没摆「牛尾」，不过肉柜店员在柜台后面有存货。

words.enDefinition: An edible mushroom with a wide fan-shaped cap

examples.en: The oyster mushrooms were in a loose cluster at the back of the tray.
examples.zh: 「平菇」在托盘后面，几朵松松地连在一起。

examples.en: One oyster mushroom was larger than the others, so I asked for a smaller cluster.
examples.zh: 有一朵「平菇」特别大，我就请摊主换一簇小点的。

words.enDefinition: a thick savoury seasoning traditionally made with oyster extracts

examples.en: We added oyster sauce to the vegetables we made in the shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 我们在共用厨房炒蔬菜时加了「蚝油」。

examples.en: The grocery shop had oyster sauce beside the other bottled cooking sauces.
examples.zh: 杂货店把「蚝油」放在其他瓶装烹调酱料旁边。

words.enDefinition: Shellfish with rough paired shells containing soft, edible flesh

examples.en: The seafood stall sold oysters in boxes of six or twelve.
examples.zh: 海鲜摊的「牡蛎」六只或十二只装一盒。

examples.en: I checked the price of the oysters on the market board.
examples.zh: 我在市场的价目牌上看了「牡蛎」的价格。

words.enDefinition: ask for one item to be packaged on its own

examples.en: Could you pack that separately so my roommate can take her dessert to the library?
examples.zh: 能「把那样东西单独装」吗？我室友好把她的甜点带去图书馆。

examples.en: Please pack that separately because my friend is picking up her meal after rehearsal.
examples.zh: 「请把那样东西单独装」，我朋友排练后才来拿她的餐。

collocations: ask the staff to pack that separately

words.enDefinition: a charge for the containers or bags used for takeaway food

examples.en: The café listed a packaging charge beside the price of my two takeaway soups.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆在我那两份外带汤的价格旁边列出了「餐品打包费」。

examples.en: I asked whether the packaging charge applied when I collected the order myself.
examples.zh: 我问自己去取餐时，是否也要付「餐品打包费」。

words.enDefinition: Brown sugar pressed into a measuring cup so it fills the space

examples.en: I checked whether the recipe called for packed brown sugar before measuring.
examples.zh: 我在量棕糖之前查了菜谱要不要用「压实量取的棕糖」。

examples.en: The tutor showed what packed brown sugar looks like when it is tipped out.
examples.zh: 老师给我们看了倒出来的「压实量取的棕糖」是什么样。

collocations: a cup of packed brown sugar
a recipe calling for packed brown sugar

words.enDefinition: The day food was placed in its packaging

examples.en: The label gave a packing date below the name of the fruit supplier.
examples.zh: 标签在水果供应商名称下方写明了「包装日期」。

examples.en: I checked the packing date before sorting two boxes in the shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 整理共用厨房里的两盒食品前，我看了「包装日期」。

collocations: a packing date on the label

words.enDefinition: fat and juices left in a pan after cooking meat or other food

examples.en: My roommate used the pan drippings to make gravy for our Sunday lunch.
examples.zh: 室友用「锅底肉汁和油脂」做肉汁酱，配周日午饭。

examples.en: The recipe asks you to keep the pan drippings after removing the roast.
examples.zh: 食谱要求取出烤肉后保留「锅底肉汁和油脂」。

collocations: skim fat from the pan drippings

words.enDefinition: to cook food in a frying pan with a small amount of fat

examples.en: I decided to pan-fry the halloumi for the sandwiches after our morning class.
examples.zh: 上午下课后，我决定「用平底锅煎」哈罗米奶酪来做三明治。

examples.en: The recipe explains how to pan-fry the onions before adding the remaining vegetables.
examples.zh: 食谱说明了加其他蔬菜之前，怎样「用平底锅煎」洋葱。

words.enDefinition: a sauce made in the same pan as a cooked item, often using its browned residue

examples.en: I made a simple pan sauce while the cooked pieces rested on a plate.
examples.zh: 煎好的食材在盘子里静置时，我做了个简单的「锅汁酱」。

examples.en: The pan sauce picked up the flavour of the mushrooms and herbs.
examples.zh: 「锅汁酱」带上了蘑菇和香草的味道。

words.enDefinition: Italian cured pork belly sold in slices or cubes

examples.en: The recipe listed pancetta, so I looked in the deli section.
examples.zh: 菜谱上列了「意式腌五花肉」，我就去熟食区找。

examples.en: I bought a small pack of pancetta for our weekend pasta.
examples.zh: 我买了一小盒「意式腌五花肉」，准备周末做意面用。

words.enDefinition: a basic ingredient commonly kept on hand in a kitchen

examples.en: Rice is a pantry staple in our flat because everyone cooks it.
examples.zh: 米是我们住处的「厨房常备食材」，因为大家都会煮它。

examples.en: I bought another pantry staple before the long break when shops would close.
examples.zh: 长假前我又买了一样「厨房常备食材」，因为到时候商店会关门。

collocations: keep something as a pantry staple

words.enDefinition: Keeping food in a cupboard at room temperature

examples.en: The label gave separate notes for pantry storage and storage after opening.
examples.zh: 标签把「食品柜常温储存」和开封后储存的说明分开列出。

examples.en: The shared kitchen uses the tall cupboard for pantry storage next to the fridge.
examples.zh: 共用厨房用冰箱旁的高柜做「食品柜常温储存」用。

words.enDefinition: A tropical fruit with soft flesh and many black seeds

examples.en: I picked a small papaya because I didn't need enough for the whole flat.
examples.zh: 我挑了一个小「番木瓜」，因为不用买够所有室友吃的量。

examples.en: The shop had half a papaya in a tray next to the whole ones.
examples.zh: 店里的半个「番木瓜」装在托盘里，就摆在整果旁边。

words.enDefinition: a small piece of paper used to wipe your mouth or hands

examples.en: I asked for a paper napkin when I saw the sauce dripping from the sandwich.
examples.zh: 看到三明治的酱汁往下滴，我要了一张「纸餐巾」。

examples.en: There was a paper napkin tucked beside the fork at the bottom of the bag.
examples.zh: 餐袋底部的叉子旁边塞着一张「纸餐巾」。

words.enDefinition: to bake something partway, so it can be finished in the oven later

examples.en: We had to parbake the pizza bases before adding the toppings for dinner.
examples.zh: 我们给晚饭做比萨，要先把饼底「预烤至半熟」，再放配料。

examples.en: The bakery uses the word parbake for rolls that customers finish at home.
examples.zh: 面包店用「预烤至半熟」来形容顾客要回家烤透的面包卷。

words.enDefinition: to cook food partly by boiling it before finishing it another way

examples.en: I decided to parboil the potatoes before putting them in the roasting tray.
examples.zh: 我决定先把土豆「预煮至半熟」，再放进烤盘。

examples.en: The recipe suggests that we parboil the carrots before finishing them in the oven.
examples.zh: 食谱建议先把胡萝卜「预煮至半熟」，再用烤箱烤到熟。

words.enDefinition: A small kitchen knife used for trimming or peeling food

examples.en: I borrowed a paring knife to get the apples ready for class.
examples.zh: 我借了一把「削皮小刀」准备课堂上要用的苹果。

examples.en: The paring knife was in the drawer beside the vegetable peeler.
examples.zh: 「削皮小刀」在抽屉里，就放在蔬菜削皮器旁边。

words.enDefinition: a hard Italian-style cheese with a strong flavour, often grated over food

examples.en: I grated parmesan over the pasta just before taking the bowls to the table.
examples.zh: 把面端上桌前，我刨了点「帕玛森奶酪」撒在意面上。

examples.en: The server offered parmesan to the students who had ordered the tomato pasta.
examples.zh: 服务员问点了番茄意面的学生要不要加「帕玛森奶酪」。

words.enDefinition: A pale, sweet root vegetable shaped like a carrot

examples.en: I picked up a parsnip because the label said it had a sweet flavour.
examples.zh: 我拿了一根「欧防风根」，因为标签说它味道偏甜。

examples.en: The parsnip had been placed in the same crate as the larger carrots.
examples.zh: 那根「欧防风根」和较大的胡萝卜放在同一个箱子里。

words.enDefinition: No longer completely frozen

examples.en: The frozen berries were partially thawed by the time we unpacked the delivery.
examples.zh: 我们拆开送来的东西时，冷冻莓果已经「部分解冻」。

examples.en: I reported a partially thawed packet when I checked the supermarket delivery.
examples.zh: 检查超市送来的东西时，我反映有一包食品「部分解冻」。

words.enDefinition: A group of four people dining together at a restaurant

examples.en: The host asked whether our whole party of four had arrived at the café.
examples.zh: 迎宾员问我们「四位客人」是不是都到咖啡馆了。

examples.en: My roommate said we were a party of four and gave our names.
examples.zh: 室友说我们有「四位客人」，还报了姓名。

collocations: a reservation for a party of four
room for a party of four

words.enDefinition: a smooth liquid made from tomatoes that have been puréed and strained

examples.en: I used passata as the base for our simple tomato and basil sauce.
examples.zh: 我用「番茄原浆」做了简单的番茄罗勒酱。

examples.en: The grocery shop sold passata in tall glass bottles next to canned tomatoes.
examples.zh: 杂货店的「番茄原浆」装在高玻璃瓶里，摆在番茄罐头旁。

words.enDefinition: A tropical fruit with aromatic pulp and many seeds

examples.en: The label showed what a passion fruit looks like with the skin opened.
examples.zh: 标签上展示了「百香果」剖开果皮后的样子。

examples.en: I found passion fruit next to the figs when I visited the market on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六去市场时，我在无花果旁找到了「百香果」。

words.enDefinition: A hand tool that cuts cold fat into flour for pastry

examples.en: The instructor showed which tool was the pastry blender on our tray.
examples.zh: 老师指给我们看，托盘里哪个工具是「油面切拌器」。

examples.en: My flatmate asked whether the recipe required a pastry blender for the dough.
examples.zh: 室友问照这个菜谱做面团是否一定要用「油面切拌器」。

collocations: cut butter with a pastry blender

words.enDefinition: A small kitchen brush used to apply liquids to food

examples.en: The recipe listed a pastry brush for coating the top of the pastry.
examples.zh: 菜谱列了一把「烘焙刷」，用来在酥皮表面刷涂。

examples.en: I found the pastry brush with the other baking tools in the drawer.
examples.zh: 我在抽屉里找到了「烘焙刷」，它和其他烘焙用具放在一起。

words.enDefinition: To remove surface moisture by pressing gently with something absorbent

examples.en: The recipe asked us to pat dry the herbs before chopping them.
examples.zh: 菜谱要求切香草之前先「轻拍吸干」表面水分。

examples.en: My flatmate asked how much moisture would remain after we pat dry the leaves.
examples.zh: 室友问把叶子「轻拍吸干」后，还会剩多少水分。

words.enDefinition: A dining table on a patio outside the main building

examples.en: The server brought menus to our patio table near the planters.
examples.zh: 服务员把菜单拿到我们靠近花盆的「露台餐桌」上。

examples.en: My friend moved her chair closer to the patio table to make room.
examples.zh: 朋友把椅子往「露台餐桌」拉近一些，好让出地方。

words.enDefinition: To settle what you owe at a designated restaurant counter

examples.en: I offered to pay at the counter while my friends packed their bags.
examples.zh: 朋友们收拾包时，我主动提出「到柜台结账」。

examples.en: The café asked us to pay at the counter on our way out.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆请我们出去时「到柜台结账」。

collocations: ask to pay at the counter
let guests pay at the counter
a sign asking guests to pay at the counter

words.enDefinition: To settle the amount you owe without leaving your table

examples.en: The server asked if we wanted to pay at the table after dessert.
examples.zh: 甜点吃完后，服务员问我们是否想「在桌边结账」。

examples.en: My flatmate was surprised that we could pay at the table at that café.
examples.zh: 室友没想到在那家咖啡馆可以「在桌边结账」。

collocations: ask to pay at the table
let guests pay at the table
offer to pay at the table

words.enDefinition: A soft stone fruit with fuzzy skin

examples.en: The peach I chose had a reddish patch but no marks from handling.
examples.zh: 我挑的「桃子」有一块皮是淡红色的，但没有磕碰的痕迹。

examples.en: I bought another peach after my flatmate said she wanted one for lunch.
examples.zh: 室友说午餐想吃一个「桃子」，我就多买了一个。

words.enDefinition: an extra delivery charge added when a service is especially busy

examples.en: The app showed a peak-time delivery surcharge while everyone was ordering dinner after the game.
examples.zh: 比赛结束后大家都在点晚饭，应用显示有「高峰时段送餐附加费」。

examples.en: I checked whether the peak-time delivery surcharge applied before ordering food for the study group.
examples.zh: 给学习小组点餐前，我查了是否要收「高峰时段送餐附加费」。

words.enDefinition: An edible seed that grows in a pod underground

examples.en: The sauce label listed peanuts among the ingredients below the picture.
examples.zh: 酱汁标签在图片下方的配料表里列出了「花生」。

examples.en: I asked whether the peanut topping was already mixed into the salad.
examples.zh: 我问当浇头的「花生」是不是已经拌进了沙拉。

words.enDefinition: a spread made from ground peanuts

examples.en: I spread peanut butter on toast before leaving for the early bus.
examples.zh: 赶早班公交前，我在吐司上抹了「花生酱」。

examples.en: My flatmate bought crunchy peanut butter because we had finished the smooth kind.
examples.zh: 室友买了带颗粒的「花生酱」，因为顺滑的那种已经吃完了。

words.enDefinition: Described as not containing peanuts

examples.en: The label said peanut-free, and my friend checked the rest of the packet too.
examples.zh: 标签写着「不含花生」，我朋友也看了包装的其他地方。

examples.en: I asked which snack bars were labelled peanut-free in the campus shop.
examples.zh: 我问学校商店里哪些零食棒标着「不含花生」。

words.enDefinition: A fruit usually wider at the bottom

examples.en: I chose a pear that felt firm enough to carry in my backpack.
examples.zh: 我挑了一个摸着够硬的「梨」，方便放在背包里带走。

examples.en: The pears from that stall stayed firm for a few days in our flat.
examples.zh: 从那个摊位买的「梨」放在我们公寓里，好几天都是硬的。

words.enDefinition: barley grains that have been polished to remove the outer layers

examples.en: I added pearl barley to the vegetable soup we shared after class.
examples.zh: 下课后我们一起喝蔬菜汤，我在里面放了「珍珠大麦」。

examples.en: The shop sells pearl barley beside other grains in the dried foods aisle.
examples.zh: 店里的「珍珠大麦」就在干货通道其他谷物旁边。

words.enDefinition: Shrimp sold with the main outer body shell removed

examples.en: My flatmate picked up peeled shrimp from the seafood counter after class.
examples.zh: 室友下课后从海鲜柜买了「去壳虾」。

examples.en: I compared the weight of two small packs of peeled shrimp.
examples.zh: 我比较了两小盒「去壳虾」的重量。

words.enDefinition: A spicy cured sausage commonly sliced for pizza toppings

examples.en: My roommate added pepperoni to the shopping list for pizza night.
examples.zh: 室友把「美式辣香肠」加进了披萨晚餐的购物清单。

examples.en: The pepperoni came in a small packet beside the salami.
examples.zh: 「美式辣香肠」是小袋装的，就摆在萨拉米香肠旁。

words.enDefinition: Food liable to deteriorate relatively quickly

examples.en: The student event team asked which deliveries contained perishable food that afternoon.
examples.zh: 学生活动小组询问当天下午送到的东西里哪些属于「易腐食品」。

examples.en: The cupboard sign asked people not to leave perishable food on its shelves.
examples.zh: 食品柜上的牌子请大家不要在架上放「易腐食品」。

words.enDefinition: An orange fruit that may be firm or soft when ripe

examples.en: I asked whether the persimmon was a variety people eat while still firm.
examples.zh: 我问这种「柿子」是不是可以趁还硬的时候吃。

examples.en: The persimmon had a green leafy cap and an orange skin with no marks.
examples.zh: 这个「柿子」有绿色的叶状蒂，橙色外皮上一点伤痕也没有。

words.enDefinition: a food order placed by speaking to a restaurant by phone

examples.en: I placed a phone order because the café's full lunch menu wasn't listed online.
examples.zh: 网上没有咖啡馆完整的午餐菜单，我就用「电话点餐」了。

examples.en: The staff checked my phone order against the name I had given them earlier.
examples.zh: 店员用我之前留的名字核对了「电话点餐订单」。

words.enDefinition: a picture showing the items actually delivered to the customer

examples.en: I attached a photo of what arrived so support could see which pizza we received.
examples.zh: 我附上了「实收餐品照片」，方便客服看到我们收到的是哪款披萨。

examples.en: The app asked for a photo of what arrived before I could submit my report.
examples.zh: 提交问题报告之前，应用要求上传「实收餐品照片」。

collocations: take a photo of what arrived
send a photo of what arrived
attach a photo of what arrived

words.enDefinition: a staffed counter where customers collect food orders

examples.en: I went to the pickup counter to get the noodles I'd ordered during my seminar break.
examples.zh: 我去「取餐柜台」拿了研讨课课间点的面条。

examples.en: The pickup counter is next to the entrance where the bike racks are.
examples.zh: 「取餐柜台」就在有自行车架的那个入口旁边。

words.enDefinition: a price reduction for collecting the food yourself

examples.en: The café offered a pickup discount, so I walked over with my roommate after class.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆有「自提折扣」，所以下课后我和室友走过去拿餐。

examples.en: I asked whether the pickup discount applied to the meal we ordered by phone.
examples.zh: 我问用电话点的这份餐能不能享受「自提折扣」。

words.enDefinition: a food order the customer collects from the restaurant

examples.en: I placed a pickup order so I could grab dinner after my evening lecture.
examples.zh: 我下了个「自提订单」，晚上上完课就能去拿晚饭。

examples.en: My pickup order was waiting on the shelf beside two bags for delivery drivers.
examples.zh: 我的「自提订单」放在架子上，旁边有两袋等骑手取的餐。

words.enDefinition: the line of people waiting to collect food orders

examples.en: The pickup queue reached the door when two lectures finished at the same time.
examples.zh: 两节课同时结束时，「取餐队伍」一直排到了门口。

examples.en: There were two lines, and the pickup queue was moving faster than the ordering line.
examples.zh: 那里排了两条队，「取餐队伍」比点餐队伍走得快。

words.enDefinition: a shelf where restaurants leave completed orders for collection

examples.en: The staff put my bag on the pickup shelf with my name facing outwards.
examples.zh: 店员把我的餐袋放上「自助取餐架」，我的名字贴在朝外的一面。

examples.en: I checked the pickup shelf first because the counter was busy during the lunch break.
examples.zh: 午休时柜台挺忙，我先去看了「自助取餐架」。

collocations: leave an order on the pickup shelf

words.enDefinition: A large sweet fruit with rough skin and yellow flesh

examples.en: I carried the pineapple home separately because it didn't fit in my small bag.
examples.zh: 这个「菠萝」塞不进我的小袋子，我就单独拎回去了。

examples.en: The fruit stall had a pineapple cut open to show the colour inside.
examples.zh: 水果摊切开了一个「菠萝」，让顾客看里面是什么颜色。

words.enDefinition: A flexible bag used to squeeze mixtures through a small opening

examples.en: I borrowed a piping bag for the frosting at our cake workshop.
examples.zh: 我在蛋糕课上借了一个「裱花袋」，用来挤糖霜。

examples.en: My flatmate held the piping bag while I checked the recipe photo.
examples.zh: 我核对菜谱照片时，室友拿着「裱花袋」。

words.enDefinition: A shaped nozzle that controls the mixture leaving a piping bag

examples.en: I picked a piping tip that matched the shape in the photo.
examples.zh: 我挑了一个和照片上形状一致的「裱花嘴」。

examples.en: The piping tip was in a small box beside the reusable bag.
examples.zh: 「裱花嘴」放在一个小盒子里，就在可重复使用的裱花袋旁边。

words.enDefinition: To remove the hard stones from cherries before using them

examples.en: I forgot the recipe said to pit the cherries before filling the bowl.
examples.zh: 我忘了菜谱上说，往碗里放之前要先「去掉樱桃核」。

examples.en: My roommate brought a tool to pit the cherries for our dessert.
examples.zh: 室友带了个工具，把甜点要用的樱桃「去掉核」。

collocations: pit the cherries for a pie
a tool to pit the cherries

words.enDefinition: a flat box used to carry a pizza

examples.en: I carried the pizza box flat while my flatmate held the door for me.
examples.zh: 室友帮我拉住门时，我把「披萨盒」平端着走。

examples.en: We opened the pizza box on the table as soon as our group arrived.
examples.zh: 我们小组一到，就在桌上打开了「披萨盒」。

words.enDefinition: a thick heat-retaining slab on which pizza is baked to crisp its base

examples.en: I used a pizza stone when making flatbread for our weekend lunch.
examples.zh: 做周末午饭的薄饼时，我用了「比萨烘烤石板」。

examples.en: The shared kitchen stores the pizza stone in a cupboard beneath the oven.
examples.zh: 共用厨房把「比萨烘烤石板」放在烤箱下面的柜子里。

words.enDefinition: yogurt with no added flavourings, such as fruit or vanilla

examples.en: I bought plain yogurt to use in both breakfast and a salad dressing.
examples.zh: 我买了「原味酸奶」，早饭和做沙拉酱都能用。

examples.en: The recipe uses plain yogurt to give the sauce a lighter texture.
examples.zh: 食谱用「原味酸奶」让酱汁口感更轻盈。

words.enDefinition: a milk-like drink made from plant ingredients such as oats, soy or nuts

examples.en: The café lists plant-based milk options on a separate card by the till.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆在收银台旁的一张卡上单独列出了几种「植物奶」。

examples.en: We bought plant-based milk for a guest who requested a dairy alternative.
examples.zh: 有客人想喝奶制品替代饮料，我们就买了「植物奶」。

words.enDefinition: A starchy banana usually eaten after cooking

examples.en: I asked which plantain was ripe enough for the dish my roommate had planned.
examples.zh: 室友想做道菜，我问哪个「烹调用香蕉」熟得差不多了。

examples.en: The plantain was in a separate display from the smaller bananas near the register.
examples.zh: 「烹调用香蕉」和收银台附近的小香蕉分开展示。

words.enDefinition: asks the courier to avoid using the doorbell

examples.en: Please don't ring the bell because my flatmate is recording an oral assignment upstairs.
examples.zh: 室友正在楼上录口语作业，「请别按门铃」。

examples.en: Please don't ring the bell when you arrive, as everyone else is already asleep.
examples.zh: 你到了以后「请别按门铃」，其他人已经睡了。

collocations: please don't ring the bell tonight
please don't ring the bell when you arrive
a note saying please don't ring the bell

words.enDefinition: A sign politely asking diners to wait for seating assistance

examples.en: The sign said "Please wait to be seated," so we stayed beside the entrance.
examples.zh: 牌子上写着「请等候店员安排座位」，我们就留在入口旁边。

examples.en: I noticed "Please wait to be seated" on the door before our group went inside.
examples.zh: 我们一行人进门前，我注意到门口写着「请等候店员安排座位」。

collocations: a "Please wait to be seated" sign
see "Please wait to be seated" at the entrance

words.enDefinition: A code identifying loose produce at checkout

examples.en: The cashier entered the PLU code from the sticker to look up the variety of apple I'd chosen.
examples.zh: 收银员输入贴纸上的「价格查询编码」，查找我挑的苹果品种。

examples.en: I couldn't find the PLU code on the loose pears when I reached the checkout.
examples.zh: 到收银台时，我没在散装梨上找到「价格查询编码」。

words.enDefinition: A soft stone fruit with smooth skin

examples.en: I chose a purple plum and a yellow one from the same stall.
examples.zh: 我在同一个摊位上选了一个紫色「李子」和一个黄色的。

examples.en: The plum at the bottom of my bag had a small bruise.
examples.zh: 我袋子底部的「李子」有一小块碰伤。

words.enDefinition: to cook food gently in hot liquid with little or no bubbling

examples.en: We planned to poach the pears for dessert after our group dinner.
examples.zh: 我们计划聚餐后做甜点，把梨「用热液低温浸煮」熟。

examples.en: The cook explained why she chose to poach the fish in the demonstration.
examples.zh: 厨师说明了示范时为什么选择把鱼「用热液低温浸煮」。

words.enDefinition: A round fruit filled with juicy seeds

examples.en: I chose a pomegranate after the seller showed me one that had been opened.
examples.zh: 摊主给我看了一个掰开的「石榴」后，我也挑了一个。

examples.en: The pomegranate was on the same shelf as the mangoes, just below the sign.
examples.zh: 「石榴」和芒果在同一层货架上，就在标签下方。

words.enDefinition: A very large citrus fruit with a thick rind

examples.en: I found a pomelo in a net bag beside the rest of the citrus fruit.
examples.zh: 我在其他柑橘类水果旁找到一个装在网袋里的「柚子」。

examples.en: The stallholder held up a pomelo so I could see how big it was.
examples.zh: 摊主举起一个「柚子」，让我看看它有多大。

words.enDefinition: A fatty cut of pork from the underside of the animal

examples.en: I bought a piece of pork belly for dinner with my flatmates.
examples.zh: 我买了一块「五花肉」，晚上和室友一起吃。

examples.en: The butcher had pork belly with skin and without it in the case.
examples.zh: 肉柜里有带皮的「五花肉」，也有去皮的。

words.enDefinition: A cut from the upper part of a pig's shoulder

examples.en: The butcher explained why a pork butt was displayed with shoulder cuts.
examples.zh: 肉柜店员解释了为什么「猪上肩肉」要和肩部的其他肉摆在一起。

examples.en: I read the label to check the weight of the pork butt.
examples.zh: 我看了标签，核对这块「猪上肩肉」的重量。

words.enDefinition: A slice of pork from the loin, sometimes containing bone

examples.en: The butcher let each of us choose a pork chop from the tray.
examples.zh: 肉柜店员让我们各自从托盘里挑一块「猪排」。

examples.en: I selected a smaller pork chop because I was eating on my own.
examples.zh: 我一个人吃，就选了一块小一点的「猪排」。

words.enDefinition: Meat from a pig sold as food for people

examples.en: I asked which section of the display contained pork that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上，我问展示柜的哪一部分摆的是「猪肉」。

examples.en: We bought a small piece of pork for Sunday dinner.
examples.zh: 我们买了一小块「猪肉」做周日晚饭。

words.enDefinition: Described as made without pork

examples.en: I checked which noodle soups were marked pork-free on the menu at lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐时，我看了菜单上哪些汤面标着「不含猪肉」。

examples.en: The caterer offered a pork-free version of the dish for our student event.
examples.zh: 餐饮供应商为我们的学生活动提供了这道菜「不含猪肉的」版本。

words.enDefinition: A broad cut of meat from along a pig's back

examples.en: I asked for a piece of pork loin that would serve three people.
examples.zh: 我问能不能买一块够三个人吃的「猪背脊肉」。

examples.en: The pork loin was displayed in a larger tray than the chops.
examples.zh: 「猪背脊肉」用的托盘比排肉用的更大。

words.enDefinition: Meat cut from the front shoulder of a pig

examples.en: We asked whether the pork shoulder could be split into two smaller pieces.
examples.zh: 我们问能不能把「猪肩肉」分成两小块。

examples.en: My roommate added pork shoulder to the shopping list for Sunday dinner.
examples.zh: 室友把「猪肩肉」加进了周日晚餐的购物清单。

words.enDefinition: Pork ribs cut from lower down the rib cage near the belly

examples.en: The butcher showed me pork spare ribs from a different part of the rib cage.
examples.zh: 肉柜店员给我看了从猪肋骨另一处切下来的「猪腹侧肋排」。

examples.en: We split the price of the pork spare ribs between four housemates.
examples.zh: 我们四个合租室友平摊了「猪腹侧肋排」的钱。

collocations: a rack of pork spare ribs

words.enDefinition: A long, narrow, tender muscle from inside a pig's loin

examples.en: The label gave the weight of each pork tenderloin in the pack.
examples.zh: 标签写明了包装内每条「猪小里脊」的重量。

examples.en: My flatmate asked whether one pork tenderloin would be enough for dinner.
examples.zh: 室友问一条「猪小里脊」够不够我们晚饭吃。

words.enDefinition: The amount of food provided in a particular restaurant order

examples.en: We asked about the portion size before ordering a plate to share.
examples.zh: 点一盘大家分之前，我们先问了「一份的分量」。

examples.en: The portion size was larger than I had expected from the photo.
examples.zh: 「一份的分量」比我看照片时想的要大。

words.enDefinition: A hand tool for crushing cooked potatoes or similar food

examples.en: I borrowed a potato masher for the filling we were making.
examples.zh: 我借了一个「土豆压泥器」，准备用来做馅。

examples.en: The potato masher was hanging above the counter in our shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 「土豆压泥器」挂在我们共用厨房的操作台上方。

words.enDefinition: To break spices into smaller pieces by repeatedly pressing or striking them

examples.en: We borrowed a mortar to pound spices for the class recipe.
examples.zh: 我们借来研钵，把课堂菜谱用的香料「捣碎」。

examples.en: My flatmate offered to pound spices while I checked the ingredient list.
examples.zh: 室友主动帮忙「捣碎香料」，我来核对食材清单。

words.enDefinition: milk dried into a powder that can be mixed with water or used in cooking

examples.en: I bought powdered milk in a small bag for the bread recipe.
examples.zh: 我买了一小袋「奶粉」，用来做面包。

examples.en: The recipe called for powdered milk alongside yeast, flour and a little sugar.
examples.zh: 食谱需要「奶粉」、酵母、面粉和少量糖。

words.enDefinition: Fruit sold already cut into pieces

examples.en: I picked up pre-cut fruit for the group meeting because there were no knives.
examples.zh: 小组会上没有刀，我买了「预切水果」带去。

examples.en: The shop puts the pre-cut fruit in a chilled display next to the salad.
examples.zh: 店里把「预切水果」放在沙拉旁的冷藏柜里。

words.enDefinition: to heat the oven to the required temperature before putting food in it

examples.en: I forgot to preheat the oven before mixing the batter for the muffins.
examples.zh: 我调松饼面糊之前，忘了「预热烤箱」。

examples.en: The recipe says to preheat the oven while getting the vegetables ready.
examples.zh: 食谱说，准备蔬菜时要「预热烤箱」。

collocations: preheat the oven to the required temperature

words.enDefinition: A small bowl for holding prepared or measured ingredients

examples.en: I put the chopped herbs in a prep bowl beside my plate.
examples.zh: 我把切好的香草放在盘子旁的「备料小碗」里。

examples.en: The prep bowl was too small for the amount of onion we needed.
examples.zh: 「备料小碗」太小，装不下我们需要的洋葱。

words.enDefinition: A designated area for preparing ingredients and organizing kitchen tools

examples.en: I used the far end of the counter as my prep station.
examples.zh: 我把操作台另一端当作自己的「备料台」。

examples.en: The prep station held our bowls and the ingredients for lunch.
examples.zh: 「备料台」上放着我们的碗和做午饭用的食材。

words.enDefinition: The time needed to prepare ingredients and tools before cooking

examples.en: I read the prep time before inviting my flatmate to help.
examples.zh: 我先看了「备料时间」，再请室友过来帮忙。

examples.en: The recipe gave separate estimates for prep time and cooking time.
examples.zh: 菜谱分别估算了「备料时间」和烹饪时间。

words.enDefinition: Tasks done to get ingredients ready before making a dish

examples.en: We split the prep work so everyone could join the study group later.
examples.zh: 我们分担了「备料工作」，这样晚些时候大家都能参加学习小组。

examples.en: The recipe estimates how long the prep work takes before cooking begins.
examples.zh: 菜谱估算了开始做菜前的「备料工作」需要多长时间。

words.enDefinition: Meat sealed in a package before a customer selects it

examples.en: I compared prepackaged meat with portions cut to order at the counter.
examples.zh: 我把「预包装肉」与柜台按顾客要求分切的肉作了比较。

examples.en: The store keeps prepackaged meat on shelves behind the deli counter.
examples.zh: 商店把「预包装肉」放在熟食柜台后面的货架上。

words.enDefinition: Fruit and vegetables packaged before being displayed for sale

examples.en: I checked both labels because the prepacked produce came from two different farms.
examples.zh: 因为这两份「预包装蔬果」来自不同农场，我查看了两张标签。

examples.en: My flatmate looked through the prepacked produce and found a small bag of carrots.
examples.zh: 室友看了看「预包装蔬果」，找到一小袋胡萝卜。

words.enDefinition: a status showing the restaurant is making your food

examples.en: The app still displayed 'Preparing your order' when my study group finished for the evening.
examples.zh: 学习小组晚上结束时，应用上仍显示「正在制作你的餐点」。

examples.en: I saw 'Preparing your order' on the screen and waited for a driver to be assigned.
examples.zh: 我在屏幕上看到「正在制作你的餐点」，就等着分配配送员。

collocations: a message saying preparing your order

words.enDefinition: To squeeze excess liquid from a block of tofu

examples.en: The recipe mentions a tool to press tofu before slicing it.
examples.zh: 菜谱提到，切片之前可以用个工具「压出豆腐里的水」。

examples.en: My roommate asked why the instructions said to press tofu for this dish.
examples.zh: 室友问这道菜为什么要「压出豆腐里的水」。

words.enDefinition: to cook food in a sealed appliance where steam raises the pressure

examples.en: The cooking class compared how to pressure-cook beans with ordinary stovetop simmering.
examples.zh: 烹饪课对比了怎样「用压力锅烹煮」豆类，以及普通炉灶慢煮的做法。

examples.en: The recipe notes that some cooks pressure-cook the potatoes before mashing them.
examples.zh: 食谱提到，有些人会先「用压力锅烹煮」土豆，再捣成泥。

words.enDefinition: Salad leaves washed before being packaged for sale

examples.en: The fridge by the entrance has prewashed salad in small bags near the herbs.
examples.zh: 入口旁的冷柜里有小袋「预洗沙拉菜」，摆在香草旁。

examples.en: I checked whether the prewashed salad contained any of the leaves my roommate wanted.
examples.zh: 我看了看「预洗沙拉菜」里有没有室友想要的那几种叶菜。

words.enDefinition: The amount charged for each pound of a product

examples.en: I checked the price per pound of the two kinds of ground meat.
examples.zh: 我核对了两种肉碎的「每磅价格」。

examples.en: The US supermarket printed the price per pound below the product name.
examples.zh: 这家美国超市把「每磅价格」印在商品名称下方。

collocations: the price per pound of beef

words.enDefinition: Showing the cost for each kilogram

examples.en: The potatoes were priced per kilo, so I checked the weight before choosing a bag.
examples.zh: 土豆是「按千克标价」的，我选袋子前先看了重量。

examples.en: I asked whether the loose pears were priced per kilo like the apples.
examples.zh: 我问散装梨是不是跟苹果一样「按千克标价」。

words.enDefinition: To print a sticker showing the measured weight

examples.en: The scale asked me to print a weight label after selecting the right variety.
examples.zh: 选对品种后，秤提示我「打印称重标签」。

examples.en: I went back to print a weight label because the first sticker tore.
examples.zh: 第一张贴纸撕破了，所以我回去重新「打印称重标签」。

collocations: prompt someone to print a weight label
print a weight label at the scale
print a weight label for loose produce

words.enDefinition: a paid option offered to give an order higher delivery priority

examples.en: The app offered priority delivery, but I had time to wait after my lecture.
examples.zh: 应用提供「优先送餐」，不过我下课后有时间等。

examples.en: We considered priority delivery because rehearsal was starting again sooner than we thought.
examples.zh: 排练比我们想的更快就要继续，我们考虑选「优先送餐」。

words.enDefinition: A small bag for loose fruits or vegetables

examples.en: I reached for a produce bag before picking out three apples and a lemon.
examples.zh: 我先拿了一个「蔬果袋」，才挑了三个苹果和一个柠檬。

examples.en: I pulled a produce bag off the roll next to the self-service scale.
examples.zh: 我从自助秤旁的那卷袋子上撕下一个「蔬果袋」。

words.enDefinition: A small label stuck directly onto fresh produce

examples.en: I checked the produce sticker on the pear to see what variety it was.
examples.zh: 我看了一下梨上的「蔬果贴纸」，想知道是什么品种。

examples.en: The produce sticker came off when I took the apple out of my bag.
examples.zh: 我从袋子里拿出苹果时，「蔬果贴纸」脱落了。

collocations: a code on the produce sticker

words.enDefinition: The day a food product was made

examples.en: The production date was stamped at the bottom of the tin near the batch code.
examples.zh: 「生产日期」打在罐底，靠近批次编码。

examples.en: I asked the assistant whether the number near the lid was the production date.
examples.zh: 我问店员，盖子旁的那串数字是不是「生产日期」。

words.enDefinition: to leave shaped yeast dough to rise before baking it

examples.en: I had an hour to proof the dough before the kitchen became busy.
examples.zh: 厨房忙起来之前，我有一小时可以「让面团发酵膨胀」。

examples.en: The recipe shows where to proof the dough after shaping the rolls.
examples.zh: 食谱标明面包卷整形后该放在哪儿「让面团发酵膨胀」。

collocations: proof the dough until it has risen

words.enDefinition: Italian dry-cured ham usually served in thin slices

examples.en: The deli worker showed me three kinds of prosciutto behind the counter.
examples.zh: 熟食柜店员给我看了柜台里的三种「意式风干火腿」。

examples.en: My flatmate brought prosciutto and bread to the study group picnic.
examples.zh: 室友带了「意式风干火腿」和面包去参加学习小组的野餐。

words.enDefinition: A small container used for fruit or vegetables

examples.en: I bought a punnet of raspberries at the market beside my college in England.
examples.zh: 我在英格兰学校旁的市场买了「一小盒」覆盆子。

examples.en: The greengrocer put another punnet of cherry tomatoes beside the bunches of basil.
examples.zh: 蔬果店店员在成把的罗勒旁又摆了「一小盒」小番茄。

words.enDefinition: To store food remaining after a meal

examples.en: I stayed behind to put away the leftovers while my friends cleared the table.
examples.zh: 朋友收拾桌子时，我留下来「把剩下的饭菜收起来」。

examples.en: Could you put away the leftovers while I find the lids for these boxes?
examples.zh: 我去找这些盒子的盖子时，你能「把剩下的饭菜收起来」吗？

collocations: remember to put away the leftovers
stay to put away the leftovers

words.expression: put your name on the list
words.lemma: put your name on the list
words.zhGloss: 把姓名登记到等位名单
words.enDefinition: To record your name among people waiting to be seated
acceptedZhAnswers: 把姓名登记到等位名单
acceptedEnVariants: put your name on the list

examples.en: The host asked if she could "Put your name on the list" before we waited outside.
examples.zh: 迎宾员问能不能先「把姓名登记到等位名单」，再请我们到外面等。

examples.en: The sign asks you to put your name on the list before choosing a seat.
examples.zh: 牌子提示，选座之前要先「把姓名登记到等位名单」。

collocations: ask to put your name on the list
offer to put your name on the list
put your name on the list first

words.enDefinition: oat flakes processed to cook more quickly than ordinary rolled oats
