examples.en: The shop stocked quick oats in small boxes near the instant breakfasts.
examples.zh: 店里在即食早餐食品旁边摆了小盒装的「快熟燕麦片」。

examples.en: I made a bowl of quick oats before leaving for the early bus.
examples.zh: 我赶早班公交前做了一碗「快熟燕麦片」。

words.enDefinition: A cut of lamb containing a row of connected ribs

examples.en: The price for a rack of lamb was printed on the sign above it.
examples.zh: 「整扇羊肋排」的价格印在上方的牌子上。

examples.en: We decided a rack of lamb was more than we needed for two.
examples.zh: 我们觉得两个人吃「整扇羊肋排」有点多。

words.enDefinition: the height at which an oven rack is placed inside the oven

examples.en: I changed the rack position so the top of the loaf would brown evenly.
examples.zh: 我调整了「烤架层位」，让面包顶部均匀上色。

examples.en: The manual shows the recommended rack position for baking with two trays.
examples.zh: 说明书标出了同时用两个烤盘时建议的「烤架层位」。

words.enDefinition: A trout species often sold as a whole fish or fillets

examples.en: We saw rainbow trout at the market next to the local produce.
examples.zh: 我们在市场的本地农产品旁边看到了「虹鳟」。

examples.en: The label showed whether the rainbow trout was whole or filleted.
examples.zh: 标签标明「虹鳟」以整条还是鱼柳的形式销售。

words.enDefinition: dried grapes, often used as a snack or in cooking and baking

examples.en: I added raisins to the oat bars we made for the student picnic.
examples.zh: 我们给学生野餐做燕麦棒时，我加了些「葡萄干」。

examples.en: The recipe asked for raisins and chopped walnuts in the sweet bread.
examples.zh: 做那款甜面包时，食谱要求加「葡萄干」和碎核桃。

words.enDefinition: A small soft berry made of many tiny parts

examples.en: The raspberries were in shallow boxes so I could see almost every berry clearly.
examples.zh: 「覆盆子」装在浅盒里，我几乎能看清每一颗。

examples.en: I found a raspberry stuck to the lid when I opened the container.
examples.zh: 我打开盒子时，发现一颗「覆盆子」粘在盖子上。

words.enDefinition: An American dining phrase signaling you want the restaurant bill

examples.en: We were ready for the check right after we finished sharing the dessert.
examples.zh: 我们分完甜点后就「可以结账了」。

examples.en: The server asked whether our group was ready for the check before clearing the plates.
examples.zh: 服务员收盘子之前问我们是不是「可以结账了」。

collocations: tell someone you're ready for the check
let the server know you're ready for the check

words.enDefinition: Having chosen what to request from a restaurant or café

examples.en: The server asked whether we were ready to order after bringing the drinks.
examples.zh: 服务员送来饮料后，问我们是否「准备好点单」。

examples.en: I was not ready to order because I had just arrived from class.
examples.zh: 我刚下课赶过来，还没「准备好点单」。

collocations: tell the server you're ready to order
wait until everyone is ready to order

words.enDefinition: The amount of food a recipe is expected to produce

examples.en: I checked the recipe yield before deciding how much flour to buy.
examples.zh: 我先核对了「菜谱成品量」，再决定买多少面粉。

examples.en: The recipe yield gave us enough for dinner and tomorrow's lunch.
examples.zh: 按「菜谱成品量」，我们做的够吃晚饭和明天的午饭。

words.enDefinition: small orange or reddish lentils that soften and break down readily when cooked

examples.en: I used red lentils to make a thicker soup for the evening meal.
examples.zh: 我用「红扁豆」给晚饭做了更浓稠的汤。

examples.en: The grocer sold red lentils in clear bags on the shelf above the rice.
examples.zh: 杂货店的「红扁豆」装在透明袋里，放在米上方的货架。

words.enDefinition: A reddish marine fish often sold whole or in fillets

examples.en: The fishmonger held up a red snapper so I could see its size.
examples.zh: 鱼柜店员拿起一条「红鲷鱼」，让我看看它有多大。

examples.en: My friend had put red snapper on the list for our weekend meal.
examples.zh: 朋友把「红鲷鱼」写进我们周末聚餐的购物清单。

words.enDefinition: to boil or simmer a sauce so some liquid evaporates and its flavour concentrates

examples.en: My flatmate showed me how to reduce a sauce without scorching the bottom.
examples.zh: 室友教我怎样「收浓酱汁」，同时避免锅底煮焦。

examples.en: The instructor demonstrated how to reduce a sauce at the end of cooking.
examples.zh: 老师示范了烹调接近尾声时怎样「收浓酱汁」。

collocations: reduce a sauce over gentle heat
reduce a sauce to a glaze

words.enDefinition: to evaporate enough liquid to leave about half its original volume

examples.en: The recipe says the mixture should reduce by half before we season it.
examples.zh: 食谱说，混合液要「收汁至原量一半」再调味。

examples.en: I marked the original level so I could see the broth reduce by half.
examples.zh: 我标了原来的液面，这样能看出高汤有没有「收汁至原量一半」。

collocations: allow stock to reduce by half
let the sauce reduce by half

words.enDefinition: to make the temperature or power of a cooking heat source lower

examples.en: I went back to reduce the heat once the soup started bubbling steadily.
examples.zh: 汤开始持续冒泡后，我回去「调低火力」。

examples.en: The recipe says to reduce the heat after the water comes to a boil.
examples.zh: 食谱说，水烧开后要「调低火力」。

words.enDefinition: A label instruction to chill food once opened

examples.en: The sauce bottle said refrigerate after opening in small letters beneath the ingredients.
examples.zh: 酱汁瓶在配料下方用小字写着「开封后冷藏」。

examples.en: We found the words refrigerate after opening when we compared the labels in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上对比标签时，我们找到了「开封后冷藏」这几个字。

collocations: a label saying refrigerate after opening

words.enDefinition: The usual amount of a dish served to one customer

examples.en: The server said a regular portion would be enough for one person.
examples.zh: 服务员说，一个人点「标准份」就够了。

examples.en: I ordered a regular portion of fries to go with my sandwich.
examples.zh: 我点了「标准份」的薯条配三明治。

words.enDefinition: The listed ingredients that have not yet been added

examples.en: I set out the remaining ingredients while my flatmate measured the flour.
examples.zh: 室友量面粉时，我摆好了「其余食材」。

examples.en: The next step tells us when to add the remaining ingredients.
examples.zh: 下个步骤会告诉我们什么时候加「其余食材」。

words.enDefinition: prepare the customer's food again after a problem

examples.en: Could you remake my order because this pizza has a completely different topping on it?
examples.zh: 能「重做我点的餐」吗？这张披萨上的配料完全不一样。

examples.en: The kitchen agreed to remake my order once I showed them the receipt from the app.
examples.zh: 我给后厨看了应用里的小票，他们同意「重做我点的餐」。

collocations: ask the kitchen to remake my order
can you remake my order tonight?

words.enDefinition: To take small bones out of a piece of fish

examples.en: Our instructor explained why some cooks still remove the fillet bones after buying fish.
examples.zh: 老师解释了为什么有些人买来鱼后仍会「剔除鱼柳里的鱼刺」。

examples.en: I asked whether the fishmonger could remove the fillet bones at the counter.
examples.zh: 我问鱼柜店员能不能在柜台帮我「剔除鱼柳里的鱼刺」。

collocations: remove the fillet bones before portioning
a tool to remove the fillet bones

words.enDefinition: To separate stems from the usable parts of an ingredient

examples.en: Our salad recipe says to remove the stems from the mushrooms first.
examples.zh: 沙拉菜谱上说，蘑菇要先「去掉梗」。

examples.en: I offered to remove the stems from the herbs while my roommate measured oil.
examples.zh: 室友在量油的时候，我主动提出帮香草「去掉梗」。

words.enDefinition: to heat fatty food so the fat melts and can be separated

examples.en: The cook used a separate pan to render the fat from the trimmings.
examples.zh: 厨师用另一个锅，从修切下来的肥肉里「加热炼出脂肪」。

examples.en: The instructor explained that the heat would render the fat during the demonstration.
examples.zh: 老师讲解说，示范中靠加热来「炼出脂肪」。

collocations: render the fat in a pan

words.enDefinition: Another serving brought after the original dish was wrong or unsuitable

examples.en: The server offered a replacement dish after taking away the noodles.
examples.zh: 服务员端走面条后，提出可以给我们一份「替换上的菜」。

examples.en: Our replacement dish arrived just as the others finished their lunches.
examples.zh: 我们的「替换上的菜」端上来时，其他人刚吃完午饭。

words.expression: report a problem with my order
words.lemma: report a problem with my order
words.enDefinition: tell the restaurant or delivery service something went wrong
acceptedEnVariants: report a problem with my order

examples.en: I need to report a problem with my order because the drink arrived without a lid.
examples.zh: 我需要「报告餐品订单的问题」，送到的饮料没盖子。

examples.en: I called to report a problem with my order after noticing the missing fries.
examples.zh: 我发现少了薯条，就打电话「报告餐品订单的问题」。

collocations: need to report a problem with my order
where to report a problem with my order
call to report a problem with my order

words.enDefinition: A bag that can be closed again after opening

examples.en: The frozen berries came in a resealable bag with a strip across the top.
examples.zh: 冷冻莓果装在「可反复封口的袋子」里，袋口有一条封口条。

examples.en: I checked whether the crackers came in a resealable bag before buying them.
examples.zh: 买饼干之前，我看了看是不是装在「可反复封口的袋子」里。

collocations: a resealable bag with a zip

words.enDefinition: A message verifying that a restaurant has saved a table

examples.en: The reservation confirmation showed the time and the address of the restaurant.
examples.zh: 「订位确认信息」上写了时间和餐厅地址。

examples.en: I forwarded the reservation confirmation to the friend who was meeting us.
examples.zh: 我把「订位确认信息」转发给了来和我们碰面的朋友。

words.enDefinition: heat that remains after the source has been switched off or removed

examples.en: The residual heat softened the cheese after I took the dish from the oven.
examples.zh: 我把盘子从烤箱拿出后，「余热」使奶酪变软。

examples.en: I used the residual heat in the pot to finish melting the butter.
examples.zh: 我利用锅里的「余热」把黄油彻底融化了。

words.enDefinition: to let cooked meat sit briefly before cutting or serving it

examples.en: The recipe said to rest the meat while we made a quick sauce.
examples.zh: 食谱说，快手酱汁制作期间要「静置熟肉」。

examples.en: The instructor explained why cooks often rest the meat before carving a roast.
examples.zh: 老师说明了为什么厨师通常切烤肉前会先「静置熟肉」。

collocations: allow time to rest the meat

words.enDefinition: To put something back in the refrigerator

examples.en: The bottle had a note saying return to the fridge after serving.
examples.zh: 瓶子上写着，倒出需要的量后要「放回冰箱」。

examples.en: I asked which trays we needed to return to the fridge after the meeting.
examples.zh: 会后，我问哪些托盘需要「放回冰箱」。

collocations: return to the fridge after serving
remember to return to the fridge
a note saying return to the fridge

words.enDefinition: A steak cut from the beef rib section around the rib eye

examples.en: My flatmate picked a ribeye steak to share on his birthday.
examples.zh: 我室友挑了一块「肋眼牛排」，准备生日那天和大家分着吃。

examples.en: The price label on the ribeye steak listed the cost per pound.
examples.zh: 「肋眼牛排」的价格标签上写着每磅多少钱。

words.enDefinition: flour produced by grinding rice into a powder

examples.en: I found rice flour next to the other flours in the specialty aisle.
examples.zh: 我在特色食品通道的其他面粉旁找到了「大米粉」。

examples.en: My roommate used rice flour to make the batter for our snacks.
examples.zh: 室友用「大米粉」给我们的点心调面糊。

words.enDefinition: thin noodles made from rice, used in soups, salads and stir-fries

examples.en: I bought rice vermicelli for the spring rolls we planned to make.
examples.zh: 我们打算做春卷，我就买了「细米粉」。

examples.en: The soup had rice vermicelli and several kinds of vegetables from the market.
examples.zh: 汤里有「细米粉」，还放了几种从市场买的蔬菜。

words.enDefinition: vinegar made from fermented rice, common in several East Asian cuisines

examples.en: We mixed rice vinegar into the dressing for the cold cucumber salad.
examples.zh: 我们在凉拌黄瓜的调料里拌进了「米醋」。

examples.en: The grocery shop placed rice vinegar beside the different kinds of soy sauce.
examples.zh: 杂货店把「米醋」摆在各类酱油旁边。

collocations: add rice vinegar to a dressing

words.enDefinition: a soft mild Italian cheese traditionally made from the whey left after cheesemaking

examples.en: I used ricotta in the filling for the pasta shells we cooked together.
examples.zh: 我们一起煮贝壳面时，我用「里科塔奶酪」做馅。

examples.en: The recipe recommended ricotta instead of cream cheese for a lighter texture.
examples.zh: 为了让口感更轻盈，食谱推荐用「里科塔奶酪」代替奶油奶酪。

words.enDefinition: Fully developed and ready to eat

examples.en: The market seller pointed out which peaches were ripe enough to eat that evening.
examples.zh: 摊主指出哪些桃子已经「成熟」，当天晚上就能吃。

examples.en: I picked one ripe pear for lunch and another to keep until Friday.
examples.zh: 我挑了一个「成熟的」梨午餐吃，另一个留到周五。

words.enDefinition: To become ready to eat as fruit develops

examples.en: The stallholder said these pears would ripen by the time my flatmates came back.
examples.zh: 摊主说，等我室友回来，这些梨就会「成熟」。

examples.en: I chose two mangoes at different stages so they wouldn't both ripen on the same day.
examples.zh: 我挑了两个成熟程度不同的芒果，这样它们就不会在同一天「成熟」。

words.enDefinition: to cook food using dry heat, typically in an oven

examples.en: We decided to roast the vegetables while the rice was cooking on the hob.
examples.zh: 我们决定趁炉子上煮饭时，把蔬菜「用干热烘烤」。

examples.en: The recipe asks you to roast the pumpkin before adding it to the soup.
examples.zh: 食谱要求南瓜先「用干热烘烤」，再加到汤里。

words.enDefinition: Thin pieces of roasted beef, often sold for sandwiches

examples.en: We bought roast beef slices for the sandwiches at our study group lunch.
examples.zh: 我们买了「烤牛肉切片」，想做三明治给学习小组当午餐。

examples.en: The worker pointed to the roast beef slices behind the glass counter.
examples.zh: 店员指着玻璃柜台后面的「烤牛肉切片」。

collocations: a packet of roast beef slices

words.enDefinition: oat grains that have been steamed and flattened into flakes

examples.en: I used rolled oats in the biscuits we made for the study group.
examples.zh: 我们给学习小组做饼干时，我用了「压片燕麦」。

examples.en: The recipe listed rolled oats and sunflower seeds among the dry ingredients.
examples.zh: 食谱把「压片燕麦」和葵花籽列在干料里。

words.enDefinition: a vigorous boil with large bubbles rising continuously across the liquid's surface

examples.en: The water reached a rolling boil while I took the pasta from the cupboard.
examples.zh: 我从柜子里拿意面的时候，水已经「持续剧烈沸腾」了。

examples.en: I waited for a rolling boil before following the next part of the recipe.
examples.zh: 我等到水「持续剧烈沸腾」，才按食谱做下一步。

collocations: bring water to a rolling boil
keep water at a rolling boil

words.enDefinition: A cylindrical tool for flattening dough or pastry evenly

examples.en: I borrowed a rolling pin from the students in the next flat.
examples.zh: 我向隔壁公寓的同学借了根「擀面杖」。

examples.en: The rolling pin was too wide for the board we had.
examples.zh: 「擀面杖」比我们那块板还宽。

words.enDefinition: Lettuce with long leaves and firm central ribs

examples.en: The romaine lettuce had longer leaves than the other kind on the same shelf.
examples.zh: 同一层货架上，「罗马生菜」的叶子比另一种生菜更长。

examples.en: I asked whether the romaine lettuce was sold by the head or in bags.
examples.zh: 我问「罗马生菜」是按整棵卖，还是袋装卖。

words.enDefinition: a prompt asking for a room number to complete the delivery address

examples.en: The checkout screen said 'Room number required' when I entered the residence address for lunch.
examples.zh: 我点午饭填宿舍地址时，结账页面提示「需要填写房间号」。

examples.en: I saw 'Room number required,' so I asked whether delivery to reception was possible.
examples.zh: 我看到提示「需要填写房间号」，就问能不能送到前台。

words.enDefinition: Butter that has softened to the temperature of the room

examples.en: The cake recipe called for room-temperature butter instead of butter from the fridge.
examples.zh: 蛋糕菜谱要用「室温软化黄油」，不用刚从冰箱取出的黄油。

examples.en: The room-temperature butter was soft enough to mix with a wooden spoon.
examples.zh: 「室温软化黄油」已经软到可以用木勺搅拌了。

collocations: a recipe calling for room-temperature butter

words.enDefinition: The temperature of the air in a room

examples.en: The tea label used the phrase room temperature near the note about storage.
examples.zh: 茶叶标签在储存说明附近用了「室温」这个词。

examples.en: I noticed room temperature printed in bold at the bottom of the carton.
examples.zh: 我看到纸盒底部用粗体印着「室温」。

collocations: labeled for storage at room temperature

words.enDefinition: Vegetables such as carrots grown for their roots

examples.en: The stall grouped root vegetables together with carrots in one crate and beets in another.
examples.zh: 摊位把「根菜类蔬菜」摆在一起，胡萝卜和甜菜根分别放在不同的箱子里。

examples.en: I bought a mix of root vegetables for dinner with my flatmates that evening.
examples.zh: 我买了几种「根菜类蔬菜」，准备那天晚上和室友一起吃。

words.enDefinition: A whole chicken roasted while turning on a spit

examples.en: I picked up a rotisserie chicken after class so we could eat together.
examples.zh: 我下课后顺路买了只「旋转烤鸡」，好和室友一起吃。

examples.en: The rotisserie chicken was displayed beside the ready-made salads at the deli.
examples.zh: 熟食柜把「旋转烤鸡」摆在现成的沙拉旁边。

words.enDefinition: A circular tool for cutting rounds from rolled pastry dough

examples.en: I looked for a round pastry cutter that matched the size in the photo.
examples.zh: 我找了一支「圆形面团切模」，尺寸和菜谱照片上的一样。

examples.en: The tutor showed a round pastry cutter large enough for the tart bases.
examples.zh: 老师展示了一个够切挞底的「圆形面团切模」。

collocations: cut dough with a round pastry cutter

words.enDefinition: To work solid fat into dry ingredients until they resemble crumbs

examples.en: The pastry recipe says to rub in the butter before adding water.
examples.zh: 酥皮菜谱说，加水之前把黄油「搓散拌入」面粉。

examples.en: The teacher explained what rub in meant in the original recipe.
examples.zh: 老师解释了原菜谱里的「搓散拌入」是什么意思。

collocations: instructions for how to rub in

words.enDefinition: A food counter where diners choose items for their own salad

examples.en: I stopped at the salad bar before choosing my main dish.
examples.zh: 选主菜前，我先去了「自助沙拉台」。

examples.en: The salad bar had two kinds of dressing beside the vegetables.
examples.zh: 「自助沙拉台」在蔬菜旁摆了两种沙拉酱。

words.enDefinition: A container that spins to remove water from salad leaves

examples.en: The salad spinner took up most of the space in the drawer.
examples.zh: 「沙拉蔬菜甩干器」占了抽屉大半的空间。

examples.en: I asked whether our flatmate had bought a salad spinner for the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我问室友是不是给厨房买了一个「沙拉蔬菜甩干器」。

collocations: the basket of a salad spinner

words.enDefinition: A hinged utensil for lifting and mixing portions of salad

examples.en: I reached for the salad tongs beside the large mixing bowl.
examples.zh: 我伸手去拿大搅拌碗旁边的「沙拉夹」。

examples.en: The salad tongs helped me mix the salad without spilling leaves.
examples.zh: 「沙拉夹」帮我拌好了沙拉，没有把菜叶撒出来。

words.enDefinition: A seasoned cured sausage often served in thin slices

examples.en: I chose a few slices of salami for our sandwiches.
examples.zh: 我选了几片「萨拉米香肠」，打算夹三明治。

examples.en: The deli had two kinds of salami with different seasonings.
examples.zh: 熟食柜有两种调味不同的「萨拉米香肠」。

words.enDefinition: A fish commonly sold for its pink or orange flesh

examples.en: I asked which kind of salmon was on special today.
examples.zh: 我问今天哪种「三文鱼」有特价。

examples.en: We chose salmon instead of cod for our dinner after class.
examples.zh: 下课后那顿晚饭，我们选了「三文鱼」，没有买鳕鱼。

words.enDefinition: A cut of salmon taken from one side of the fish

examples.en: I chose a small salmon fillet for dinner in our shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 我挑了一小块「三文鱼柳」，晚上在共用厨房做饭。

examples.en: The fishmonger weighed the salmon fillet and printed the price label.
examples.zh: 鱼柜店员称过「三文鱼柳」，然后打印了价格标签。

words.enDefinition: butter to which salt has been added

examples.en: I used salted butter on the bread we shared with the soup.
examples.zh: 我们喝汤配面包，我抹了「有盐黄油」。

examples.en: The corner shop had salted butter but no other kind that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，街角商店只有「有盐黄油」，没有别的黄油。

words.enDefinition: Small oily sea fish often sold whole or in tins

examples.en: The fishmonger arranged the sardines in rows on the ice.
examples.zh: 鱼柜店员把「沙丁鱼」一排排摆在冰上。

examples.en: My roommate bought sardines from the seafood counter on Saturday.
examples.zh: 室友周六从海鲜柜买了「沙丁鱼」。

words.enDefinition: a small container used to hold a portion of sauce

examples.en: The sauce cup had a lid, so I could carry it back to my flat.
examples.zh: 「小酱汁杯」有盖子，我就能把它带回公寓。

examples.en: I opened the sauce cup over my plate before dipping the dumplings in it.
examples.zh: 我在盘子上方打开「小酱汁杯」，然后拿饺子蘸着吃。

collocations: a sauce cup with a lid

words.enDefinition: Sauce served in its own container apart from the main food

examples.en: I ordered the fish with sauce on the side for our shared lunch.
examples.zh: 我们一起吃午饭，我点了鱼，请店员把「酱汁另外放」。

examples.en: I asked whether the café always served sauce on the side with that dish.
examples.zh: 我问这家咖啡馆上这道菜时是不是总把「酱汁另外放」。

collocations: ask for sauce on the side
order with sauce on the side

words.enDefinition: A thin edible or removable covering holding sausage meat together

examples.en: I asked whether the sausage casing was mentioned on the package.
examples.zh: 我问包装上有没有注明「香肠肠衣」的材质。

examples.en: The deli worker pointed out a tear in the sausage casing.
examples.zh: 熟食柜店员指出「香肠肠衣」上有个破口。

collocations: a tear in the sausage casing

words.enDefinition: Individual portions of sausage formed in casings and often joined together

examples.en: We bought four sausage links for the breakfast at our flat.
examples.zh: 我们买了四根「分节香肠」，准备在合租公寓吃早餐。

examples.en: The butcher cut two sausage links off the chain for me.
examples.zh: 肉柜店员从一串里剪下两根「分节香肠」给我。

words.enDefinition: A flat, round portion of seasoned ground sausage meat

examples.en: My roommate ordered a sandwich with a sausage patty inside it.
examples.zh: 室友点了一个夹「香肠肉饼」的三明治。

examples.en: The shop sold each sausage patty separately at the hot counter.
examples.zh: 店里的热食柜把「香肠肉饼」按个卖。

words.enDefinition: to cook food quickly in a small amount of fat over fairly high heat

examples.en: I used a small pan to sauté mushrooms for the toast at breakfast.
examples.zh: 我用小平底锅「用少量油快炒」蘑菇，早餐配吐司吃。

examples.en: The recipe says to sauté the garlic briefly before adding the tomatoes.
examples.zh: 食谱说，先把蒜「用少量油快炒」一下，再加番茄。

words.enDefinition: To read the barcode on a produce sticker electronically

examples.en: I couldn't scan the produce label because I'd stuck it across a fold.
examples.zh: 我贴标签时跨过了一个折痕，结果没法「扫描蔬果标签」。

examples.en: The cashier asked me to scan the produce label at the self-service checkout.
examples.zh: 收银员让我在自助结账机上「扫描蔬果标签」。

collocations: try to scan the produce label
scan the produce label at checkout
ask someone to scan the produce label

words.enDefinition: An amount slightly smaller than a full measuring teaspoon

examples.en: The recipe lists a scant teaspoon of ground cinnamon for the filling.
examples.zh: 菜谱上写着，做馅要放「略少于一茶匙」的肉桂粉。

examples.en: We checked what a scant teaspoon meant before measuring the spice.
examples.zh: 量香料之前，我们查了「略少于一茶匙」这个说法。

words.enDefinition: a food delivery arranged for a chosen future time

examples.en: I booked a scheduled meal delivery for after the last rehearsal of the evening.
examples.zh: 我预约了「时段送餐」，让外卖在晚上最后一次排练后送到。

examples.en: Our group used scheduled meal delivery so the food would arrive when everyone was free.
examples.zh: 我们小组用了「预约时段送餐」，这样大家都有空时餐才能送到。

words.enDefinition: to make shallow cuts on dough to guide expansion during baking

examples.en: The instructor showed how to score the dough before sliding it into the oven.
examples.zh: 老师示范了面团进烤箱之前怎样「在面团表面割口」。

examples.en: I practised how to score the dough on the first loaf I made.
examples.zh: 我用自己做的第一条面包练习怎样「在面团表面割口」。

collocations: use a blade to score the dough

words.enDefinition: To move mixture from the sides of a bowl back into it

examples.en: The baker told us to scrape down the sides before adding the rest of the flour.
examples.zh: 老师让我们在加入剩余面粉前「把碗壁上的材料刮下」。

examples.en: I looked for a spatula to scrape down the sides between additions.
examples.zh: 每次加料的间隙，我都想找把刮刀「把碗壁上的材料刮下」。

collocations: scrape down the sides of the bowl
use a spatula to scrape down the sides
stop to scrape down the sides

words.enDefinition: A market name for several marine fish sold for food

examples.en: The fishmonger displayed sea bass with its name written on a card.
examples.zh: 鱼柜店员在「海鲈鱼」旁放了一张写着鱼名的牌子。

examples.en: I asked whether I could buy a single fillet of sea bass.
examples.zh: 我问能不能只买一块「海鲈鱼」鱼柳。

words.enDefinition: Sea-dwelling scallops sold mainly for their large, round edible muscles

examples.en: The fishmonger showed us sea scallops in a shallow tray on ice.
examples.zh: 鱼柜店员给我们看了冰上一只浅托盘里的「大型扇贝肉」。

examples.en: I asked whether the sea scallops came in smaller portions as well.
examples.zh: 我问「大型扇贝肉」有没有更小的份量可买。

words.enDefinition: a takeout bag with its opening closed and fastened

examples.en: The courier handed me a sealed takeout bag with the receipt stapled to the top.
examples.zh: 配送员递给我一个「封好的外卖袋」，小票订在袋口上。

examples.en: I left the sealed takeout bag on the table until my project partner got back.
examples.zh: 在项目搭档回来前，我把「封好的外卖袋」放在了桌上。

collocations: hand over a sealed takeout bag

words.enDefinition: to expose food to strong heat briefly so its surface browns

examples.en: I watched the cook sear the tofu before adding it to the sauce.
examples.zh: 我看厨师先把豆腐「高温煎至表面上色」，再放进酱汁。

examples.en: The demonstration showed how to sear the outside without cooking the whole piece through.
examples.zh: 示范展示了怎样只「高温煎至表面上色」，同时不让整块食材熟透。

collocations: quickly sear a piece of fish

words.enDefinition: To adjust seasonings according to how you want food to taste

examples.en: The dressing recipe says to season to taste after adding the lemon juice.
examples.zh: 调酱汁的菜谱说，加了柠檬汁之后再「按口味调味」。

examples.en: I asked what season to taste meant in the instructions for the dip.
examples.zh: 我问蘸酱的做法里写的「按口味调味」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: A changing selection featuring ingredients available at a particular time of year

examples.en: The café posted its new seasonal menu beside the front door.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆在前门旁贴出了新的「时令菜单」。

examples.en: My flatmate chose a dish from the seasonal menu after class.
examples.zh: 我室友下课后从「时令菜单」上点了一道菜。

words.enDefinition: Fruit and vegetables available around their usual harvest time

examples.en: The market puts seasonal produce near the entrance so shoppers can see what just arrived.
examples.zh: 市场把「应季蔬果」摆在入口附近，让顾客能看见刚到的货。

examples.en: I asked which seasonal produce would still be on the stall in late May.
examples.zh: 我问到了五月底，摊位上还会有哪些「应季蔬果」。

words.enDefinition: To choose an available table without waiting for staff to assign one

examples.en: The sign said "Seat yourself," so we sat in the corner.
examples.zh: 牌子上写着「请自行入座」，我们就在角落坐下了。

examples.en: I asked what "Seat yourself" meant before walking past the entrance.
examples.zh: 进门之前，我问了「请自行入座」是什么意思。

collocations: a sign saying to seat yourself
ask if you can seat yourself

words.enDefinition: the stage when yeast dough is allowed to rise again after its initial rise

examples.en: My flatmate covered the rolls with a cloth during their second rise.
examples.zh: 面包卷「二次发酵」时，室友用布把它们盖了起来。

examples.en: The recipe allows time for a second rise before the bread goes into the oven.
examples.zh: 食谱在面包进烤箱前留了「二次发酵」的时间。

words.enDefinition: Grapes without hard mature seeds

examples.en: I picked up seedless grapes before heading to the library with my flatmates.
examples.zh: 和室友去图书馆之前，我买了点「无籽葡萄」。

examples.en: The sign said both colours were seedless grapes, so I chose the darker ones.
examples.zh: 标签写着两种颜色的都是「无籽葡萄」，所以我选了颜色深的。

words.enDefinition: wheat flour sold with a raising agent already mixed into it

examples.en: I checked whether the scone recipe needed self-raising flour before going to the store.
examples.zh: 去商店之前，我查了司康食谱需不需要「自发面粉」。

examples.en: The shelf label distinguished self-raising flour from the ordinary type in a nearby bag.
examples.zh: 货架标签把「自发面粉」与旁边袋子里的普通面粉区分开。

words.enDefinition: A meal where diners choose and serve their own food from displays

examples.en: The university held a self-service buffet for students arriving before term.
examples.zh: 学校为开学前到校的同学办了一场「自取式自助餐」。

examples.en: Our group chose the self-service buffet because everyone wanted different dishes.
examples.zh: 每个人想吃的菜都不同，所以我们选了「自取式自助餐」。

words.enDefinition: A scale shoppers operate to weigh their purchases

examples.en: I took my apples to the self-service scale beside the shelf of reusable bags.
examples.zh: 我把苹果拿到可重复使用的袋子货架旁的「自助秤」上。

examples.en: The self-service scale showed a picture of the fruit before I chose the label.
examples.zh: 我选择标签前，「自助秤」显示了水果的图片。

collocations: weigh fruit on a self-service scale
a self-service scale in the produce section

words.zhGloss: 零售陈列截止日期（美国）
words.enDefinition: A retail date marking the end of display for sale
acceptedZhAnswers: 零售陈列截止日期（美国）

examples.en: The U.S. supermarket printed a sell-by date next to the barcode on this pack.
examples.zh: 这家美国超市把「零售陈列截止日期」印在了这个包装的条形码旁。

examples.en: I noticed a sell-by date on the U.S. carton when we compared sample labels.
examples.zh: 比较标签样本时，我注意到美国那个纸盒上印着「零售陈列截止日期」。

collocations: a sell-by date for stock rotation

words.enDefinition: milk with some but not all of its fat removed, especially in the UK

examples.en: I picked up semi-skimmed milk from the shelf below the large cartons.
examples.zh: 我从大盒牛奶下面那层货架上拿了「半脱脂牛奶」。

examples.en: The café asked if I wanted semi-skimmed milk in my hot chocolate.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆问我要不要在热巧克力里加「半脱脂牛奶」。

words.enDefinition: To ask staff to take back a dish with a problem

examples.en: I asked if I could send a dish back because it was the wrong order.
examples.zh: 上的不是我点的菜，我问能不能「把菜退回厨房」。

examples.en: My friend decided to send a dish back after speaking quietly with the server.
examples.zh: 朋友和服务员小声说过情况后，决定「把菜退回厨房」。

collocations: ask to send a dish back
decide to send a dish back
when to send a dish back

words.enDefinition: deliver the item that was left out of an order

examples.en: Could you send out the missing item if the driver is still near campus?
examples.zh: 如果配送员还在学校附近，能「把漏掉的餐品补送来」吗？

examples.en: The café offered to send out the missing item with another delivery going past our residence.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆提出等另一单经过我们的宿舍时，「把漏掉的餐品补送来」。

collocations: could you send out the missing item?
ask the restaurant to send out the missing item
offer to send out the missing item

words.enDefinition: Individual plates provided so diners can share food and eat separately

examples.en: We asked for separate plates to share the dessert more easily.
examples.zh: 我们要了「分开的盘子」，好分着吃甜点。

examples.en: The server brought two separate plates with the sharing platter.
examples.zh: 服务员端来分享拼盘，也给了我们两个「分开的盘子」。

words.enDefinition: Separate tools kept for different foods or people

examples.en: The server showed us which dishes had separate utensils on the buffet table.
examples.zh: 服务员给我们指出，自助餐台哪些菜品配了「分开使用的用具」。

examples.en: I asked whether the kitchen used separate utensils when preparing the two orders.
examples.zh: 我问厨房准备这两份餐时，会不会「分开使用用具」。

collocations: keep separate utensils for each dish

words.enDefinition: to serve food or drink after it has been cooled in a refrigerator

examples.en: The recipe says to serve chilled once the berry mixture has cooled completely.
examples.zh: 食谱说，浆果混合物完全凉透后，再「冰凉时端上桌」。

examples.en: We planned to serve chilled, so the dessert went into the refrigerator earlier.
examples.zh: 我们打算「冰凉时端上桌」，所以甜点早些时候就放进冰箱了。

words.enDefinition: to offer the food to eat as soon as it is ready

examples.en: The recipe says to serve immediately so the toast stays crisp underneath.
examples.zh: 食谱说要「做好就端上桌」，这样吐司底面还脆。

examples.en: We decided to serve immediately because everyone was already sitting at the table.
examples.zh: 大家已经坐在餐桌旁，我们决定「做好就端上桌」。

words.enDefinition: To bring the opening dish before other parts of the meal

examples.en: We asked the server to serve the starter first while we chose our main dishes.
examples.zh: 我们点主菜时，请服务员「先上前菜」。

examples.en: The restaurant said it would serve the starter first and then bring the noodles.
examples.zh: 餐厅说会「先上前菜」，接着端上面条。

collocations: ask to serve the starter first
offer to serve the starter first
remember to serve the starter first

words.enDefinition: to offer food while it is still pleasantly warm

examples.en: The instructions say to serve warm with a spoonful of plain yogurt.
examples.zh: 说明里写着配一勺原味酸奶，「温热时端上桌」。

examples.en: I chose to serve warm rolls alongside the soup for our guests.
examples.zh: 我选了「端上温热的」面包卷，和汤一起招待客人。

words.enDefinition: To take the food or drink you want without waiting for staff

examples.en: The sign said "Serve yourself," with the plates on a table nearby.
examples.zh: 牌子上写着「请自取」，餐盘放在旁边的桌上。

examples.en: I asked what "Serve yourself" meant on the sign by the drinks.
examples.zh: 我问饮品旁的牌子写的「请自取」是什么意思。

collocations: a sign saying to serve yourself

words.enDefinition: A person who takes orders and serves food in a restaurant

examples.en: The server brought us a second menu when our friend arrived.
examples.zh: 朋友到了之后，「餐厅服务员」又给我们拿来一份菜单。

examples.en: I asked the server which of the dishes came with rice.
examples.zh: 我问「餐厅服务员」哪些菜配米饭。

words.enDefinition: a platform charge for arranging a restaurant order

examples.en: I noticed the service fee on our pizza order after checking the final total.
examples.zh: 我核对最终总价时，注意到披萨订单里有「外卖平台服务费」。

examples.en: The app listed the service fee separately from the cost of sending the courier.
examples.zh: 应用把「外卖平台服务费」和配送员送餐的费用分开列。

words.enDefinition: A line of diners waiting to be given food or serve themselves

examples.en: Our class joined the serving line together after the lecture ended.
examples.zh: 讲座结束后，我们班的同学一起加入了「排队打饭的队伍」。

examples.en: The serving line split into two queues near the hot dishes.
examples.zh: 到热菜附近时，「排队打饭的队伍」分成了两列。

words.enDefinition: tools such as large spoons or tongs used to serve food

examples.en: The caterer dropped off serving utensils with the trays for our student society dinner.
examples.zh: 餐饮店把「分餐用具」和我们社团聚餐用的几盘菜一起送了过来。

examples.en: I asked for serving utensils because we were sharing dishes around one big table.
examples.zh: 大家要围着一张大桌子分着吃菜，所以我要了「分餐用具」。

words.enDefinition: Small oil-rich seeds used to flavour food

examples.en: I looked for sesame on the label at the small shop near campus.
examples.zh: 我在学校附近的小店查看标签上有没有「芝麻」。

examples.en: The server checked whether the bread had sesame on top or inside.
examples.zh: 服务员查了面包上的「芝麻」是撒在表面还是加在里面。

words.enDefinition: Described as not containing sesame

examples.en: I looked for a sesame-free option on the prepacked lunch menu at the café.
examples.zh: 我在咖啡馆的预包装午餐菜单里找「不含芝麻的」选项。

examples.en: The sesame-free label was on one variety rather than on the entire shelf.
examples.zh: 「不含芝麻」的标签贴在一个品种上，没有贴在整层货架上。

words.enDefinition: to become firm enough in the centre to hold its shape

examples.en: The custard needed more time to set in the middle before we served it.
examples.zh: 蛋奶冻还需要一点时间让「中心凝固」，再端上桌。

examples.en: I waited for the filling to set in the middle before slicing the pie.
examples.zh: 我等馅料「中心凝固」后，才切开派。

collocations: allow the filling to set in the middle
begin to set in the middle
check that it has set in the middle

words.enDefinition: A menu offering a defined selection of courses at one price

examples.en: We tried the set menu because there were several courses to share.
examples.zh: 我们点了「固定套餐菜单」上的餐，里面有好几道菜可以一起吃。

examples.en: The set menu offered two choices for each course of the meal.
examples.zh: 「固定套餐菜单」的每一道都能从两种菜里选。

words.enDefinition: A small bulb with a mild onion flavour

examples.en: I picked a shallot from the small basket between the onions and the garlic.
examples.zh: 我在洋葱和大蒜中间的小篮里挑了一个「红葱头」。

examples.en: The cashier checked whether the bulb in my bag was a shallot or an onion.
examples.zh: 收银员核实我袋里的那个是「红葱头」还是洋葱。

words.enDefinition: to fry food in oil that comes partway up its sides without covering it

examples.en: Our instructor showed us how to shallow-fry the fritters in a wide pan.
examples.zh: 老师用一个宽平底锅，示范怎样给炸饼「浅油煎炸」。

examples.en: The recipe says to shallow-fry the cakes until both sides are crisp.
examples.zh: 食谱说，把饼「浅油煎炸」，直到两面变脆。

words.enDefinition: To form pieces of a mixture into round shapes

examples.en: The recipe says the pieces should be shaped into balls before assembly.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，这些小块要先「做成球形」，再进行组装。

examples.en: I asked whether to shape into balls or flatten the mixture instead.
examples.zh: 我问要把混合物「做成球形」，还是压扁。

collocations: shape into balls of equal size

words.enDefinition: A fryer used for more than one food

examples.en: I asked whether the café cooked the fries in a shared fryer.
examples.zh: 我问咖啡馆会不会用「共用炸锅」炸薯条。

examples.en: The shared fryer was mentioned in a note at the bottom of the menu.
examples.zh: 菜单底部的一条注释提到了「共用炸锅」。

words.enDefinition: A large plate of food intended to be eaten by several people

examples.en: Three of us ordered a sharing platter of dips and bread.
examples.zh: 我们三个人点了一份有蘸酱和面包的「分享拼盘」。

examples.en: The server explained how many people the sharing platter would serve.
examples.zh: 服务员说明了这份「分享拼盘」够几个人吃。

words.enDefinition: Able to be stored unopened without refrigeration

examples.en: The campus pantry kept shelf-stable cartons on a different shelf from fresh deliveries.
examples.zh: 学校食品救济站把「可常温储存的」盒装食品和新到的生鲜分开摆放。

examples.en: I checked which drinks were described as shelf-stable before helping to arrange the shelves.
examples.zh: 帮忙整理货架前，我查看了哪些饮料标为「可常温储存」。

words.enDefinition: Shrimp sold with the outer body shell still attached

examples.en: I asked whether the shell-on shrimp were sold by weight at the counter.
examples.zh: 我问鱼柜的「带壳虾」是不是按重量卖。

examples.en: The supermarket had shell-on shrimp near the packs of peeled shrimp.
examples.zh: 超市把「带壳虾」放在几盒去壳虾旁边。

words.enDefinition: Edible crustaceans and molluscs, such as prawns and mussels

examples.en: The menu used shellfish for dishes containing prawns, mussels or both at the café.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆菜单把含虾、贻贝或两者都有的菜标为「甲壳及软体类水产」。

examples.en: I asked the server which soups contained shellfish before we ordered at the counter.
examples.zh: 我们在柜台点餐前，我问服务员哪些汤含「甲壳及软体类水产」。

words.zhGloss: 不含甲壳及软体类水产的
words.enDefinition: Described as not containing shellfish
acceptedZhAnswers: 不含甲壳及软体类水产的

examples.en: I asked the dining team which dishes were described as shellfish-free on their menu.
examples.zh: 我问餐厅工作人员，菜单上哪些菜标为「不含甲壳及软体类水产」。

examples.en: The chef showed me where shellfish-free appeared in the list of meal options.
examples.zh: 厨师指给我看菜单选项中哪里标着「不含甲壳及软体类水产」。

words.enDefinition: A mushroom with a dark cap and savoury flavour

examples.en: I asked for shiitake mushrooms because those were the ones on my flatmate's list.
examples.zh: 我问有没有「香菇」，因为室友的清单上要买的是这种。

examples.en: The sign showed a shiitake mushroom with a broad brown cap and pale stem.
examples.zh: 标签上画了一朵「香菇」，有宽宽的褐色菌盖和浅色菌柄。

words.enDefinition: Near its best-before or use-by date

examples.en: The British supermarket set out short-dated items on a shelf beside the checkout.
examples.zh: 这家英国超市把「临近食用标示日期的」食品摆在收银台旁的货架上。

examples.en: I asked what short-dated meant on the label for the packaged sandwiches.
examples.zh: 我问包装三明治的标签上写的「临近食用标示日期」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: rice with short, rounded grains that often cling together when cooked

examples.en: The shop keeps short-grain rice near the ingredients for making sushi rolls.
examples.zh: 店里把「短粒米」放在寿司卷食材附近。

examples.en: I chose short-grain rice for the bowl with grilled vegetables and egg.
examples.zh: 我选「短粒米」做盖饭，上面配烤蔬菜和鸡蛋。

words.enDefinition: To guide you to the table assigned to you

examples.en: The host said, "A colleague will show you to your table in a moment."
examples.zh: 迎宾员说，马上会有同事「领你们到座位」。

examples.en: The host told my friend, "I can show you to your table by the window."
examples.zh: 迎宾员跟我朋友说，可以「领你到靠窗的座位」。

collocations: come to show you to your table
ready to show you to your table
wait to show you to your table

words.enDefinition: To divide food into many long, thin pieces or strips

examples.en: The recipe says to shred the cabbage for the sandwich filling.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，要把夹三明治的卷心菜「切成细丝」。

examples.en: I used a grater to shred the carrots for our salad.
examples.zh: 我用擦丝器把做沙拉的胡萝卜「切成细丝」。

words.enDefinition: cheese cut or grated into long thin pieces

examples.en: I sprinkled shredded cheese over the potatoes before serving them to my flatmates.
examples.zh: 给室友端上土豆前，我撒了些「刨丝奶酪」。

examples.en: The shop sold bags of shredded cheese beside the blocks of cheddar.
examples.zh: 商店把袋装「刨丝奶酪」放在一块块切达奶酪旁边。

collocations: sprinkle shredded cheese over a dish

words.enDefinition: A menu category for side dishes and additional ingredients

examples.en: The menu listed bread and extra dressing under sides and extras near the bottom.
examples.zh: 菜单接近底部的「配菜与加料」栏列出了面包和额外的酱汁。

examples.en: I checked the sides and extras section before choosing something for the table.
examples.zh: 给大家点东西之前，我先看了「配菜与加料」一栏。

collocations: a section for sides and extras

words.enDefinition: To pass flour through a sieve to remove lumps

examples.en: I borrowed a fine sieve to sift flour for the cake.
examples.zh: 我借了一个细筛子，准备给蛋糕「过筛面粉」。

examples.en: My flatmate asked whether we needed to sift flour for this recipe.
examples.zh: 室友问我们这道菜谱要不要「过筛面粉」。

words.enDefinition: A dish a restaurant or chef is especially known for

examples.en: We shared the signature dish after the server recommended it to us.
examples.zh: 服务员推荐了「招牌菜」，我们就点了一份分着吃。

examples.en: The menu showed a photo of the restaurant's signature dish.
examples.zh: 菜单上印着这家餐厅「招牌菜」的照片。

words.enDefinition: A flexible kitchen tool used to scrape or fold mixtures

examples.en: I used a silicone spatula to get the batter out of the bowl.
examples.zh: 我用「硅胶刮刀」把面糊从碗里刮出来。

examples.en: The silicone spatula was soft enough to bend against the bowl.
examples.zh: 「硅胶刮刀」很软，可以弯曲贴着碗壁。

words.enDefinition: to cook in liquid kept just below or at a very gentle boil

examples.en: I left the sauce to simmer while chopping the herbs for dinner.
examples.zh: 我让酱汁「小火慢煮」，同时切好晚餐用的香草。

examples.en: The soup can simmer while we prepare the plates for our guests.
examples.zh: 我们给客人摆盘时，可以让汤继续「小火慢煮」。

words.enDefinition: to cook a liquid at a gentle simmer without covering its container

examples.en: The recipe asked me to simmer uncovered so the sauce could thicken.
examples.zh: 食谱要求「不盖锅盖小火慢煮」，让酱汁收浓。

examples.en: I left the soup to simmer uncovered while the bread finished warming.
examples.zh: 面包加热好之前，我让汤「不盖锅盖小火慢煮」。

collocations: leave a sauce to simmer uncovered

words.enDefinition: a British cream with less fat than double cream, used for pouring or cooking

examples.en: I bought single cream to stir into the soup we were serving.
examples.zh: 我买了「英式稀奶油」，打算搅进要端上桌的汤里。

examples.en: The supermarket put single cream in small cartons next to the milk.
examples.zh: 超市把小盒装的「英式稀奶油」放在牛奶旁边。

words.enDefinition: A steak cut from the rear part of the beef loin

examples.en: My roommate compared the sirloin steak with the cut on the shelf below.
examples.zh: 室友把「西冷牛排」和下层货架上的那块肉作了比较。

examples.en: We bought one sirloin steak to split between two people for dinner.
examples.zh: 我们买了一块「西冷牛排」，晚饭两个人分着吃。

words.enDefinition: milk from which nearly all of the fat has been removed

examples.en: I bought skim milk in a small bottle for cereal in the morning.
examples.zh: 我买了一小瓶「脱脂牛奶」，早上泡麦片。

examples.en: The coffee stand ran out of skim milk just before the morning break.
examples.zh: 上午课间休息前，咖啡摊正好用完了「脱脂牛奶」。

words.enDefinition: A cut of fish sold with the skin still attached

examples.en: I picked a skin-on fillet from the two pieces of salmon.
examples.zh: 两块三文鱼里，我挑了那块「带皮鱼柳」。

examples.en: The label confirmed that the pack contained a single skin-on fillet.
examples.zh: 标签确认，这盒只装了一块「带皮鱼柳」。

words.enDefinition: A long, thin beef steak cut from the diaphragm area

examples.en: I showed the butcher the recipe because I could not find skirt steak.
examples.zh: 我找不到「横膈膜牛排」，就把菜谱拿给肉柜店员看。

examples.en: The label on the skirt steak gave its weight and price.
examples.zh: 「横膈膜牛排」的标签上写着这块肉的重量和价格。

words.enDefinition: To cut food into pieces with very little thickness

examples.en: I asked whether to slice thinly or leave the pieces a little thicker.
examples.zh: 我问是要「切成薄片」，还是把片切厚一点。

examples.en: For the salad, the recipe says to slice thinly rather than cut into cubes.
examples.zh: 沙拉菜谱要求「切成薄片」，别切成方丁。

words.enDefinition: Prepared ham cut into thin pieces for serving or sandwiches

examples.en: We bought sliced ham and bread for lunch after the seminar.
examples.zh: 研讨课结束后，我们买了「火腿切片」和面包当午餐。

examples.en: A small pack of sliced ham was enough for our sandwiches.
examples.zh: 一小盒「火腿切片」就够我们做三明治了。

words.enDefinition: Cut into slices as requested by the customer at purchase

examples.en: The deli had roast beef sliced to order for customers at the counter.
examples.zh: 熟食柜给柜台顾客提供「按顾客要求切片」的烤牛肉。

examples.en: I asked whether the salami could be sliced to order for my sandwiches.
examples.zh: 我问给三明治用的萨拉米香肠可不可以「按顾客要求切片」。

words.enDefinition: Prepared turkey meat cut into thin pieces for serving cold

examples.en: My roommate picked up sliced turkey for sandwiches before our morning lecture.
examples.zh: 室友早课前买了「火鸡肉切片」，打算做三明治。

examples.en: The deli put the sliced turkey in a flat packet for me.
examples.zh: 熟食柜店员帮我把「火鸡肉切片」装进一个扁平包装。

words.enDefinition: to cook food for a long time at a low temperature or gentle setting

examples.en: My flatmate planned to slow-cook the vegetables while working on an essay.
examples.zh: 室友打算一边写论文，一边把蔬菜「长时间低温烹煮」。

examples.en: The recipe says to slow-cook the onions so their flavour develops gradually.
examples.zh: 食谱说把洋葱「长时间低温烹煮」，让味道慢慢出来。

words.enDefinition: to roast food at a relatively low temperature for a long time

examples.en: My flatmate wanted to slow-roast the tomatoes for our sauce on Sunday.
examples.zh: 室友想周日把番茄「低温慢烤」，用来做酱汁。

examples.en: The recipe uses the term slow-roast for the vegetables in the main dish.
examples.zh: 食谱把主菜蔬菜的烹法称为「低温慢烤」。

words.enDefinition: an extra charge for ordering below a stated amount

examples.en: The app added a small order fee because I was only ordering one sandwich.
examples.zh: 我只点一份三明治，应用加收了「小额订单附加费」。

examples.en: We shared an order to avoid the small order fee on two separate meals.
examples.zh: 我们合在一个单里点餐，省下分两单的「小额订单附加费」。

words.enDefinition: Small portions of prepared dishes served as part of a meal

examples.en: The café offered small plates for people wanting a lighter lunch.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆为想少吃一点的人提供「小份菜」。

examples.en: Our group ordered three small plates instead of one large dish each.
examples.zh: 我们一行点了三份「小份菜」，没有每人点一大份。

words.enDefinition: Ham processed with smoke to give it a distinctive flavor

examples.en: The deli had smoked ham beside the roasted turkey in the glass case.
examples.zh: 熟食冷柜里，「熏火腿」摆在烤火鸡旁边。

examples.en: My roommate asked for smoked ham because she remembered it from home.
examples.zh: 室友想买「熏火腿」，因为她记得家里吃过这个。

words.enDefinition: ground dried peppers made smoky during drying, used to season food

examples.en: I added smoked paprika to the chickpeas before putting them in the oven.
examples.zh: 把鹰嘴豆放进烤箱前，我加了「烟熏甜椒粉」。

examples.en: The grocery store sold smoked paprika in a small tin beside the other spices.
examples.zh: 杂货店的小罐「烟熏甜椒粉」就在其他香料旁边。

words.enDefinition: Salmon flavored by smoking and often sold in slices

examples.en: The store had smoked salmon beside the cream cheese and bagels.
examples.zh: 店里把「熏三文鱼」摆在奶油奶酪和贝果旁边。

examples.en: I asked the deli worker how much the smoked salmon weighed.
examples.zh: 我问熟食柜的店员那份「熏三文鱼」有多重。

words.enDefinition: A lid that clicks into place when pushed

examples.en: The box had a snap-on lid that clicked when I pressed the sides.
examples.zh: 盒子有个「按扣式盒盖」，我按两侧时听到了咔哒声。

examples.en: I found the snap-on lid for my lunch container behind the larger ones.
examples.zh: 我在较大的那些盒盖后面找到了午餐盒的「按扣式盒盖」。

collocations: a container with a snap-on lid

words.enDefinition: Japanese noodles typically made with buckwheat flour, sometimes mixed with wheat flour

examples.en: We served soba noodles with cold dipping sauce after our afternoon picnic.
examples.zh: 下午野餐回来，我们吃了配冷蘸汁的「荞麦面条」。

examples.en: I checked the ingredients on the soba noodles because some brands use wheat.
examples.zh: 我看了「荞麦面条」的配料，因为有些牌子会用小麦。

collocations: serve soba noodles with a dipping sauce

words.enDefinition: A Pacific salmon species known for its deep red flesh

examples.en: The sockeye salmon looked darker than the other salmon in the case.
examples.zh: 展示柜里，「红鲑」看起来比其他鲑鱼颜色更深。

examples.en: I compared the price of the sockeye salmon with the regular salmon.
examples.zh: 我把「红鲑」的价格和普通鲑鱼的价格比较了一下。

words.enDefinition: to boil an egg so that the yolk remains soft

examples.en: I wanted to soft-boil the eggs for breakfast in our shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 我想在共用厨房做早餐，把鸡蛋「煮成溏心」。

examples.en: My flatmate chose to soft-boil an egg for the noodle bowl.
examples.zh: 室友决定把鸡蛋「煮成溏心」，放进汤面里。

words.enDefinition: Soft points that droop when whipped cream or egg whites are lifted

examples.en: The instructor showed how to recognize soft peaks in the mixing bowl.
examples.zh: 老师示范了如何辨认搅拌碗里的「软尖峰」。

examples.en: The picture of soft peaks showed the tip bending over slightly.
examples.zh: 「软尖峰」的图片显示顶端轻轻弯了下去。

collocations: beat the cream to soft peaks

words.enDefinition: A small area that feels softer than the rest

examples.en: I noticed a soft spot on one side of the pear at the market.
examples.zh: 我在市场发现这个梨的一侧「有一小块发软」。

examples.en: I checked the mango for a soft spot before putting it in my bag.
examples.zh: 我把芒果放进袋子前看了看有没有「一小块发软的地方」。

collocations: a soft spot on a pear

words.enDefinition: Priced for a group of items tied together

examples.en: The spring onions were sold by the bunch at the stall near campus.
examples.zh: 学校附近的摊位上，青葱是「按把出售」的。

examples.en: I asked which herbs were sold by the bunch instead of in plastic packets.
examples.zh: 我问哪些香草是「按把出售」的，而不是用塑料袋预先包好的。

collocations: sold by the bunch at the market
sold by the bunch or by weight

words.enDefinition: Sold for a price calculated from how much the portion weighs

examples.en: At this deli, the ham is sold by weight instead of by the slice.
examples.zh: 这家熟食柜的火腿「按重量出售」，不按片卖。

examples.en: The sold by weight label was placed above the display of fresh fish.
examples.zh: 鲜鱼展示柜上方的标签写着「按重量出售」。

words.enDefinition: Priced for each separate item

examples.en: The small melons were sold individually, so I could take just one for the picnic.
examples.zh: 小瓜是「按个出售」的，我只买一个带去野餐就行。

examples.en: I asked whether the apples were sold individually or if I needed the whole bag.
examples.zh: 我问苹果是「按个出售」，还是得买一整袋。

words.enDefinition: A phrase saying a part of the order has not arrived

examples.en: My roommate said, "Something is missing." She checked the receipt again.
examples.zh: 室友说「少了一样东西」，又核对了一遍小票。

examples.en: At lunch I said, "Something is missing." We were waiting for the side.
examples.zh: 午饭时我说「少了一样东西」，我们还在等配菜。

collocations: say "Something is missing from our order."
explain "Something is missing from this meal."
tell the server "Something is missing from the tray."

words.enDefinition: Any drink someone might want to order or be served

examples.en: The server asked if we wanted something to drink before choosing our meals.
examples.zh: 服务员问我们选餐之前要不要来「喝的东西」。

examples.en: My roommate ordered something to drink while waiting for two friends to arrive.
examples.zh: 室友等两位朋友来时，先点了「喝的东西」。

words.zhGloss: 不好意思我点的不是这个
words.enDefinition: A polite correction when your food is not what you requested
acceptedZhAnswers: 不好意思我点的不是这个

examples.en: I told the server, "Sorry, I ordered something different," when the burger arrived.
examples.zh: 汉堡端来时，我对服务员说「不好意思，我点的不是这个」。

examples.en: My friend said, "Sorry, I ordered something different." before pointing to the menu.
examples.zh: 朋友说「不好意思，我点的不是这个」，然后指了指菜单。

collocations: start with "Sorry, I ordered something different."

words.enDefinition: The soup a restaurant is featuring on a particular day

examples.en: I asked what the soup of the day was before choosing my starter.
examples.zh: 选前菜之前，我问了「当日例汤」是什么。

examples.en: My friend ordered the soup of the day with a piece of bread.
examples.zh: 朋友点了「当日例汤」，配一片面包。

collocations: ask for the soup of the day
order the soup of the day
a bowl of the soup of the day

words.enDefinition: cream cultured to give it a thick consistency and slightly sour taste

examples.en: I put a spoonful of sour cream on each baked potato at dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭时，我在每个烤土豆上加了一勺「酸奶油」。

examples.en: The sour cream was in the same cooler as the cream cheese.
examples.zh: 「酸奶油」和奶油奶酪放在同一个冷柜里。

words.enDefinition: Soybean-derived food used in other products

examples.en: The label listed soy alongside milk in the note below the ingredients.
examples.zh: 标签在配料表下的说明里，把「大豆成分」和乳类列在一起。

examples.en: I asked whether the sauce contained soy before checking the menu for other options.
examples.zh: 我先问酱汁是不是含「大豆成分」，再看菜单上有没有别的选择。

words.enDefinition: Described as not containing soy

examples.en: The café had one soy-free dressing listed in the folder beside the menu.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆在菜单旁的文件夹里列了一种「不含大豆的」沙拉酱。

examples.en: I asked whether the soy-free label belonged to this packet or the one beside it.
examples.zh: 我问「不含大豆」的标签是贴这包的，还是旁边那包的。

words.enDefinition: A soy-derived ingredient used to help mixtures stay blended

examples.en: I found soy lecithin in the list printed inside the box flap.
examples.zh: 我在盒盖内侧印的清单里看到了「大豆卵磷脂」。

examples.en: Both chocolate bars listed soy lecithin, but the wrappers displayed it in different places.
examples.zh: 两种巧克力棒都列了「大豆卵磷脂」，但印在包装上的位置不同。

words.enDefinition: an extra food container available if one is needed

examples.en: I asked for a spare container so we could divide the noodles into two portions.
examples.zh: 我要了个「备用空餐盒」，这样可以把面条分成两份。

examples.en: The shop put a spare container in the bottom of the bag with our order.
examples.zh: 店家给我们的订单袋底还放了一个「备用空餐盒」。

words.enDefinition: A board showing dishes offered for a limited period

examples.en: The specials board was beside the counter near the main entrance.
examples.zh: 「特色菜牌」就在靠近正门的柜台旁。

examples.en: I read the specials board while my roommate found us a table.
examples.zh: 室友去找桌位的时候，我看了看「特色菜牌」。

words.enDefinition: a covering designed to stop liquid spilling from a container

examples.en: I asked for a spill-proof lid on the coffee because I was catching a bus.
examples.zh: 我得赶公交，就请店员给咖啡加个「防洒杯盖」。

examples.en: The soup arrived in a pot with a spill-proof lid and a spoon beside it.
examples.zh: 送来的汤装在有「防洒盖」的罐子里，旁边还放了个勺子。

collocations: a cup with a spill-proof lid

words.enDefinition: A leafy vegetable with soft dark green leaves

examples.en: I bought spinach on the way home because my flatmate needed some for dinner.
examples.zh: 回家路上我买了「菠菜」，因为室友做晚饭要用。

examples.en: The spinach came in a small bag that fit in our crowded shared fridge.
examples.zh: 「菠菜」是小袋装的，能放进我们塞得满满的共用冰箱。

words.enDefinition: dried peas that have had their outer skins removed and been split into halves

examples.en: My roommate bought split peas for a thick soup on a cold day.
examples.zh: 室友买了「干去皮豌豆瓣」，天冷时煮浓汤。

examples.en: The grocery shop displayed green split peas next to the red lentils.
examples.zh: 杂货店把绿色的「干去皮豌豆瓣」和红扁豆摆在一起。

words.enDefinition: a sauce whose ingredients have separated instead of remaining blended together

examples.en: The instructor showed an example of split sauce with oil floating on top.
examples.zh: 老师展示了一份油浮在表面的「油水分离的酱汁」。

examples.en: I started over after noticing the split sauce in my small saucepan.
examples.zh: 我发现小锅里是「油水分离的酱汁」，就重新做了一份。

words.enDefinition: Food that has deteriorated and is no longer fit to eat

examples.en: The cleaning roster included a line about removing spoiled food from the shared fridge.
examples.zh: 清洁值班表上有一条是清理共用冰箱里「变质的食物」。

examples.en: We reported the spoiled food that had been left at the back of the cupboard.
examples.zh: 我们反映柜子深处留有「变质的食物」。

words.enDefinition: butter or a butter blend made soft enough to spread readily

examples.en: My flatmate prefers spreadable butter for toast when we have early lectures.
examples.zh: 我们早上有课时，室友喜欢用「易涂抹黄油」抹吐司。

examples.en: I bought a tub of spreadable butter instead of a wrapped block.
examples.zh: 我买的是一盒「易涂抹黄油」，没有买纸包的整块黄油。

words.enDefinition: to return to the original shape after light pressure is removed

examples.en: The top of the cake should spring back when gently touched.
examples.zh: 轻轻碰一下蛋糕表面，它应该「受压后回弹」。

examples.en: I saw the dough spring back after my flatmate pressed it lightly.
examples.zh: 室友轻轻按了下面团，我看到它「受压后回弹」。

words.enDefinition: A young mild onion with long green leaves

examples.en: I asked if I could buy a single spring onion rather than a whole bunch.
examples.zh: 我问能不能只买一根「青葱」，不用买一整把。

examples.en: The sign marked spring onion was next to the shelf of fresh herbs.
examples.zh: 标有「青葱」的牌子就在新鲜香草的货架旁。

words.enDefinition: To press fruit so the liquid inside it comes out

examples.en: We put a bowl underneath to squeeze the juice without losing any liquid.
examples.zh: 我们在下面放了个碗，准备「挤出果汁」，免得汁液洒出来。

examples.en: My roommate offered to squeeze the juice from the last two limes.
examples.zh: 室友主动提出帮我从最后两个青柠里「挤出果汁」。

collocations: squeeze the juice from a lemon
squeeze the juice into a bowl

words.enDefinition: Round slices cut across the tube-shaped body of a squid

examples.en: The store put plain squid rings next to the breaded kind.
examples.zh: 店里把原味「鱿鱼圈」摆在裹面包糠的那种旁边。

examples.en: We compared two packs of squid rings with different weights.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两包重量不同的「鱿鱼圈」。

words.enDefinition: A container designed to sit securely on another

examples.en: I bought a stackable container that fits on the shallow shelf in our fridge.
examples.zh: 我买了一个「可叠放的容器」，能放进我们冰箱的浅层搁板。

examples.en: The stackable container left enough room for my flatmate's groceries on the same shelf.
examples.zh: 这个「可叠放的容器」在同一层架子上给室友的食品留出了足够的空间。

collocations: a stackable container with a lid

words.enDefinition: to cook vegetables using steam without putting them directly in water

examples.en: I decided to steam the vegetables while my flatmate prepared the noodles.
examples.zh: 室友准备面条时，我决定「用蒸汽蒸蔬菜」。

examples.en: The recipe says to steam the vegetables before tossing them in the dressing.
examples.zh: 食谱说，拌调味汁之前先「用蒸汽蒸蔬菜」。

collocations: steam the vegetables in a basket

words.enDefinition: whole oat kernels chopped into small pieces instead of flattened into flakes

examples.en: I bought steel-cut oats for a breakfast that I could prepare on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我买了「切粒燕麦」，打算周日做早餐。

examples.en: My flatmate explained why steel-cut oats take longer to cook than rolled oats.
examples.zh: 室友解释了为什么「切粒燕麦」比压片燕麦需要煮更久。

words.enDefinition: to cook food slowly in liquid, usually with the ingredients cut into pieces

examples.en: I watched my flatmate stew the apples for the crumble we served later.
examples.zh: 我看室友把苹果「用汤汁慢炖」，后来用来做酥粒甜点。

examples.en: The recipe asks us to stew the vegetables before adding the fresh herbs.
examples.zh: 食谱要求，先把蔬菜「用汤汁慢炖」，再加新鲜香草。

words.enDefinition: Beef sold in pieces intended for use in stews

examples.en: I saw a pack of stewing beef beside the trays of steaks.
examples.zh: 我在几盒牛排旁边看到了一盒「炖煮用牛肉」。

examples.en: The butcher showed me which of the packs contained stewing beef.
examples.zh: 肉柜店员指给我看，哪些盒子装的是「炖煮用牛肉」。

collocations: use stewing beef in a casserole

words.enDefinition: Dough that clings noticeably to hands, utensils, or other surfaces

examples.en: The sticky dough clung to the sides of our mixing bowl.
examples.zh: 「发黏的面团」粘在我们的搅拌碗内壁上。

examples.en: My flatmate wondered why this particular recipe always produced sticky dough.
examples.zh: 室友问为什么这份菜谱做出来的是「发黏的面团」。

words.enDefinition: a rice variety whose grains stick together when cooked

examples.en: We bought sticky rice to make a dessert for the student society.
examples.zh: 我们买了「糯米」给学生社团做甜点。

examples.en: The small market sold sticky rice in a bag with a blue label.
examples.zh: 小市场卖的「糯米」装在带蓝色标签的袋子里。

words.enDefinition: Firm points that stay upright in whipped cream or egg whites

examples.en: I checked the recipe photo to see how stiff peaks should look.
examples.zh: 我看了菜谱照片，确认「硬尖峰」应该是什么样子。

examples.en: Our tutor showed the difference between stiff peaks and the earlier stage.
examples.zh: 老师展示了「硬尖峰」和前一阶段的区别。

collocations: whisk egg whites to stiff peaks

words.enDefinition: to keep mixing something without pausing during a particular part of cooking

examples.en: The recipe says to stir constantly while the thick mixture is heating.
examples.zh: 食谱说，浓稠的混合物加热时要「不断搅拌」。

examples.en: I needed to stir constantly because the sauce was starting to stick.
examples.zh: 酱汁开始粘锅了，我需要「不断搅拌」。

words.enDefinition: to cook small pieces of food quickly over high heat while stirring

examples.en: I used the wok to stir-fry greens for dinner in our shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 我在共用厨房用炒锅「翻炒」绿叶菜做晚饭。

examples.en: The recipe asks you to stir-fry the vegetables before adding the sauce.
examples.zh: 食谱要求先「翻炒」蔬菜，再加酱汁。

words.enDefinition: To add an ingredient to a mixture by stirring it

examples.en: I almost forgot to stir in the lemon juice at the end.
examples.zh: 我差点忘了最后把柠檬汁「搅拌加入」。

examples.en: The note tells us when to stir in the remaining flour.
examples.zh: 备注告诉我们什么时候把剩余的面粉「搅拌加入」。

words.enDefinition: to mix something from time to time while it is cooking

examples.en: The soup recipe says to stir occasionally while the vegetables soften in the pot.
examples.zh: 汤的食谱说，锅里的蔬菜煮软过程中要「不时搅拌」。

examples.en: I asked my flatmate to stir occasionally while I cleared the table.
examples.zh: 我收拾桌子时，请室友「不时搅拌」一下。

collocations: allow to simmer and stir occasionally

words.enDefinition: To move ingredients together until they form a single mixture

examples.en: I checked what stir until combined meant before preparing the salad dressing.
examples.zh: 我在调沙拉酱之前查了「搅拌至混合均匀」是什么意思。

examples.en: The recipe says to stir until combined before pouring the mixture into the dish.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，先「搅拌至混合均匀」，再把混合物倒进盘里。

collocations: stir until combined after each addition
the instruction to stir until combined

words.enDefinition: a small solid concentrate that dissolves in water to make stock

examples.en: I dropped a stock cube into the pot before adding the vegetables.
examples.zh: 我先把一块「高汤块」放进锅里，然后再加蔬菜。

examples.en: The grocery store had a vegetable stock cube beside the chicken flavour.
examples.zh: 杂货店有蔬菜口味的「高汤块」，就放在鸡味的旁边。

words.enDefinition: Fruit containing a single large hard stone

examples.en: The fruit stand put peaches and plums under a sign that said stone fruit.
examples.zh: 水果摊把桃子和李子摆在写着「核果」的牌子下。

examples.en: I asked which stone fruit would still be in stock for next week's picnic.
examples.zh: 我问给下周野餐买水果时，还能买到哪些「核果」。

words.enDefinition: The surroundings needed when keeping a product

examples.en: The carton listed storage conditions beside the other information from the supplier.
examples.zh: 包装盒把「储存条件」和供应商的其他说明列在一起。

examples.en: I checked the storage conditions on the sample label before answering the question.
examples.zh: 回答问题前，我查看了标签样本上的「储存条件」。

words.expression: store in a cool dry place
words.lemma: store in a cool dry place
words.enDefinition: A label instruction to avoid heat and moisture
acceptedEnVariants: store in a cool dry place
keep in a cool dry place

examples.en: The tea tin said to store in a cool dry place near the barcode.
examples.zh: 茶叶罐在条形码旁写着「存放在阴凉干燥处」。

examples.en: I copied the words store in a cool dry place from a sample packet in class.
examples.zh: 我在课堂上从包装样本上抄下了「存放在阴凉干燥处」这句话。

collocations: a label saying store in a cool dry place
products marked store in a cool dry place
store in a cool dry place away from sunlight

words.enDefinition: To keep things in different places or containers

examples.en: We labelled the two batches that we needed to store separately in the fridge.
examples.zh: 我们给冰箱里需要「分开存放」的两批食物贴了标签。

examples.en: The label showed which parts of the meal the kitchen would store separately.
examples.zh: 标签标出了厨房会「分开存放」餐点中的哪些部分。

words.enDefinition: A direction to keep a container standing vertically

examples.en: The words store upright were printed on a removable sticker beside the handle.
examples.zh: 「竖直存放」印在提手旁一张可撕下的贴纸上。

examples.en: I saw that the label said store upright when my flatmate unpacked the bottle.
examples.zh: 室友把瓶子从袋里拿出来时，我看到标签写着「竖直存放」。

words.enDefinition: to pass a sauce through a fine filter to remove solid pieces

examples.en: I used a fine sieve to strain a sauce before pouring it into bowls.
examples.zh: 我用细筛「过滤酱汁」，再把它倒入碗里。

examples.en: The chef showed us how to strain a sauce so it looked smooth.
examples.zh: 厨师示范了怎样「过滤酱汁」，让它看起来均匀细腻。

collocations: strain a sauce through a sieve
use a sieve to strain a sauce

words.enDefinition: A soft red fruit with seeds on its surface

examples.en: I bought strawberries on my walk home from the library for our weekend picnic.
examples.zh: 我从图书馆走回家时买了些「草莓」，准备周末野餐吃。

examples.en: Only one strawberry in the whole box still had a pale tip on it.
examples.zh: 一整盒里只有一颗「草莓」的尖端还发白。

words.enDefinition: Bacon cut from pork belly with layers of meat and fat

examples.en: The British shop put the streaky bacon beside the leaner back cut.
examples.zh: 英国这家店把「五花培根」摆在更瘦的背部培根旁边。

examples.en: I noticed bands of fat running through the streaky bacon in the pack.
examples.zh: 我看到包装里的「五花培根」有一条条肥肉。

words.enDefinition: A steak cut from the strip loin of a beef animal

examples.en: The butcher showed us a strip steak with a band of fat.
examples.zh: 肉柜店员给我们看了一块边上带肥肉的「纽约客牛排」。

examples.en: I read the label twice before buying the strip steak on sale.
examples.zh: 我看了两遍标签，才买了那块打折的「纽约客牛排」。

words.enDefinition: the outer edge of a pizza with filling inside it

examples.en: We chose stuffed crust for the pizza we shared after our project meeting.
examples.zh: 项目会结束后，我们分吃了一张披萨，选的是「夹馅饼边」。

examples.en: The stuffed crust had cheese inside, which the menu listed separately from the toppings.
examples.zh: 「夹馅饼边」里面有芝士，菜单把它和披萨表面的配料分开列了。

words.enDefinition: To choose rice instead of the normally included fries

examples.en: The server said I could substitute rice for fries with the fish dish.
examples.zh: 服务员说，点鱼可以「用米饭换薯条」。

examples.en: I asked whether I could substitute rice for fries for my lunch order.
examples.zh: 我问午餐可不可以「用米饭换薯条」。

collocations: ask to substitute rice for fries
offer to substitute rice for fries
choose to substitute rice for fries

words.enDefinition: Sweet peas with crisp, edible rounded pods

examples.en: I bought sugar snap peas from the stall beside the entrance to campus.
examples.zh: 我在学校入口旁的摊位买了「甜脆豌豆」。

examples.en: The sugar snap peas felt plumper than the flatter peas in the next crate.
examples.zh: 「甜脆豌豆」摸起来比旁边箱子里较扁的豌豆更饱满。

collocations: a bag of sugar snap peas

words.enDefinition: Compounds sometimes used to preserve foods and drinks

examples.en: I saw sulphites listed among the ingredients on the dried fruit packet.
examples.zh: 我看到果干包装的配料表上有「亚硫酸盐」。

examples.en: The dining card showed sulphites in a separate column for this particular menu.
examples.zh: 这份菜单专用的餐饮卡片给「亚硫酸盐」单列了一栏。

words.enDefinition: to cook onions gently in a little fat until soft without browning them

examples.en: I began to sweat the onions while my roommate prepared the vegetable stock.
examples.zh: 我开始「小火炒软洋葱」，室友在旁边准备蔬菜高汤。

examples.en: The instructor said to sweat the onions before adding the rice to the pan.
examples.zh: 老师说，要先「小火炒软洋葱」，再把米倒进锅里。

collocations: sweat the onions over low heat
sweat the onions without browning them

words.enDefinition: A sweet starchy root sold as a vegetable

examples.en: I bought a sweet potato because the shop was selling them individually that day.
examples.zh: 那天店里「红薯」可以按个买，我就买了一个。

examples.en: The sweet potato in my bag was smaller than the ones in the display.
examples.zh: 我袋子里的「红薯」比展台上的那些小一点。

words.enDefinition: milk concentrated by removing water and sweetened with added sugar

examples.en: I used sweetened condensed milk for the iced coffee we made at home.
examples.zh: 我们在家做冰咖啡时，我用了「加糖炼乳」。

examples.en: The shop sells sweetened condensed milk in small cans next to the baking ingredients.
examples.zh: 商店在烘焙食材旁边卖小罐装的「加糖炼乳」。

collocations: a tin of sweetened condensed milk

words.enDefinition: A leafy vegetable with broad leaves and colourful stalks

examples.en: The Swiss chard at the stall had bright red stalks and wide green leaves.
examples.zh: 摊位上的「叶用甜菜」有鲜红色的叶柄和宽大的绿叶。

examples.en: I asked the seller whether the Swiss chard was sold loose or by the bunch.
examples.zh: 我问摊主，「叶用甜菜」是散卖还是按把卖。

words.enDefinition: A beef steak with a T-shaped bone separating two cuts

examples.en: I recognized the T-bone steak by the bone in the middle.
examples.zh: 我看到中间那根骨头，就认出这是「T骨牛排」。

examples.en: We skipped the T-bone steak because it would not fit our pan.
examples.zh: 我们没买「T骨牛排」，因为我们的锅放不下。

words.enDefinition: A restaurant table intended for two people to sit at

examples.en: I asked for a table for two when my friend arrived from campus.
examples.zh: 朋友从学校过来后，我问有没有「两人桌」。

examples.en: The host showed us to a table for two near the back wall.
examples.zh: 迎宾员领我们到了靠近后墙的一张「两人桌」。

collocations: ask for a table for two
a table for two by the window

words.enDefinition: Words telling waiting diners they can now be shown to their table

examples.en: I got a text saying our table is ready while we waited outside.
examples.zh: 我们在外面等着时，我收到短信说「桌位已经准备好」。

examples.en: The host told us our table is ready while we looked at the menu.
examples.zh: 我们看菜单时，迎宾员说「桌位已经准备好」。

collocations: let us know the table is ready
send a text when the table is ready

words.enDefinition: The number used to identify a particular table at a venue

examples.en: The server asked me for the table number printed on our sign.
examples.zh: 服务员让我报一下桌牌上印的「桌号」。

examples.en: I read out the table number so my friends could find us.
examples.zh: 我报了「桌号」，好让朋友找到我们。

words.enDefinition: Service in which staff take orders and bring food to diners' tables

examples.en: The café near campus offered table service only in the upstairs room.
examples.zh: 学校附近的咖啡馆只在楼上的用餐区提供「餐桌服务」。

examples.en: I asked whether the dining area had table service or a counter.
examples.zh: 我问用餐区是有「餐桌服务」还是需要到柜台去。

words.enDefinition: a smooth paste made from ground sesame seeds, common in Middle Eastern cooking

examples.en: I put a spoonful of tahini in the dressing for our lunch salad.
examples.zh: 我往午餐沙拉的酱汁里加了一勺「中东芝麻酱」。

examples.en: The supermarket stocks tahini beside the jars of nut butter and spreads.
examples.zh: 超市把「中东芝麻酱」放在罐装坚果酱等抹酱旁。

words.enDefinition: Shrimp sold with the tails still attached to the bodies

examples.en: The fishmonger pointed out where the packs of tail-on shrimp had been moved.
examples.zh: 鱼柜店员指给我看，几盒「留虾尾的虾」被挪到了哪里。

examples.en: We checked the name on the tail-on shrimp before buying it.
examples.zh: 买之前，我们核对了「留虾尾的虾」的品名。

words.enDefinition: To remove a particular item or charge from a bill

examples.en: The server offered to take it off the bill after checking what we ordered.
examples.zh: 服务员核对了我们点的东西后，主动提出「从账单上划掉这项」。

examples.en: I asked if the manager could take it off the bill before we paid.
examples.zh: 我问经理能不能在付钱前「从账单上划掉这项」。

collocations: ask to take it off the bill
agree to take it off the bill
offer to take it off the bill

words.enDefinition: To listen to and record what we want to eat

examples.en: The server came to take our order after our last friend arrived.
examples.zh: 最后一位朋友到场后，服务员过来「给我们点单」。

examples.en: We waited near the counter for someone to take our order at lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭时我们在柜台边等店员「给我们点单」。

collocations: come over to take our order
be ready to take our order
wait for someone to take our order

words.enDefinition: a container used to carry food away from a restaurant

examples.en: The café put my pasta in a takeout container for the walk back to campus.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆把意面装进「外带餐盒」，方便我走回学校时带着。

examples.en: I opened the takeout container over a plate because the noodles were covered in sauce.
examples.zh: 面条裹满了酱汁，我就把「外带餐盒」放在盘子上方打开。

collocations: put food in a takeout container

words.enDefinition: a menu listing food available to order and take away

examples.en: The café has a takeout menu with sandwiches that are ready before my afternoon lab.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆的「外带菜单」上有三明治，能在我下午的实验课前做好。

examples.en: I checked the takeout menu because we were eating on the lawn after practice.
examples.zh: 训练后我们要在草坪上吃饭，所以我看了看「外带菜单」。

words.enDefinition: a special offer available only for food taken off the premises

examples.en: The café had a takeout-only special for students leaving campus late after evening classes.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆有「仅供外带的特惠餐」，方便上完夜课才离校的学生。

examples.en: We chose the takeout-only special because we were having dinner in the shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 我们选了「仅供外带的特惠餐」，因为要在共用厨房吃晚饭。

words.enDefinition: A control that resets a scale while a container is on it

examples.en: The tare button was next to the display on our kitchen scale.
examples.zh: 我们的厨房秤上，「去皮归零键」就在显示屏旁边。

examples.en: I asked why the numbers changed after I pressed the tare button.
examples.zh: 我问为什么按下「去皮归零键」之后数字变了。

words.enDefinition: The weight of a container without its contents

examples.en: The scale screen showed the tare weight after I selected my reusable produce bag.
examples.zh: 我选了可重复使用的蔬果袋后，秤屏上显示了「包装皮重」。

examples.en: I asked whether the tare weight was already deducted when I weighed my vegetables.
examples.zh: 称蔬菜时，我问「包装皮重」是不是已经扣除了。

words.enDefinition: A planned sequence of several small dishes served in one meal

examples.en: The tasting menu let us try small portions of several different dishes.
examples.zh: 点「品鉴菜单」，我们就能尝到几道不同的菜，每道都是小份。

examples.en: My classmate asked what the first course on the tasting menu was.
examples.zh: 同学问「品鉴菜单」里的第一道菜是什么。

words.enDefinition: a small porous bag containing tea leaves for making one or more servings

examples.en: I took a tea bag from the box on the kitchen shelf.
examples.zh: 我从厨房架子上的盒子里拿了一只「茶包」。

examples.en: The café let me choose a tea bag from a tray by the kettle.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆让我在水壶边的托盘里选一只「茶包」。

words.enDefinition: to cover food loosely with foil instead of sealing it around the edges

examples.en: The recipe says to tent with foil while the roasted vegetables rest.
examples.zh: 食谱说，烤蔬菜静置时要「用箔纸松松盖住」。

examples.en: I needed to tent with foil because the top was browning too quickly.
examples.zh: 表面上色太快，所以我得「用箔纸松松盖住」。

collocations: tent with foil near the end of baking

words.enDefinition: asks for a text once the courier arrives

examples.en: Please text me when you're here because the doorbell in our building doesn't work.
examples.zh: 我们楼的门铃坏了，「到这儿了请给我发消息」。

examples.en: Text me when you're here and I'll open the side door near the stairs.
examples.zh: 「到这儿了给我发消息」，我去开楼梯旁边的侧门。

collocations: please text me when you're here
text me when you're here with the food
text me when you're here at the gate

words.enDefinition: Directions describing how to thaw frozen food

examples.en: I found thawing instructions beneath a fold at the back of the packet.
examples.zh: 我在包装背面的折边下面找到了「解冻说明」。

examples.en: The worksheet asked us to compare thawing instructions on two different food labels.
examples.zh: 练习单让我们比较两张不同食品标签上的「解冻说明」。

words.enDefinition: says the food bag was not closed when received

examples.en: The bag was open when I got it, and one of the containers was upside down.
examples.zh: 我拿到时「外卖袋是开着的」，里面有一个餐盒是倒扣着的。

examples.en: The bag was open at the top, so I checked that both sandwiches were inside.
examples.zh: 「外卖袋的袋口是开着的」，所以我看了看两份三明治是否都在。

collocations: the bag was open when I got it
the bag was open at the top
tell them the bag was open

words.enDefinition: reports that the food container was badly squeezed or dented

examples.en: The box got crushed under the drinks that were packed in the same bag.
examples.zh: 饮料装在同一个袋子里，把「餐盒压扁了」。

examples.en: It looks like the box got crushed before the courier reached our residence hall.
examples.zh: 好像配送员还没到宿舍楼，「餐盒就被压扁了」。

collocations: the box got crushed in the bag
the box got crushed on the way
it looks like the box got crushed

words.expression: the courier is at the restaurant
words.lemma: the courier is at the restaurant
words.enDefinition: says the driver or rider has reached the restaurant
acceptedEnVariants: the courier is at the restaurant

examples.en: The courier is at the restaurant now, so we can start setting the table.
examples.zh: 「配送员已到餐厅」，我们可以开始摆餐具了。

examples.en: The app says the courier is at the restaurant waiting for the noodles to be packed.
examples.zh: 应用显示「配送员已到餐厅」，在等面条打包好。

collocations: the courier is at the restaurant now
the map shows the courier is at the restaurant
the courier is at the restaurant waiting for our food

words.expression: the door is around the corner
words.lemma: the door is around the corner
words.enDefinition: says the door is just beyond the nearest corner
acceptedEnVariants: the door is around the corner

examples.en: The door is around the corner on the left, just past the bike racks.
examples.zh: 「那扇门在左边拐角过去」，过了自行车架就是。

examples.en: The door is around the corner from the café with the blue sign outside.
examples.zh: 「那扇门从咖啡馆拐过去就到」，那家咖啡馆外面有块蓝牌子。

collocations: the door is around the corner on the left
the door is around the corner from the sign
the door is around the corner by the stairs

words.enDefinition: says that the courier needs to make another delivery stop

examples.en: The app says the driver has another stop before coming to our campus entrance.
examples.zh: 应用上说「配送员还要先停一站」，然后才到咱们学校入口。

examples.en: The driver has another stop, so I'll turn my ringer back on and keep studying.
examples.zh: 「配送员还要先停一站」，所以我会把手机铃声重新打开，然后继续学习。

collocations: the app says the driver has another stop
the driver has another stop before ours
if the driver has another stop

words.expression: the driver has picked up your order
words.lemma: the driver has picked up your order
words.enDefinition: says the driver has collected your food from the restaurant
acceptedEnVariants: the driver has picked up your order

examples.en: The driver has picked up your order, so please keep an eye on your phone.
examples.zh: 「配送员已取餐」，请留意你的手机。

examples.en: The driver has picked up your order and is heading towards the campus residence.
examples.zh: 「配送员已取餐」，正往学校宿舍方向走。

collocations: the driver has picked up your order already
the driver has picked up your order from the café
a message saying the driver has picked up your order

words.enDefinition: says the delivery worker is close to your location

examples.en: The driver is nearby, so I'll go down to the student centre entrance now.
examples.zh: 「配送员就在附近」，我现在下楼去学生中心入口。

examples.en: The app says the driver is nearby, but I don't see anyone outside yet.
examples.zh: 应用上显示「配送员就在附近」，不过我还没看到外面有人。

collocations: the app says the driver is nearby

words.enDefinition: reports that a hot meal was cold when it arrived

examples.en: The food arrived cold after the courier went to the wrong residence building first.
examples.zh: 配送员先去了另一栋宿舍，「餐送到时已经凉了」。

examples.en: The food arrived cold even though the café is only a short walk away.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆走几步就到，「餐送到时还是已经凉了」。

collocations: the food arrived cold after the delay
tell them the food arrived cold
the food arrived cold this time

words.expression: the food spilled in the bag
words.lemma: the food spilled in the bag
words.enDefinition: says some food escaped its container inside the bag
acceptedEnVariants: the food spilled in the bag

examples.en: The food spilled in the bag before I could take it into the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我还没来得及把餐拿进厨房，「餐就洒在袋子里了」。

examples.en: The food spilled in the bag, so we asked if the café could replace it.
examples.zh: 「餐洒在袋子里了」，所以我们问咖啡馆能不能重新给我们做一份。

collocations: the food spilled in the bag on the way
it looks like the food spilled in the bag
report that the food spilled in the bag

words.enDefinition: says a container's cover fell or moved off it

examples.en: The lid came off the coffee cup while I was walking back to campus.
examples.zh: 走回学校的路上，咖啡杯的「盖子掉了」。

examples.en: The lid came off in the bag, so I contacted the café after lunch.
examples.zh: 「杯盖在袋子里掉了」，我午饭后联系了咖啡馆。

collocations: the lid came off in the bag
the lid came off during the ride
it looks like the lid came off

words.expression: the map pin is in the wrong place
words.lemma: the map pin is in the wrong place
words.enDefinition: reports that a location marker shows the wrong place
acceptedEnVariants: the map pin is in the wrong place

examples.en: I think the map pin is in the wrong place because I'm outside the gym.
examples.zh: 我现在在健身房外，所以我觉得「地图标记位置有误」。

examples.en: The map pin is in the wrong place, so please come to the north gate.
examples.zh: 「地图标记位置有误」，请到北门。

collocations: the map pin is in the wrong place on this app
it looks like the map pin is in the wrong place
