if the map pin is in the wrong place

words.enDefinition: says the listed collection time has been changed repeatedly

examples.en: The pickup time keeps changing, and I need to return to class in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 「取餐时间一直在变」，我十分钟后得回去上课。

examples.en: The pickup time keeps changing because the kitchen is finishing a large group order.
examples.zh: 后厨正在做完一个大团餐单，所以「取餐时间一直在变」。

collocations: the pickup time keeps changing in the app
the pickup time keeps changing again
tell them the pickup time keeps changing

words.expression: the restaurant hasn't got my order
words.lemma: the restaurant hasn't got my order
words.enDefinition: says the restaurant does not have the order you submitted
acceptedEnVariants: the restaurant hasn't got my order
the restaurant hasn't received my order

examples.en: The restaurant hasn't got my order, so I checked whether I'd selected another branch.
examples.zh: 「餐厅还没收到我的单」，于是我看看是不是选了另一家分店。

examples.en: It looks like the restaurant hasn't got my order even though the app accepted it.
examples.zh: 应用接受了订单，但看起来「餐厅还没收到我的单」。

collocations: it looks like the restaurant hasn't got my order
the restaurant hasn't got my order yet
if the restaurant hasn't got my order

words.expression: there’s a mistake on the bill
words.lemma: there’s a mistake on the bill
words.enDefinition: A polite way to point out an error in a bill
acceptedEnVariants: there’s a mistake on the bill

examples.en: I said, "There’s a mistake on the bill." I pointed to the second soup on the list.
examples.zh: 我说「账单上有一处错误」，指了指单子上的第二份汤。

examples.en: My flatmate said, "There’s a mistake on the bill." The server then checked our order.
examples.zh: 室友说「账单上有一处错误」，服务员随后核对了点单。

collocations: say "There's a mistake on the bill."
explain "There's a mistake on the bill here."
tell the server "There's a mistake on the bill."

words.enDefinition: A mixture of flour and liquid that flows only slowly

examples.en: The muffins needed a thick batter that would stay on the spoon.
examples.zh: 做玛芬需要能挂在勺子上的「稠面糊」。

examples.en: I checked whether the thick batter in my bowl matched the photo.
examples.zh: 我核对了碗里的「稠面糊」是不是和照片里的一样。

words.enDefinition: to increase the thickness of a sauce, for example by adding a thickener

examples.en: The demonstration compared two ways to thicken a sauce for the same dish.
examples.zh: 演示对比了给同一道菜「让酱汁变稠」的两种方法。

examples.en: I used a little cornstarch to thicken a sauce made with vegetable stock.
examples.zh: 我放了一点玉米淀粉，「让蔬菜高汤做的酱汁变稠」。

collocations: use flour to thicken a sauce

words.enDefinition: to make a sauce less thick by adding a suitable liquid

examples.en: I used a little stock to thin a sauce that had reduced too far.
examples.zh: 酱汁收得太浓了，我加了一点高汤来「把酱汁调稀」。

examples.en: The cook explained when to thin a sauce so it still coated the pasta.
examples.zh: 厨师说明了什么时候「把酱汁调稀」，仍能裹在意面上。

collocations: add stock to thin a sauce

words.enDefinition: a pizza base rolled or stretched so it stays thin

examples.en: I chose thin crust because we were ordering pizza to share before the concert.
examples.zh: 我们点披萨在音乐会前分着吃，所以我选了「薄饼底」。

examples.en: The thin crust stayed crisp on my first slice even after the walk home.
examples.zh: 走回家后，我吃的第一片还是有脆脆的「薄饼底」。

words.enDefinition: delivery handled by a separate service on a restaurant's behalf

examples.en: This kitchen uses third-party delivery on weekends when its own driver is off work.
examples.zh: 这家店自己的司机周末不上班，所以周末用「第三方送餐」。

examples.en: I asked who handled address changes because the café relies on third-party delivery for lunch.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆午餐依靠「第三方送餐」，所以我问了谁负责处理地址变更。

words.enDefinition: A meal with three separately served parts, often including dessert

examples.en: The event ended with a three-course meal at a restaurant near campus.
examples.zh: 活动最后在学校附近的餐厅吃了一顿「三道式餐点」。

examples.en: We asked what the first part of the three-course meal would be.
examples.zh: 我们问「三道式餐点」的头一道会是什么。

words.enDefinition: A mild-tasting freshwater fish commonly raised for food

examples.en: The shop sold tilapia in packs of two medium-sized fillets.
examples.zh: 店里的「罗非鱼」装成两片中等大小的鱼柳一包出售。

examples.en: I chose tilapia because the shop had sold out of cod.
examples.zh: 店里的鳕鱼卖光了，所以我选了「罗非鱼」。

words.enDefinition: In whatever amount gives the flavor someone prefers

examples.en: The last line says we can add lemon juice to taste.
examples.zh: 最后一行说，柠檬汁可以「按个人口味」添加。

examples.en: I asked what it meant to add herbs to taste in the dressing.
examples.zh: 我问在酱汁里「按个人口味」放香草是怎么回事。

words.enDefinition: to use dry heat to brown food lightly and bring out its flavour

examples.en: I wanted to toast the sesame seeds before sprinkling them on our salad.
examples.zh: 我打算先把芝麻「烘烤至褐香」，再撒到沙拉上。

examples.en: We used the same pan to toast the bread for the soup.
examples.zh: 我们用同一个锅把配汤的面包「烘烤至褐香」。

words.enDefinition: a thick concentrate made by cooking tomatoes down and removing much of their water

examples.en: I added tomato paste to make the lentil stew taste more of tomato.
examples.zh: 我给炖扁豆加了「浓缩番茄膏」，让番茄味更浓。

examples.en: The shop sold tomato paste in small tubes beside jars of sauce.
examples.zh: 店里的「浓缩番茄膏」装在小管里，摆在瓶装酱汁旁边。

words.enDefinition: To pour more water into glasses that have partly emptied

examples.en: The server came over to top up our water halfway through our meal.
examples.zh: 我们吃到一半时，服务员过来「给我们续点水」。

examples.en: My flatmate asked if someone could top up our water before dessert.
examples.zh: 室友问甜点上来以前能不能请人「给我们续点水」。

collocations: offer to top up our water
ask someone to top up our water
come by to top up our water

words.enDefinition: To gently mix pieces so their surfaces receive an even covering

examples.en: The salad recipe says to toss to coat once the dressing is added.
examples.zh: 沙拉菜谱上说，倒入酱汁后要「拌匀使表面裹上」酱汁。

examples.en: We used the larger bowl to toss to coat without spilling the vegetables.
examples.zh: 我们用大一点的碗「拌匀使表面裹上」酱汁，免得蔬菜洒出来。

collocations: toss to coat in a bowl

words.enDefinition: Very small quantities of a substance

examples.en: The packet said the chocolate might contain trace amounts of milk from shared equipment.
examples.zh: 包装说，巧克力可能因共用设备而含有「微量」乳类成分。

examples.en: I asked the café what trace amounts meant on the notice beside the muffins.
examples.zh: 我问咖啡馆，松饼旁边的告示上写的「微量」是什么意思。

words.expression: track the driver on the map
words.lemma: track the driver on the map
words.zhGloss: 在地图上看配送员的位置
words.enDefinition: use a map to follow a driver's location during delivery
acceptedZhAnswers: 在地图上看配送员的位置
acceptedEnVariants: track the driver on the map

examples.en: I could track the driver on the map while we cleared space for the food.
examples.zh: 我们腾出地方放吃的时，我可以「在地图上看配送员的位置」。

examples.en: You can track the driver on the map to see which gate they're approaching.
examples.zh: 可以「在地图上看配送员的位置」，看看对方快到哪个门了。

collocations: you can track the driver on the map
use the app to track the driver on the map
keep trying to track the driver on the map

words.enDefinition: says that traffic is delaying you on the way

examples.en: Sorry, traffic is holding me up near the bridge, but I have your food.
examples.zh: 不好意思，「桥附近堵车耽误了我」，餐已经在我这儿了。

examples.en: Traffic is holding me up this evening, so the delivery might be a little late.
examples.zh: 今晚「路上堵车耽误了我」，餐可能会送晚一点。

collocations: sorry, traffic is holding me up
traffic is holding me up near the bridge
traffic is holding me up today

words.enDefinition: to move the cooked food or another item from its container to a plate

examples.en: The recipe says to transfer to a plate after the first batch browns.
examples.zh: 食谱说，第一批上色后就「移到盘子里」。

examples.en: It was easier to transfer to a plate after loosening the edge first.
examples.zh: 先把边缘松开之后，更容易「移到盘子里」。

collocations: transfer to a plate with a spatula
transfer to a plate before serving

words.enDefinition: The place for leaving used trays after eating in a dining hall

examples.en: We left our bowls and plates at the tray return after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后，我们把碗和盘子放在「托盘回收处」。

examples.en: The tray return was near the door leading back to the library.
examples.zh: 「托盘回收处」就在通往图书馆的那扇门旁边。

collocations: leave dishes at the tray return

words.enDefinition: in British cooking, a savoury dish made by baking several ingredients together on one tray

examples.en: We made a traybake with potatoes and peppers for our midweek dinner.
examples.zh: 周中晚饭，我们做了「一盘烤成的菜」，里面有土豆和甜椒。

examples.en: I chose a traybake because I could put everything on one oven tray.
examples.zh: 我选了「一盘烤成的菜」，因为所有食材都能放在同一个烤盘上。

words.enDefinition: An edible nut from a tree, such as a walnut

examples.en: I checked which tree nut was listed in bold on the chocolate wrapper.
examples.zh: 我查看了巧克力包装上用粗体标出的是哪种「树坚果」。

examples.en: The menu named each tree nut used in the café's cakes and pastries.
examples.zh: 菜单逐一列出了咖啡馆蛋糕和糕点中用到的各种「树坚果」。

words.enDefinition: To remove the outer tips from a vegetable or similar ingredient

examples.en: The recipe says to trim the ends of the green beans before measuring them.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，称四季豆之前要「切掉两端」。

examples.en: I asked whether I needed to trim the ends of the scallions first.
examples.zh: 我问是不是得先给小葱「切掉两端」。

collocations: trim the ends of the beans

words.enDefinition: A thick, flat cut of tuna sold as a portion

examples.en: I bought one tuna steak to share with my roommate after class.
examples.zh: 我买了一块「金枪鱼排」，准备下课后和室友分着吃。

examples.en: The market displayed the tuna steak beside the fillets of white fish.
examples.zh: 市场把「金枪鱼排」摆在白肉鱼的鱼柳旁边。

words.enDefinition: to turn food over midway through its cooking time

examples.en: The recipe says to turn halfway through so each side has time to brown.
examples.zh: 食谱说要「做到一半时翻面」，这样两面都有时间上色。

examples.en: My flatmate reminded me to turn halfway through when we roasted the wedges.
examples.zh: 我们烤薯角时，室友提醒我「做到一半时翻面」。

collocations: turn halfway through the cooking time

words.enDefinition: to tip a baked item out of its tin and onto a rack

examples.en: The recipe says to turn out onto a rack after the tin cools.
examples.zh: 食谱说，等烤模凉下来后，要「脱模倒在晾架上」。

examples.en: I waited a few minutes before trying to turn out onto a rack.
examples.zh: 我等了几分钟，才试着「脱模倒在晾架上」。

collocations: carefully turn out onto a rack
leave briefly before you turn out onto a rack
turn out onto a rack to cool

words.enDefinition: thick Japanese noodles traditionally made from wheat flour

examples.en: I bought udon noodles from the chilled shelf for our shared soup.
examples.zh: 我从冷藏货架上买了「乌冬面」，准备和大家一起吃汤面。

examples.en: The grocery store sells udon noodles in packs that serve two people.
examples.zh: 杂货店的「乌冬面」一袋够两个人吃。

words.enDefinition: milk treated at an ultra-high temperature and packaged for a long unopened shelf life

examples.en: I found UHT milk in the grocery aisle beside the cartons of juice.
examples.zh: 我在杂货通道的果汁盒旁边找到了「超高温灭菌牛奶」。

examples.en: My flatmate keeps a carton of UHT milk in the cupboard for weekends.
examples.zh: 室友在柜子里放了一盒「超高温灭菌牛奶」，周末用。

words.enDefinition: not offered through the delivery option

examples.en: The soup was unavailable for delivery, so we picked it up after our seminar.
examples.zh: 汤「不提供外送」，所以研讨课结束后，我们自己去取了。

examples.en: A few desserts showed as unavailable for delivery after the café changed its evening menu.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆换了晚间菜单后，有几款甜点显示「不提供外送」。

words.enDefinition: Not yet fully developed or ready to eat

examples.en: The unripe bananas were still green when I brought them home from the shop.
examples.zh: 我从店里带回来的「未成熟的」香蕉还是青的。

examples.en: The stallholder showed me which mangoes were unripe and which I could eat that evening.
examples.zh: 摊主告诉我哪些芒果「还没成熟」，哪些当晚就能吃。

words.enDefinition: butter made without added salt

examples.en: The recipe called for unsalted butter in the crust and the filling.
examples.zh: 食谱说饼皮和馅料都要用「无盐黄油」。

examples.en: I bought unsalted butter so I could adjust the seasoning myself later.
examples.zh: 我买了「无盐黄油」，之后可以自己调整咸淡。

words.enDefinition: Prepared without adding sugar or other sweeteners

examples.en: I bought an unsweetened version of the drink from the shop near campus.
examples.zh: 我在学校附近的店买了这种饮料「未加甜味剂的」版本。

examples.en: The dispenser offered unsweetened tea in a separate jug beside the sweetened one.
examples.zh: 供饮处把「未加甜味剂的」茶单独放在一个壶里，旁边是甜茶。

words.zhGloss: 安全食用截止日期（英国）
words.enDefinition: A UK food label date concerning safe use
acceptedZhAnswers: 安全食用截止日期（英国）

examples.en: I checked the use-by date on the sandwich I bought at the London station.
examples.zh: 我查看了在伦敦车站买的三明治的「安全食用截止日期」。

examples.en: The UK package printed the use-by date next to the note about refrigeration.
examples.zh: 英国的食品包装把「安全食用截止日期」印在冷藏说明旁边。

words.enDefinition: To use earlier stock before the newer items

examples.en: We put a note on the cupboard asking everyone to use the oldest first.
examples.zh: 我们在食品柜上贴了便条，请大家「先用较早存放的食物」。

examples.en: The pantry volunteer explained what use the oldest first meant in their stock rotation system.
examples.zh: 食品救济站的志愿者解释了「先用较早存放的食物」在他们的库存周转中是什么意思。

collocations: remember to use the oldest first
a note saying use the oldest first
arrange stock to use the oldest first

words.enDefinition: asks somebody to go in through the door at the side

examples.en: Please use the side entrance so you can avoid the queue at the front.
examples.zh: 「请走侧门」，这样能避开正门排队的人。

examples.en: I asked the courier to use the side entrance because the front steps were blocked.
examples.zh: 正门的台阶被挡住了，我请配送员「走侧门」。

collocations: use the side entrance after dark
ask them to use the side entrance

words.enDefinition: A label phrase giving a period for using something

examples.en: I looked for the words use within on the note below the lid.
examples.zh: 我在盖子下方的说明上找「须在所示期限内用完」的提示。

examples.en: The cooking class worksheet asked us to find the use within instruction on each carton.
examples.zh: 烹饪课的练习单让我们找出每个纸盒上「须在所示期限内用完」的说明。

collocations: a label beginning with use within

words.enDefinition: a flavouring made by drawing aromatic compounds out of vanilla beans

examples.en: I added vanilla extract when mixing the batter for the birthday cake.
examples.zh: 我调生日蛋糕面糊时，加了「香草精」。

examples.en: The shop keeps vanilla extract in small bottles beside the food colouring.
examples.zh: 商店把小瓶装的「香草精」放在食用色素旁边。

words.enDefinition: Meat from a young calf sold for use as food

examples.en: I asked which section of the counter displayed the veal.
examples.zh: 我问肉柜的哪个区域摆着「小牛肉」。

examples.en: The shop had only one pack of veal left that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，店里只剩下一盒「小牛肉」。

words.enDefinition: An available meal or dish made without ingredients from animals

examples.en: The server showed me the vegan option on a separate page.
examples.zh: 服务员给我看了单独一页上的「纯素选项」。

examples.en: Our group chose the café after checking that it offered a vegan option.
examples.zh: 我们确认这家咖啡馆有「纯素选项」才选了这里。

words.enDefinition: A small tool for removing thin skin from vegetables

examples.en: We found the vegetable peeler at the bottom of the utensil drawer.
examples.zh: 我们在厨具抽屉底部找到了「蔬菜削皮器」。

examples.en: I passed the vegetable peeler to my roommate when she started the carrots.
examples.zh: 室友开始准备胡萝卜时，我把「蔬菜削皮器」递给了她。

words.enDefinition: a savoury liquid made by simmering vegetables, used as a cooking base

examples.en: We used vegetable stock as the base for the soup we made together.
examples.zh: 我们一起煮汤时，用「蔬菜高汤」做汤底。

examples.en: The recipe calls for vegetable stock to be added gradually to the rice.
examples.zh: 食谱要求把「蔬菜高汤」分次加进米饭里。

collocations: use vegetable stock as a base

words.enDefinition: One of the available meals that contains no meat or fish

examples.en: I asked whether there was a vegetarian option at the campus café.
examples.zh: 我问校园咖啡馆有没有「素食选项」。

examples.en: The vegetarian option came with the same two sides as my friend's meal.
examples.zh: 我点的「素食选项」和朋友的餐搭配了同样两份配菜。

collocations: a vegetarian option on the menu

words.enDefinition: a food box with small openings that let steam escape

examples.en: The café packed the fries in a vented box for the walk back to campus.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆把薯条装在「带透气孔的餐盒」里，方便我走回学校时拿着。

examples.en: The vented box let out steam while I waited by the pickup shelf.
examples.zh: 我在取餐架旁等时，蒸汽从「带透气孔的餐盒」冒了出来。

collocations: pack fries in a vented box
a vented box for hot food

words.enDefinition: A diner who arrives without booking a table in advance

examples.en: The host gave a walk-in guest the next available table for one.
examples.zh: 迎宾员把下一张空出的一人桌安排给了一位「没订位就到店的客人」。

examples.en: I asked whether a walk-in guest could sit at the counter instead.
examples.zh: 我问「没订位就到店的客人」可不可以改坐吧台。

words.enDefinition: a food order placed in person without ordering ahead

examples.en: I placed a walk-in order after passing the café on my way from class.
examples.zh: 下课路上经过咖啡馆时，我「到店当场点了单」。

examples.en: The staff had nearly finished my walk-in order by the time my friend arrived.
examples.zh: 我朋友到的时候，店员已经快做好了我「到店当场点的单」。

words.enDefinition: to heat food until the inside, as well as the outside, is warm

examples.en: I left the rolls in the oven to warm through before lunch.
examples.zh: 我把面包卷留在烤箱里，「把食物热透」再吃午饭。

examples.en: The recipe says the filling should warm through while the crust crisps.
examples.zh: 食谱说，外皮变脆时，里面的馅也应该「热透」。

collocations: allow the food to warm through
give the rolls time to warm through

words.enDefinition: Drinking water requested for everyone seated at a table

examples.en: The server brought water for the table before we opened our menus.
examples.zh: 我们还没打开菜单，服务员就拿来了「给一桌人喝的水」。

examples.en: I asked for water for the table when the last two friends arrived.
examples.zh: 最后两位朋友到场时，我请服务员拿来「给一桌人喝的水」。

collocations: ask for water for the table

words.enDefinition: A small leafy green with a peppery taste

examples.en: I found a bag of watercress near the fresh herbs in the refrigerated section.
examples.zh: 我在冷藏区的新鲜香草旁找到了一袋「西洋菜」。

examples.en: The sign said watercress, so I checked my list before taking the bag.
examples.zh: 标签上写的是「西洋菜」，我对照购物清单后才拿了那一袋。

words.enDefinition: A large melon with juicy flesh and a green rind

examples.en: I bought half a watermelon because I was taking the bus back to campus.
examples.zh: 我要坐公交回学校，所以只买了半个「西瓜」。

examples.en: The shop showed the inside of a seedless watermelon on the sign by the crate.
examples.zh: 瓜箱旁的标签上画了切开的无籽「西瓜」。

words.enDefinition: A statement explaining that an item was not requested by your group

examples.en: I said, "We didn’t order this," when a second salad arrived.
examples.zh: 又端来一份沙拉时，我说「这不是我们点的」。

examples.en: My friend said, "We didn’t order this," and pointed to the extra plate.
examples.zh: 朋友指着多出来的盘子说「这不是我们点的」。

collocations: tell the server "We didn't order this side dish."

words.zhGloss: 我们的订位登记在某人名下
words.enDefinition: A phrase introducing the name used for an existing reservation
acceptedZhAnswers: 我们的订位登记在某人名下

examples.en: I told the host, "We have a reservation under my roommate’s name," and showed the email.
examples.zh: 我跟迎宾员说「我们的订位登记在室友名下」，然后出示了邮件。

examples.en: The message says "We have a reservation under Lee," so tell the host that name.
examples.zh: 消息里说「我们的订位登记在李的名下」，所以到店后请报这个姓名。

collocations: we have a reservation under Chen
we have a reservation under my name
we have a reservation under my friend's name

words.enDefinition: To measure a quantity of food on a scale

examples.en: The worker offered to weigh out a portion from the larger piece of fish.
examples.zh: 店员提出可以从那块大鱼肉里「称出一份」给我。

examples.en: I watched the deli worker weigh out a portion of turkey for my order.
examples.zh: 我看着熟食柜店员给我「称出一份」火鸡肉。

collocations: weigh out a portion of meat
weigh out a portion of fish
ask someone to weigh out a portion

words.enDefinition: To use a scale to get the specified amount of flour

examples.en: We used the kitchen scale to weigh out the flour for the dough.
examples.zh: 我们用厨房秤给面团「称出所需面粉」。

examples.en: My roommate offered to weigh out the flour while I checked the recipe.
examples.zh: 我核对菜谱时，室友主动帮我「称出所需面粉」。

collocations: weigh out the flour for the dough
use a scale to weigh out the flour

words.enDefinition: To measure the weight of fruit or vegetables being bought

examples.en: Do you have to weigh your produce in this aisle or at the checkout?
examples.zh: 你得在这条货架通道里「给买的蔬果称重」，还是去收银台称？

examples.en: The sign says you can weigh your produce next to the loose apples.
examples.zh: 告示说，可以在散装苹果旁边「给买的蔬果称重」。

collocations: weigh your produce at the scale

words.enDefinition: Liquid or moist recipe ingredients usually mixed separately before combining

examples.en: I checked which of the wet ingredients belonged in the smaller bowl.
examples.zh: 我核对了哪些「湿性食材」应该放在较小的碗里。

examples.en: The wet ingredients included mashed banana as well as milk and eggs.
examples.zh: 「湿性食材」包括香蕉泥，也包括牛奶和鸡蛋。

words.enDefinition: A question asking which items accompany a particular order

examples.en: I pointed at the fish and asked, "What comes with that?" before ordering.
examples.zh: 点菜前，我指着鱼问「这道菜配什么？」

examples.en: My friend asked, "What comes with that?" when the server mentioned the rice bowl.
examples.zh: 服务员提到那款盖饭时，朋友问「这道菜配什么？」

collocations: say "What comes with that main dish?"
ask "What comes with that, besides the salad?"

words.enDefinition: A question inviting a server to suggest a dish or drink

examples.en: I asked, "What do you recommend?" when the server described the lunch menu.
examples.zh: 服务员介绍午餐菜单时，我问「您推荐什么？」

examples.en: My roommate asked, "What do you recommend?" after finding three dishes she liked.
examples.zh: 室友看到三道都想尝的菜，就问「您推荐什么？」

collocations: say "What do you recommend for lunch?"
ask "What do you recommend with this dish?"

words.enDefinition: A cereal crop used to make flour

examples.en: I checked whether wheat was listed on the back of the cracker packet.
examples.zh: 我查看了饼干包装背面有没有列「小麦」。

examples.en: The label mentioned wheat even though the front of the packet only showed oats.
examples.zh: 包装正面只画了燕麦，可标签里提到了「小麦」。

words.enDefinition: Described as not containing wheat

examples.en: The shelf label said wheat-free, but I still wanted to read the full ingredients.
examples.zh: 货架上标着「不含小麦」，不过我还是想看完整配料表。

examples.en: I checked the menu to see which crackers were labelled wheat-free that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，我查看了菜单上哪些饼干标着「不含小麦」。

words.enDefinition: Starch extracted from wheat grains

examples.en: The sandwich label listed wheat starch in the ingredients for the sauce.
examples.zh: 三明治标签上，酱汁的配料里列了「小麦淀粉」。

examples.en: I asked which part of the meal contained wheat starch before choosing another dish.
examples.zh: 我问餐点的哪一部分含「小麦淀粉」，再决定选另一道菜。

collocations: a sauce thickened with wheat starch

words.enDefinition: The liquid left after milk forms curds

examples.en: I saw whey on the cracker label and checked the other ingredients.
examples.zh: 我在饼干标签上看到「乳清」，又查看了其他配料。

examples.en: My classmate pointed out where whey was printed on the milk chocolate wrapper.
examples.zh: 同学指给我看牛奶巧克力包装上哪里印着「乳清」。

words.enDefinition: asks which entrance leads to the correct delivery location

examples.en: Which entrance should I use if the main doors are locked after six?
examples.zh: 如果六点后正门锁了，「我该从哪个入口进」？

examples.en: I can see two sets of doors, so which entrance should I use?
examples.zh: 我能看到两处门，「我该从哪个入口进」？

collocations: which entrance should I use after six?
which entrance should I use for the delivery?
just checking, which entrance should I use?

words.enDefinition: To combine ingredients using quick movements with a whisk

examples.en: I checked which ingredients to whisk together before adding the flour.
examples.zh: 我核对了在加面粉前要把哪些食材「一起搅打」。

examples.en: The recipe says to whisk together the eggs and milk first.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，先把鸡蛋和牛奶「一起搅打」。

words.enDefinition: A market name for certain pale shrimp sold for food

examples.en: The label listed white shrimp beside the product's country of origin.
examples.zh: 标签在产地旁写着「白对虾」。

examples.en: I saw white shrimp and several other kinds of shrimp on ice.
examples.zh: 我看到冰上摆着「白对虾」和其他几种虾。

words.enDefinition: A chicken sold with the main body and cuts still attached

examples.en: Our flat bought a whole chicken for a meal with visiting friends.
examples.zh: 我们合租的几个人买了一只「整鸡」，准备和来访的朋友一起吃。

examples.en: I asked whether the shop had a smaller whole chicken in stock.
examples.zh: 我问店里还有没有小一点的「整鸡」。

words.enDefinition: A fish sold as one piece rather than as separate cuts

examples.en: The worker pointed to a whole fish that weighed just under a kilo.
examples.zh: 店员指着一条不到一公斤的「整条鱼」。

examples.en: We chose a whole fish because several friends were coming to dinner.
examples.zh: 有几个朋友要来吃晚饭，所以我们买了「整条鱼」。

words.enDefinition: milk from which little or none of the natural fat has been removed

examples.en: I bought whole milk because it was the only small carton left.
examples.zh: 我买了「全脂牛奶」，因为只剩这种有小盒装。

examples.en: My flatmate put whole milk on the list for our weekend pancakes.
examples.zh: 室友把「全脂牛奶」写进了周末做薄煎饼的购物清单。

words.enDefinition: flour made by grinding the whole wheat grain, including the bran and germ

examples.en: I bought wholemeal flour to make a loaf for our shared lunch.
examples.zh: 我买了「全麦面粉」，想烤个面包一起吃午饭。

examples.en: The recipe uses wholemeal flour for half of the dry mixture in the rolls.
examples.zh: 做这些面包卷时，食谱要求干料一半用「全麦面粉」。

words.enDefinition: Leaves that have lost their firmness and freshness

examples.en: I left the bunch with wilted leaves and chose the one next to it.
examples.zh: 我没拿那把「叶子打蔫的」，选了旁边的一把。

examples.en: Some of the wilted leaves were hidden at the bottom of the salad bag.
examples.zh: 有几片「打蔫的叶子」藏在袋装沙拉菜的底部。

words.enDefinition: A restaurant table placed near a window

examples.en: We chose a window table because we wanted to watch the rain.
examples.zh: 我们选了张「靠窗的餐桌」，想看看外头下雨。

examples.en: The host said a window table would be available after the lunch rush.
examples.zh: 迎宾员说午餐高峰过后会有一张「靠窗的餐桌」空出来。

words.enDefinition: to move gently from side to side while remaining soft or flexible

examples.en: The centre of the pudding should wobble slightly when we move the dish.
examples.zh: 移动盘子时，布丁的中心应该「轻微晃动」。

examples.en: I could see the custard wobble slightly when my flatmate lifted the tray.
examples.zh: 室友抬起烤盘时，我能看到蛋奶冻「轻微晃动」。

collocations: allow the mixture to wobble slightly
look for the centre to wobble slightly

words.enDefinition: A wooden utensil commonly used to stir or combine ingredients

examples.en: I mixed the dough with a wooden spoon from the shared drawer.
examples.zh: 我从共用抽屉里拿出一把「木勺」拌面团。

examples.en: My flatmate asked for a wooden spoon to mix the salad.
examples.zh: 室友要一把「木勺」拌沙拉。

words.enDefinition: To handle and shape dough until it reaches a desired texture

examples.en: My flatmate asked whether we needed to work the dough any longer.
examples.zh: 室友问我们还要不要继续「揉整面团」。

examples.en: The teacher said to work the dough just enough to bring it together.
examples.zh: 老师说，只要「揉整面团」到能够成团就可以。

collocations: work the dough on a board

words.enDefinition: a drinking straw enclosed in its own small wrapper

examples.en: The café put a wrapped straw in the bag beside my iced tea.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆把一根「单独包好的吸管」放进袋子里，就在我的冰茶旁边。

examples.en: I found the wrapped straw under the napkins after bringing lunch back to campus.

words.enDefinition: A mild summer squash with a thin edible skin
